job.title: Kitchen Porter
job.location: Bell Lane, St Albans, AL2 1DR, GB
job.html_description:
The Role

We are looking for a Kitchen Porter to support the Kitchen and Front of House teams at Sobha Realty Training Centre. You will be responsible for completing daily cleaning schedules and health and safety documents, including the ware washing of all kitchen and restaurant equipment, crockery and cutlery.

You will also ensure that standards of cleanliness are maintained to an exceptional level by keeping facilities clean, tidy and safe at all times.

Who we are

We are one of the most famous clubs in world football, with a rich heritage and history of success – read more about our history, here.

Beyond that, we are passionate about our local community and, behind the scenes, we have a wide variety of opportunities and career paths for all. We have a very defined purpose: to act for a winning team, culture and community. We achieve this by ensuring we are courageous in the pursuit of progress, we champion our community and each other, and that we do the right thing (even when no one is looking).

 

Our Commitment to Safeguarding

We are committed to ensuring that our environments for children, young people and adults at risk remain safe and inclusive. We therefore require successful candidates to complete a DBS check and other essential background checks prior to starting their employment. Depending on the responsibilities of the role, a DBS will be either a basic, standard, or enhanced check.

Your day-to-day

  • Maintain exceptional standards of cleanliness - you will ensure that kitchen equipment is sufficiently cleaned and stored, and you will be responsible for cleaning the entire kitchen once it is closed, to ensure it is ready for the next day

  • Align with senior colleagues on stock levels - you'll work closely with our Head Chef and keep them up to date with regards to stock levels of ware washing supplies to ensure we have no shortages

  • Maintain safety and compliance - you will ensure the safety of others is considered and confidentiality is maintained at all times when work is being undertaken, ensuring the compliance of nutrition and sanitation regulations and all industry hygiene and safety standards

  • Proactively support the team - you'll show flexibility and a positive, can do attitude throughout to help out in other areas where required, such as the cleaning of all back of house areas where required

 

What we are looking for

  • Excellent communication skills - you are a confident, clear communicator with a positive team player attitude, and you're highly approachable with a clear professional manner

  • Proven experience in a similar kitchen environment - you have experience in a kitchen based or similar role

  • Proud team player - you can effectively work in a team as well as work independently, willing to support and help with your teams needs when required

  • Composed under pressure - you’re able to work well in a high pressure environment and effectively adapt to change and prioritise work loads accordingly

  • Flexible and adaptable mindset - you have availability to work weekdays and / or weekends and early mornings, and you are an effective time manager with the ability to multi-task and prioritise

Why choose us

At Arsenal, we want everyone to feel a sense of trust and belonging, so we are proud of both our club values and also what we offer to our employees. As one of our Gunners, you will receive:

  • An exciting reward and recognition scheme

  • Generous holiday allowance which increases with your length of service

  • Great internal learning and development programmes

  • A flexible hybrid working model

  • Priority access to apply for match tickets

  • A competitive health and wellbeing benefits package

  • A leading Employee Assistance Programme

  • Great discounts with some of our Partners

  • An opportunity to play a vital role in delivering our ED&I strategy by joining one of our Employee Networks

Discover why ‘Our Gunners’ are proud to be part of our team - view their stories here.

Arsenal for Everyone

Arsenal for Everyone is our commitment to promoting and embracing equality, diversity and inclusion, so that everyone connected to the club feels like they belong to the same Arsenal family. We believe that diversity of background, skills and experience drives our success on and off the pitch. 


Disability Confident Leader

We are a Disability Confident Leader. We actively welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities and long-term health conditions. If you need disability-related adjustments to the recruitment process, please indicate this in your application.

If you are likely to meet the definition of being a ‘disabled person’ according to the Equality Act 2010, you may be eligible to apply for an interview via the Disability Confident Scheme - please indicate this in your application form below. The information you share with us about your health or disability will not be used in recruitment decisions.


Application Closing Date - Friday 27th November 2026

Please note: we reserve the right to close the position early if application volumes are particularly high. We encourage you to get your application in sooner rather than later.

Updates on the status of your application will be sent via email, please routinely check your spam and junk folders, as occasionally emails sent via the Teamtailor platform will find themselves there.

Good luck!

job.title: Manager, Global Digital Advertising (FTC)
job.location: Arsenal Football Club, London, N5 1BU, GB
job.html_description:
The Role

We are looking for a Manager of Global Digital Advertising to join us on a 12 month fixed term contract basis.

We're looking to find a commercially driven, proactive and creative individual to join our Media Sales & Digital Partnerships team. In this exciting role, you'll need to be a true self-starter and all-rounder who is comfortable taking ownership across every stage of the media sales process. You'll be actively involved throughout the lifecycle, from prospecting and media planning through to proposal development, deal negotiation, project management and campaign reporting.

The role offers considerable variety and requires someone who can adapt to changing priorities, take a hands-on approach and confidently manage multiple workstreams. Working alongside colleagues across servicing, insights, content and social media, you will be responsible for progressing opportunities from initial client brief through to campaign delivery and post-campaign analysis.

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced media sales professional with an extensive background in digital advertising, particularly across social media, branded content, paid social and pre-roll video advertising.

The successful candidate will combine sales credentials with excellent organisational and project management skills, commercial creativity and the confidence to develop client relationships. Above all, we are looking for someone who can hit the ground running, embrace the breadth of the role and make a tangible contribution to our club's digital advertising commercial performance.

Who we are

We are one of the most famous clubs in world football, with a rich heritage and history of success – read more about our history, here.

Beyond that, we are passionate about our local community and, behind the scenes, we have a wide variety of opportunities and career paths for all. We have a very defined purpose: to act for a winning team, culture and community. We achieve this by ensuring we are courageous in the pursuit of progress, we champion our community and each other, and that we do the right thing (even when no one is looking).

Our Commitment to Safeguarding

We are committed to ensuring that our environments for children, young people and adults at risk remain safe and inclusive. We therefore require successful candidates to complete a DBS check and other essential background checks prior to starting their employment. Depending on the responsibilities of the role, a DBS will be either a basic, standard, or enhanced check.

Your day-to-day

  • Drive media sales and revenue growth - you'll drive revenue across our digital advertising portfolio, with a particular focus on social media, branded content, paid social and pre-roll video advertising, and you will develop existing opportunities, generate new business and maximise the commercial potential of the proposition

  • Secure exciting new business opportunities - you will proactively identify, develop and convert new business opportunities to achieve agreed revenue targets, managing the end-to-end sales process, from prospecting and client briefing through to proposal development, negotiation and deal closure

  • Establish winning relationships - you'll eagerly build and maintain valuable relationships with media agencies, media buyers, direct advertisers and commercial partners

  • Highlight target brands and agencies - you'll uncover target brands and agencies, develop prospecting strategies and create opportunities for long-term commercial partnerships

  • Lead the pitching process - you will relish the opportunity to lead client presentations and sales pitches, confidently communicating the value of our digital inventory, audience and content offering

  • Negotiate competitive agreements - you'll negotiate commercial agreements and manage client expectations to maximise revenue and build sustainable relationships

  • Develop compelling proposals and presentations - you will produce creative, insight-led media plans and commercial proposals tailored to client briefs and campaign objectives, and you'll create polished, persuasive PowerPoint presentations that clearly communicate campaign concepts, deliverables, audience opportunities and commercial value

  • Collaborate with colleagues across our club - you'll team up with our Content, Social Media and Marketing teams to develop and commercialise engaging branded content opportunities

  • Tap into our brand power - you will combine our digital channels, content and audience insights to deliver compelling campaigns that resonate with advertisers

  • Keep up to date with industry trends and developments - you'll stay informed about digital advertising trends, market opportunities and evolving client needs to help develop our club's commercial proposition

 

What we are looking for

  • Extensive experience in digital media sales - you're proud of your significant experience in digital media sales, ideally within a media owner, publisher, sports, entertainment or digital content environment

  • In depth knowledge of content and advertising - you are well versed in branded content, paid social advertising and digital video, including pre-roll advertising

  • A well connected professional - you've built up an established network of contacts across media agencies, media buying teams and/or direct advertisers

  • Commercial instinct - you come with a demonstrable track record of developing commercial opportunities, negotiating deals and maximising revenue, while also creating long-term client partnerships and accelerating growth

  • Engaging and persuasive approach - you've got a track record of developing creative media plans, responding to client briefs and presenting persuasive commercial proposals, and you lean on your exceptional pitching and negotiation skills to influence senior stakeholders

  • Best-in-class communication skills - you grow and nurture impactful relationships with a range of colleagues and stakeholders, and you're able to vary your style and approach as necessary

  • Forward-thinking mindset - you're a proactive self-starter with the ability to take ownership of a sales pipeline and deliver results with minimal supervision

  • Excellent organisational skills - you have the ability to prioritise multiple opportunities, manage competing deadlines and maintain attention to detail

  • Confidence with key tools - you back yourself to produce high-quality, professional PowerPoint presentations and sales materials


Why choose us

At Arsenal, we want everyone to feel a sense of trust and belonging, so we are proud of both our club values and also what we offer to our employees. As one of our Gunners, you will receive:

  • An exciting reward and recognition scheme

  • Generous holiday allowance which increases with your length of service

  • Great internal learning and development programmes

  • A flexible hybrid working model

  • Priority access to apply for match tickets

  • A competitive health and wellbeing benefits package

  • A leading Employee Assistance Programme

  • Great discounts with some of our Partners

  • An opportunity to play a vital role in delivering our ED&I strategy by joining one of our Employee Networks

Discover why ‘Our Gunners’ are proud to be part of our team - view their stories here.

Arsenal for Everyone

Arsenal for Everyone is our commitment to promoting and embracing equality, diversity and inclusion, so that everyone connected to the club feels like they belong to the same Arsenal family. We believe that diversity of background, skills and experience drives our success on and off the pitch. 


Disability Confident Leader

We are a Disability Confident Leader. We actively welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities and long-term health conditions. If you need disability-related adjustments to the recruitment process, please indicate this in your application.

If you are likely to meet the definition of being a ‘disabled person’ according to the Equality Act 2010, you may be eligible to apply for an interview via the Disability Confident Scheme - please indicate this in your application form below. The information you share with us about your health or disability will not be used in recruitment decisions.


Application Closing Date - Tuesday 1st December 2026

Please note: we reserve the right to close the position early if application volumes are particularly high. We encourage you to get your application in sooner rather than later.

Updates on the status of your application will be sent via email, please routinely check your spam and junk folders, as occasionally emails sent via the Teamtailor platform will find themselves there.

Good luck!

job.title: Lead Phase Coach (U16)
job.html_description:
The Role

We are looking for a Phase Lead Coach to be responsible for covering the full coaching remit, leading on an effective coaching programme for U15/U16 players in the late youth development phase.

In this critical role, you'll be delivering and developing performance pathways and plans, and creating an optimum environment for youth players to develop and grow; with the biggest focus being on the four pillars, creating effective team players, lifelong learners, most efficient movers with a champion mentality.

Who we are

We are one of the most famous clubs in world football, with a rich heritage and history of success – read more about our history, here.

Beyond that, we are passionate about our local community and, behind the scenes, we have a wide variety of opportunities and career paths for all. We have a very defined purpose: to act for a winning team, culture and community. We achieve this by ensuring we are courageous in the pursuit of progress, we champion our community and each other, and that we do the right thing (even when no one is looking).

 

Our Commitment to Safeguarding

We are committed to ensuring that our environments for children, young people and adults at risk remain safe and inclusive. We therefore require successful candidates to complete a DBS check and other essential background checks prior to starting their employment. Depending on the responsibilities of the role, a DBS will be either a basic, standard, or enhanced check.

Your day-to-day

  • Deliver impactful training sessions - you'll lead players to develop and coordinate all individual and team training sessions, catering for the needs of the players both individually and collectively, in order to maximise the potential of all our players in this age group

  • Uphold our high standards - you will work closely with our Head of Academy Coaching to comply with Premier League, FA and EPPP rules and requirements

  • Provide inspiring leadership - you'll be entrusted to line manage Academy Coaches, providing guidance, mentorship and day-to-day direction

  • Champion insightful feedback - you'll provide a reporting platform to give constructive feedback at the end of each term for players and you will work with the relevant phase Coaching team to implement, ensuring that player review meetings are effectively and accurately documented

  • Collaborate with colleagues across our club - you will assist other Coaches in the relevant youth development phase to prepare and debrief matches, and you'll work closely with colleagues across physical performance and analysis, as well as psychological and operational support staff

  • Evolve our coaching programme - you'll eagerly seek out ways to improve the coaching programme and assist with the implementation and operation of these ideas

  • Advocate for effective CPD - you will work with our Head of Academy Coaching to implement a programme of continuous professional development for the Academy team

  • Support squad selection processes - you'll operate as an active member of the youth squad selection team, analysing the skills and capabilities of individual players through player progress meetings of the relevant phase

 

What we are looking for

  • Proven track record in elite football - you come with significant experience of coaching elite football players to individual potential and team success, and you've got experience of coaching players at youth level who have progressed to play professional football in the Premier League or English Football League

  • Background in academy coaching - you have demonstrable experience of working with elite academy of players of this age group, possessing proven EPPP knowledge, and you're able to work as part of a coaching team and within the guidelines set by our Academy Director

  • Credible expertise - you proudly hold a UEFA B Licence and an FA Advanced Youth Award for Coaching, and you hold an FA Safeguarding Certificate as well as a First Aid Certification

  • Impactful communicator - you pride yourself on your ability to build strong rapport with the players in the age range and you're able to communicate key technical messages in coaching sessions

  • Forward-thinking approach - you have a keen awareness of how to develop players and you can set realistic goals for them and the team

  • Inspiring leadership skills - you're motivated and driven with a commitment and natural passion for our game

  • Best-in-class organisational skills - you've got excellent organisational and time management skills

  • Proud ambassador for our club - you act as a role model at all times, embodying our Academy's values of discipline, humility and respect, as well as our wider club values

    Position of Trust - As someone in a position of trust role involving regular, direct contact with children or vulnerable adults you will be expected to uphold high standards of conduct to prevent abuse, including sexual, physical, or emotional harm. This role requires you to keep updated with both Club and FA Safeguarding training and education

Why choose us

At Arsenal, we want everyone to feel a sense of trust and belonging, so we are proud of both our club values and also what we offer to our employees. As one of our Gunners, you will receive:

  • An exciting reward and recognition scheme

  • Generous holiday allowance which increases with your length of service

  • Great internal learning and development programmes

  • A competitive health and wellbeing benefits package

  • A leading Employee Assistance Programme

  • Great discounts with some of our Partners

  • An opportunity to play a vital role in delivering our ED&I strategy by joining one of our Employee Networks

Discover why ‘Our Gunners’ are proud to be part of our team - view their stories here.

Arsenal for Everyone

Arsenal for Everyone is our commitment to promoting and embracing equality, diversity and inclusion, so that everyone connected to the club feels like they belong to the same Arsenal family. We believe that diversity of background, skills and experience drives our success on and off the pitch. 


Disability Confident Leader

We are a Disability Confident Leader. We actively welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities and long-term health conditions. If you need disability-related adjustments to the recruitment process, please indicate this in your application.

If you are likely to meet the definition of being a ‘disabled person’ according to the Equality Act 2010, you may be eligible to apply for an interview via the Disability Confident Scheme - please indicate this in your application form below. The information you share with us about your health or disability will not be used in recruitment decisions.

Application Closing Date - Sunday 29th November 2026

Please note: we reserve the right to close the position early if application volumes are particularly high. We encourage you to get your application in sooner rather than later.

Updates on the status of your application will be sent via email, please routinely check your spam and junk folders, as occasionally emails sent via the Teamtailor platform will find themselves there.

Good luck!

job.title: Media Services Support Engineer (FTC)
job.html_description:
The Role

We are looking for a Media Services Support Engineer to join us on a 12 month fixed-term contract basis, and maintain and optimise our club’s media infrastructure, ensuring the seamless delivery of matchday and non-matchday content and supporting our Media, Events, Operational and Editorial teams. You will collaborate with these teams, supporting live productions, managing broadcast and media systems, and contributing to the improvement of digital and video workflows.

In this exciting role, you will combine technical expertise with operational delivery, taking ownership of reported issues and providing vital support by troubleshooting live event production systems from diagnosis through to resolution and documentation. You will work with live production systems while ensuring content is distributed reliably across multiple platforms.

Please note: Matchdays are a core part of this role. You will monitor and manage contribution and distribution feeds, helping to deliver high-quality content to supporters, third-parties and rights holders. The role requires availability on matchdays, evenings, weekends and public holidays in line with our club's fixture schedule.

Who we are

We are one of the most famous clubs in world football, with a rich heritage and history of success – read more about our history, here.

Beyond that, we are passionate about our local community and, behind the scenes, we have a wide variety of opportunities and career paths for all. We have a very defined purpose: to act for a winning team, culture and community. We achieve this by ensuring we are courageous in the pursuit of progress, we champion our community and each other, and that we do the right thing (even when no one is looking). 

Our Commitment to Safeguarding

We are committed to ensuring that our environments for children, young people and adults at risk remain safe and inclusive. We therefore require successful candidates to complete a DBS check and other essential background checks prior to starting their employment. Depending on the responsibilities of the role, a DBS will be either a basic, standard, or enhanced check.

Your day-to-day

  • Maintain and enhance infrastructure - you will proudly maintain and enhance the media equipment and facilities within our club, minimising any service downtime and implementing alternative solutions

  • Collaborate with Production and Content teams - you'll provide critical support to our Content and Production teams on weekdays and during events/productions

  • Support matchday and live event operations - you will oversee the preparation, routing and monitoring of contribution and distribution feeds

  • Work with external stakeholders - you'll work diligently with third-party suppliers and rights holders over contribution issues and live/amended deliveries, ensuring agreed media delivery formats are adhered to

  • Develop and improve media workflows - you will contribute to the design, implementation and optimisation of media workflows and system improvements

  • Maintain technical documentation - you will maintain accurate technical documentation to support technical documentation to support operational continuity and knowledge sharing

 

What we are looking for

  • Experience in broadcast or live production - you have experience supporting broadcast, media production or live event operations, with an understanding of the technical and operational requirements of live content delivery

  • Broadcast, IT and media systems knowledge - you have thorough technical knowledge across broadcast, media and IT systems. This includes practical experience with Windows and Linux operating systems, networking fundamentals, broadcast video formats, encoding standards, contribution and delivery protocols, digital and broadcast production workflows, media asset management systems, encoding and playout systems, and video/audio signal routing and distribution within physical and virtualised environments

  • Effective communication skills - you can communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Organised and proactive working style - you can manage your workload effectively within a fast-paced production environment, prioritising operational tasks while contributing to ongoing improvements to systems and workflows

  • Commercial awareness - you're able to assess solutions, upgrades and liaise with supplier services to make recommendations through a commercial lens

  • Customer-focused mindset - you're driven by providing an outstanding experience and determined to provide an optimal service under any circumstance

  • Natural problem-solver - you have a passion for solving problems, with a keen curiosity in uncovering potential issues, and you take a calm, methodical approach under pressure with high attention to detail

Why choose us

At Arsenal, we want everyone to feel a sense of trust and belonging, so we are proud of both our club values and also what we offer to our employees. As one of our Gunners, you will receive:

  • An exciting reward and recognition scheme

  • Generous holiday allowance which increases with your length of service

  • Great internal learning and development programmes

  • A flexible hybrid working model

  • Priority access to apply for match tickets

  • A competitive health and wellbeing benefits package

  • A leading Employee Assistance Programme

  • Great discounts with some of our Partners

  • An opportunity to play a vital role in delivering our ED&I strategy by joining one of our Employee Networks

Discover why ‘Our Gunners’ are proud to be part of our team - view their stories here.

Arsenal for Everyone

Arsenal for Everyone is our commitment to promoting and embracing equality, diversity and inclusion, so that everyone connected to the club feels like they belong to the same Arsenal family. We believe that diversity of background, skills and experience drives our success on and off the pitch. 

Disability Confident Leader

We are a Disability Confident Leader. We actively welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities and long-term health conditions. If you need disability-related adjustments to the recruitment process, please indicate this in your application.

If you are likely to meet the definition of being a ‘disabled person’ according to the Equality Act 2010, you may be eligible to apply for an interview via the Disability Confident Scheme - please indicate this in your application form below. The information you share with us about your health or disability will not be used in recruitment decisions.



Application Closing Date - Sunday 6th December 2026

Please note: we reserve the right to close the position early if application volumes are particularly high. We encourage you to get your application in sooner rather than later.

Updates on the status of your application will be sent via email, please routinely check your spam and junk folders, as occasionally emails sent via the Teamtailor platform will find themselves there.

Good luck!

job.title: Grounds Person - Hale End Academy
job.html_description:
The Role

We are looking for a Grounds Person to join our team and support the maintenance and general upkeep of our world class playing surfaces and amenity landscapes at our Hale End Academy.

 

Who we are

We are one of the most famous clubs in world football, with a rich heritage and history of success – read more about our history, here.

Beyond that, we are passionate about our local community and, behind the scenes, we have a wide variety of opportunities and career paths for all. We have a very defined purpose: to act for a winning team, culture and community. We achieve this by ensuring we are courageous in the pursuit of progress, we champion our community and each other, and that we do the right thing (even when no one is looking).

Our Commitment to Safeguarding

We are committed to ensuring that our environments for children, young people and adults at risk remain safe and inclusive. We therefore require successful candidates to complete a DBS check and other essential background checks prior to starting their employment. Depending on the responsibilities of the role, a DBS will be either a basic, standard, or enhanced check.

Your day-to-day

  • Uphold our world class playing surfaces and landscapes - you'll be entrusted with the maintenance of our playing surfaces and amenity landscapes

  • Carry out daily activities to as part of a wider team - you’ll be using our handheld and ride on cutting equipment, strimming around trees, operating our sprinklers, hand digging borders, spreading composts, incorporating into soil, sweeping up hard standing areas, pruning shrubs, disposing of leaves, cuttings and debris, and hand weeding sensitive areas where chemical control is not permitted

  • Efficiently use specialist equipment - you will carry out tractor and trailer work and use a range of machinery in renovation of grass areas such as turf cutters, stone buriers, scarifiers and seeders

  • Keep a keen-eye on the finer details - you'll assist in the renovation of the grounds and play a key role in marking out pitches, applying fertiliser and watering plants

  • Support wider team with important manual tasks - you will help out with deliveries and undertake manual handling of bags of sand, fertiliser and seed ranging from 20-25kg

  • Prioritise best-in-class standards - you'll proactively clean equipment stores and washdown areas and play a vital role in ensuring we're working in an impeccable and spotless environment

 

What we are looking for

  • Qualified expert - you hold NVQ level 2 or above in green keeping and groundsmanship or equivalent

  • Experience with a range of key equipment - you've used a wide range of turf equipment such as cylinder mowers, ride on mowers, scarification equipment and a wide range of renovation equipment as well as hedge cutters, strimmers and all equipment associated with amenity landscapes

  • Background in all aspects of grounds keeping - you've not only applied your specialist skills to playing surfaces but also to wider amenity landscapes as well

  • Proud team player - you're able to collaborate courageously with the wider team but you also demonstrate the capabilities to work using your own initiative

  • Safety conscious individual - you have a good understanding of the latest health and safety legislation related to the proper use of equipment and machinery

  • Excellent attention to detail and communication skills - you take a meticulous approach to your work and pride yourself on your ability to build strong relationships with colleagues

  • Clean UK driving licence - you'll be able to transport yourself to our club's various different locations


Why choose us

At Arsenal, we want everyone to feel a sense of trust and belonging, so we are proud of both our club values and also what we offer to our employees. As one of our Gunners, you will receive:

  • An exciting reward and recognition scheme

  • Generous holiday allowance which increases with your length of service

  • Great internal learning and development programmes

  • A flexible hybrid working model

  • Priority access to apply for match tickets

  • A competitive health and wellbeing benefits package

  • A leading Employee Assistance Programme

  • Great discounts with some of our Partners

  • An opportunity to play a vital role in delivering our ED&I strategy by joining one of our Employee Networks

Discover why ‘Our Gunners’ are proud to be part of our team - view their stories here.

Arsenal for Everyone

Arsenal for Everyone is our commitment to promoting and embracing equality, diversity and inclusion, so that everyone connected to the club feels like they belong to the same Arsenal family. We believe that diversity of background, skills and experience drives our success on and off the pitch. 


Disability Confident Leader

We are a Disability Confident Leader. We actively welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities and long-term health conditions. If you need disability-related adjustments to the recruitment process, please indicate this in your application.

If you are likely to meet the definition of being a ‘disabled person’ according to the Equality Act 2010, you may be eligible to apply for an interview via the Disability Confident Scheme - please indicate this in your application form below. The information you share with us about your health or disability will not be used in recruitment decisions.


Application Closing Date - Friday 4th December 2026

Please note: we reserve the right to close the position early if application volumes are particularly high. We encourage you to get your application in sooner rather than later.

job.title: Pre-Academy & Junior Training Centre Goalkeeping Coach (Casual)
job.location: AFC Bournemouth Performance Centre, Wimborne, Wimborne, Dorset
job.html_description:
To deliver high-quality goalkeeping coaching sessions to develop players within AFC Bournemouth’s Pre-Academy Programme (Under-6 to Under-8) and Junior Training Centre Programme (Under-9 to Under-14).  

Academy Values: 
  • Players First: every player valued. Every decision made with care.  
  • Togetherness: working as part of a wider team and willing to contribute beyond own interests. 
  • Integrity: carrying out academy and club values in an open and honest manner. 
  • Accountability: willing to take responsibility for actions, allowing for learning, growth and reflection.  
  • Plan, deliver and review high-quality weekly coaching sessions in accordance with AFC Bournemouth Academy’s coaching philosophy, maximising the individual development of players within AFC Bournemouth’s Pre-Academy and Junior Training Centre Programme. 
  • Engage positively with players and parents, providing specific feedback at the end of each training block in relation to each players Individual Development Plan (IDP).  
  • Work collaboratively with coaching & recruitment departments, to support the recruitment and progression of players within AFC Bournemouth’s Pre-Academy and Junior Training Centre Programme. 
Professional Requirements 
  • Attend continued professional development sessions organised by the Academy or other professional bodies. 
  • Attend seasonal safeguarding training as required by the Club. 
  • Adhere to all guidelines contained within the Club's Safeguarding Policy. 
  • Utilise the ‘MyConcern’ system to ‘recognise, respond, report and record’ any safeguarding incidents in a timely and detailed manner. 
General 
  • As a casual worker you must adhere to the club’s safeguarding policies and procedures and are committed to our safeguarding values, creating a safe and positive environment for all those who interact with the club.  
  • Obligation to adhere to the club’s health and safety policy and procedures.  
  • Actively promote the club’s equality policies and practices to ensure a welcoming, safe and inclusive environment for everyone engaged with the club.  

The duties and responsibilities described are not a comprehensive list and additional tasks may be assigned to the employee from time to time; or the scope of the job may change as necessitated by business demands.
Essential 
Skills, Knowledge & Qualifications: 
  • Introduction to Coaching Football (Equivalent to FA Level 1 Coaching course)  
  • FA Safeguarding Children 
  • EFAiF (Emergency First Aid in Football) 
  • Excellent communication and organisational skills 
Experience: 
  • Experience of coaching football to players between 5 to 14 years old.  

Desirable 
Skills, Knowledge & Qualifications: 
  • FA National Goalkeeping Course (Equivalent to FA Level 1 & 2 Coaching Goalkeepers course) 
  • UEFA C Coaching Diploma (or working towards) 
Experience: 
  • Working within a professional football environment at youth level.

job.title: Casual Ticketing Services Representative
job.html_description:
To ensure that all supporters have the best ticketing experience possible, throughout the season and on matchdays. 

Being proactive and going the extra mile to ensure that all customer service queries by supporters are dealt with maximum efficiency and quality.

Located within the AFC Bournemouth ticketing team at Vitality Stadium, delivering a high level of customer service over the phone, in person and through written communication. 
  • Processing ticket sales, memberships, ballots and away travel through the ticketing platform 
  • Processing ticketing applications, in a polite, courteous and professional manner 
  • Ensure that inbound emails and phone calls to the ticket office are answered promptly and in a professional manner 
  • Complete call campaigns to assigned base of supporter accounts 
  • Receive, count, track, record and secure all payment methods on behalf of the club 
  • Ensure customer credit/debit card details are secure and PCI compliant 
  • Provide information and a high level of customer service assistance to all supporters 
  • Support the ticketing management team 
  • Provide general administration and postage fulfilment as required by the ticket office staff 
  • Adhere to a strict code of confidentiality in respect of any information relating to AFC Bournemouth 
  • On a matchday, working sales or collections windows to provide an efficient and professional service to all matchday guests 
  • Available to work weekends 
  • Be presentable at all times when working and demonstrate you can represent the face of the club in the manner expected. 
  • As a member of staff to ensure in all matters, you follow and actively promote the club’s mental health policies and practices to ensure an open, non-judgmental and inclusive environment for everyone engaged with the club 
  • As a member of staff to ensure that you adhere to the club’s safeguarding policies and procedures and are committed to our safeguarding values, creating a safe and positive environment for all those who interact with the club.  
  • Obligation to adhere to the club’s health and safety policy and procedures.  
  • As a member of staff to ensure in all matters you follow and actively promote the club’s equality policies and practices to ensure a welcoming, safe and inclusive environment for everyone engaged with the club.  

The duties and responsibilities described are not a comprehensive list and additional tasks may be assigned to the employee from time to time; or the scope of the job may change as necessitated by business demands.
  • Exceptional customer service 
  • Excellent organisation and time management. 
  • Evidence of good verbal and written communication skills. 
  • Ability to work effectively under own initiative and to anticipate and prioritise different workloads. 
  • Ability to communicate concisely, assertively and effectively with external and internal stakeholders, at all levels of the organisation. 
  • Excellent IT skills 
  • Previous experience in a similar role would be preferred.

job.title: Academy Driver (Casual)
job.location: AFC Bournemouth Performance Centre, Wimborne, Wimborne, Dorset
job.html_description:
To transport Academy players to and from all Academy activity, around Bournemouth and nationally.

Academy Values: 
  • Players First: every player valued. Every decision made with care. 
  • Togetherness: working in a prosocial manner as part of a wider team – willing to contribute beyond own interests. 
  • Integrity: carrying out academy and club values in an open and honest manner. 
  • Accountability: willing to take responsibility for actions in a manner which allows learning, growth and reflection. 

  • Transport Academy Players from various pick-up points in the Bournemouth area to and from AFC Bournemouth Performance Centre. Pick up points include but are not limited to: Vitality Stadium, Bournemouth Train Station, Player Accommodation.  
  • Be available to transport Academy players to venues around the country for away fixtures at weekends. 
  • To be available to transport Academy players to other venues as and when needed. 
  • Liaise with the Academy Operations & Player Care teams around weekly schedules and bus registers.  
  • Daily & weekly vehicle checks to be undertaken prior to any journey. Any faults are to be reported in the first instance to the Academy, and maintain the cleanliness of the vehicles. 
  • Provide transport for Academy Players in a safe and lawful manner, fully compliant with the Highway Code and other regulations applying to passenger and minibus transport.  
  • As a casual member of staff to ensure in all matters, you follow and actively promote the club’s mental health policies and practices to ensure an open, non-judgmental and inclusive environment for everyone engaged with the club. 
  • As a casual member of staff to ensure that you to adhere to the club’s safeguarding policies and procedures and are committed to our safeguarding values, creating a safe and positive environment for all those who interact with the club. 
  • Obligation to adhere to the club’s health and safety policy and procedures. 
  • Responsibility to comply with the Health and Safety at Work etc. Act 1974, the Regulatory Reform (Fire Safety) Order 2005, and all related Company policies, taking reasonable care for their own safety and that of others, reporting hazards or incidents, following safe systems of work, and co-operating with all training and emergency procedures.
  • As a casual member of staff to ensure in all matters you follow and actively promote the club’s equality policies and practices to ensure a welcoming, safe and inclusive environment for everyone engaged with the club. 
The duties and responsibilities described are not a comprehensive list and additional tasks may be assigned to the employee from time to time; or the scope of the job may change as necessitated by business demands.
  • Valid UK Driving Licence, including D1 
  • Experience in driving 17-seater minibuses 
  • Experience in driving sports teams or young people (desirable)

job.title: Concourse Bar Staff (Casual)
job.html_description:
We are recruiting staff to serve food, confectionery, hot /cold drinks, etc.
 The shifts are approx. 4 - 6 hours home match day only (usually Saturday ko. 3.00pm.).
Staff will be expected to work at a fast pace as we only have a smalltime frame to serve the supporters.

The stadium is very busy on a match day but there is a good atmosphere within the team and you get to know the supporters.

Experience is a bonus, but not essential as full training given onsite.
  • Duties include using tills, recording information, replenishing stock, ensuring your work area is clean and tidy.
  •  You will also be expected to handle food this can include an element of cooking.
  •  You will be expected to work as part of a team as there are 22 concourse bars and kiosk around the stadium.
  • Customer care is very important to us, so you will be expected to be polite and helpful to all individual customers..
  • As a casual worker you must adhere to the club’s safeguarding policies and procedures and are committed to our safeguarding values, creating a safe and positive environment for all those who interact with the club. 
  • Obligation to adhere to the club’s health and safety policy and procedures. 
  • Actively promote the club’s equality policies and practices to ensure a welcoming, safe and inclusive environment for everyone engaged with the club. 
The duties and responsibilities described are not a comprehensive list and additional tasks may be assigned to the employee from time to time; or the scope of the job may change as necessitated by business demands.

job.title: Women’s Team Operations and Administration Assistant
job.location: AFC Bournemouth Performance Centre, Wimborne, Wimborne, Dorset
job.html_description:
The Women’s Team Operations Assistant will provide administrative and logistical support to the Women’s Team Operations Manager, helping ensure the smooth day-to-day running of AFC Bournemouth Women.  

Working under the guidance and direction of the Women’s Team Operations Manager, the postholder will support the administration of training, fixtures, travel, matchdays, player requirements and the wider Women’s Team programme. The postholder will act as a reliable point of administrative support for players and staff, ensuring operational information is communicated accurately and in a timely manner.  

This is a hands-on administrative role requiring excellent organisation, attention to detail and communication. The successful candidate will work closely with players and staff and will liaise with other departments across the club and external organisations. 

The role requires regular travel with the team to home and away fixtures and will involve evening and weekend working in line with the football calendar.   


Please keep the following dates available (you will be notified if you have been successful for an interview): 
  • Stage 1 interviews will be held on Wednesday 2nd December on MS Teams.  
  • Stage 2 interviews will be held on Tuesday 8th and Thursday 10th December in person.

1. Team Administration 
  • Provide day-to-day administrative support to the Women’s Team Operations Manager. 
  • Maintain accurate team schedules, contact information, operational records and relevant player and staff trackers.  
  • Assist with maintaining the season fixture calendar in collaboration with the Women’s Team Operations Manager and Club Secretary. 
  • Prepare and circulate schedules, itineraries and other relevant operational information to players and staff. 
  • Support the completion and submission of matchday and competition administration to the relevant league and cup authorities.  
  • Act as an administrative point of contact for players, escalating matters to the Women’s Team Operations Manager or relevant member of staff where appropriate.  
  • Support player accommodation and housing administration, including maintaining relevant records and liaising with approved accommodation providers.  
  • Take minutes at operational meetings and support the monitoring and follow-up of agreed actions where required.  
  • Maintain relevant equipment and inventory records and assist with approved orders.  
2. Training and Matchday Coordination 
  • Support the Women’s Team Operations Manager with the administration and coordination of training and matchday requirements, including facilities, schedules and relevant internal and external communications. 
  • Assist with the booking and coordination of pitches, gym, physio and meeting facilities, analysis sessions and other team activities where required.  
  • Support matchday administration, including information relating to opposition and officials, venue requirements, kit logistics, accreditation, medical and media requirements, and player/guest ticketing allocations.   
  • Maintain the squad kit matrix, including sizes, numbers, printing requirements and training/warm-up allocations.  
  • Provide practical operational support at all home and away fixtures.  
3. Travel and Accommodation 
  • Support the Women’s Team Operations Manager with the administration and coordination of team travel and accommodation for fixtures and other team activities. 
  • Liaise with approved transport, hotel and other travel providers as required.  
  • Prepare and circulate detailed travel itineraries, including timings, comfort stops, accommodation details and key contact information.  
  • Coordinate rooming lists, meal requirements and other travel-related administration.  
4. Medical and Performance Administration 
  • Provide administrative support to the Medical and Performance teams across the Women's First Team and Development Squad.                                               
  • Coordinate the administration of player appointments, schedules and other requirements as directed by the relevant Medical or Performance practitioner or Head of Women’s Football.  
  • Assist with the ordering, monitoring and organisation of agreed medical and performance equipment, supplies, technology and external services.  
  • Provide administrative support for medical and performance processes associated with recruitment and signing, working with the relevant practitioners and club leadership. 
 
General Duties  
  • Perform any other duties appropriate to the role as directed by the Women’s Team Operations Manager or Head of Women’s Football. 
  • Work collaboratively and flexibly with colleagues across AFC Bournemouth to meet the requirements of the football calendar, including matchdays, evenings and weekends.  
  • Follow and actively promote the club’s mental health policies and practices to support an open, non-judgmental and inclusive environment. 
  • Adhere to the club’s safeguarding policies and procedures and promote the club’s safeguarding values, creating a safe and positive environment for all those who interact with the club. 
  • Adhere to the club’s health and safety policy and procedures.  
  • Follow and actively promote the club’s equality policies and practices to support a welcoming, safe and inclusive environment. 
  • Responsibility to comply with the Health and Safety at Work etc. Act 1974, the Regulatory Reform (Fire Safety) Order 2005, and all related Company policies, taking reasonable care for their own safety and that of others, reporting hazards or incidents, following safe systems of work, and co-operating with all training and emergency procedures.
The duties and responsibilities described are not a comprehensive list and additional tasks may be assigned to the employee from time to time; or the scope of the job may change as necessitated by business demands.
  • Excellent organisational and administrative skills. 
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to maintain accurate records.  
  • Ability to prioritise effectively and work to deadlines in a fast-paced environment. 
  • Confident using Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Word, Excel and Teams. 
  • Clear and professional written and verbal communication skills. 
  • A proactive and flexible approach to the complex and dynamic requirements of a football programme.  
  • Ability to work as part of a team. 
  • High level of discretion and professionalism with the ability to handle confidential and sensitive information appropriately. 
  • Willingness to travel and work evenings and weekends.  

EXPERIENCE (Desirable) 

  • Previous administrative or operational experience within competitive sport or another fast-paced professional environment.  
  • Previous experience supporting travel, events or logistical arrangements.  

  • Free onsite parking.
  • Season ticket and allocation of complimentary/purchased tickets (subject to eligibility & availability).
  • Subsidised lunches and complimentary healthy snacks throughout the day.
  • Discounts at the club Superstore.
  • Access to Health Cash Plan with Simplyhealth.
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Contribution towards eye tests and glasses.
  • Discounts and benefits from partners and local businesses.
  • Club pension & Life Assurance Scheme.
  • Paid parental leave (bank of five days per year).
  • Club events or other social events throughout the year run by our club social team.
  • Paid volunteer opportunities (2 days per year).
  • Paid day’s leave on your birthday.

job.title: Women's Team & Development Squad Goalkeeper Coach
job.location: AFC Bournemouth Performance Centre, Wimborne, Wimborne, Dorset
job.html_description:
To lead on the technical, tactical, physical and psychological development of AFC Bournemouth Women’s First Team and Development Squad goalkeepers within a high-performance environment. The postholder will design and deliver an elite-standard goalkeeping programme aligned with the club’s playing philosophy, the Head Coach’s game model, and WNL / WSL2 performance expectations. This role is pivotal within the football operations structure, contributing to the club’s strategic goals and on-pitch success.
 
This is a really exciting time to join the Women’s Team.

Women’s Club Values: 
  • Professionalism: Always acting with integrity and respect to the badge in a competent and reliable manner. 
  • Togetherness: Working collaboratively through high levels of communication in a manner that supports an environment where everyone feels included, respected and valued. 
  • Opportunity: Providing fair and equitable chances to all individuals by encouraging a growth mindset through empowering the natural abilities of others in service of the overall mission. 
  • Team First: Prioritising the team beyond personal or individual interests. 
Goalkeeper Development & Coaching 
  • Plan, deliver and review all goalkeeper training sessions for the Women’s First Team and Development Squad. 
  • Design position-specific training that aligns with the Head Coach’s tactical approach and club playing philosophy. 
  • Provide technical, tactical and decision-making development for all senior / development goalkeepers.
  • Deliver individual development plans (IDPs) with measurable outcomes. 
  • Analyse goalkeeper performance in training and matches, providing video, data and feedback. 
  • Support integration and progression of Academy/PGA goalkeepers where appropriate (aligned with WSL talent pathway expectations).
Match Preparation & Performance 
  • Lead goalkeeper-specific pre-match warm-ups and contribute to matchday technical preparation. 
  • Support opposition analysis with a focus on goalkeeper implications (e.g., pressing triggers, set pieces, restarts). 
  • Support the multidisciplinary team (MDT) on matchday, carrying out specific roles allocated by the Head Coach. 
  • Provide input into game plans and debriefs from a goalkeeper perspective.
Performance, Wellbeing & Compliance 
  • Work collaboratively within the MDT, including with sports science staff, medical staff, analysts and performance staff. 
  • Support the Head Coach with player management by demonstrating emotional intelligence and building trusting relationships with players. Lead individual player meetings when required. 
  • Monitor physical and psychological wellbeing of goalkeepers, escalating concerns to medical or performance teams as required. 
  • Ensure all coaching delivery adheres to WSL performance support regulations, safeguarding standards, anti-doping compliance, and clean sport requirements. 
Administration & Reporting 
  • Maintain up-to-date training plans, attendance records and IDP records for reporting to the Head Coach and Head of Women’s Football. 
  • Submit required information for WSL audits, compliance checks and staff documentation. 
  • Support recruitment processes for senior and Academy goalkeepers, including trial identification and feedback. 
  • Contribute to, and when required lead, analysis sessions and meetings, ensuring presentation software and skills are of a high standard.
General
  • As a member of staff to ensure in all matters, you follow and actively promote the club’s mental health policies and practices to ensure an open, non-judgmental and inclusive environment for everyone engaged with the club.
  • As a member of staff to ensure that you to adhere to the club’s safeguarding policies and procedures and are committed to our safeguarding values, creating a safe and positive environment for all those who interact with the club.
  • Obligation to adhere to the club’s health and safety policy and procedures.
  • Responsibility to comply with the Health and Safety at Work etc. Act 1974, the Regulatory Reform (Fire Safety) Order 2005, and all related Company policies, taking reasonable care for their own safety and that of others, reporting hazards or incidents, following safe systems of work, and co-operating with all training and emergency procedures.
  • As a member of staff to ensure in all matters you follow and actively promote the club’s equality policies and practices to ensure a welcoming, safe and inclusive environment for everyone engaged with the club.
The duties and responsibilities described are not a comprehensive list and additional tasks may be assigned to the employee from time to time; or the scope of the job may change as necessitated by business demands.
  • FA Level 2 in Coaching Goalkeepers or equivalent. 
  • UK Anti-Doping Introduction to Clean Sport certificate. 
  • Safeguarding and DBS clearance. 
  • Proven experience in a senior or assistant coaching role within women’s football. 
  • Strong tactical understanding and ability to communicate effectively with players and staff. 
  • Excellent leadership, interpersonal, and organisational skills. 
  • Commitment to AFC Bournemouth’s values, culture, and long-term vision. 
  • Familiarity with modern performance analysis tools and techniques. 
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a high-pressure, fast-paced environment. 
  • Strong media and public speaking skills.
  • Free onsite parking.
  • Season ticket and allocation of complimentary/purchased tickets (subject to eligibility & availability).
  • Subsidised lunches and complimentary healthy snacks throughout the day.
  • Discounts at the club Superstore.
  • Access to Health Cash Plan with Simplyhealth.
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Contribution towards eye tests and glasses.
  • Discounts and benefits from partners and local businesses.
  • Club pension & Life Assurance Scheme.
  • Paid parental leave (bank of five days per year).
  • Club events or other social events throughout the year run by our club social team.
  • Paid volunteer opportunities (2 days per year).
  • Paid day’s leave on your birthday.

job.title: Superstore Sales Advisor
job.html_description:
The retail team have an exciting opportunity within its retail and superstore team.  You will help our customer’s/supporters find the right products to enhance their enjoyment of supporting AFC Bournemouth through the provision of exceptional customer service. 
To personally provide excellent standards of customer service by: 
  • Displaying good listening skills to identify customer needs and meeting those needs with the right product advice. 
  • Provide relevant and comprehensive key product information to customers. 
  • Demonstrating appropriate body language - friendly, open, helpful and approachable. 
  • Confidently engaging with customers and closing sales. 
  • Looking for link selling and till add on opportunities which will increase spend per head. 
  • Understanding the importance of product presentation and general store/ retail area standards.  
  • Confident in solving customer problems quickly and effectively. 
  • Maintaining good working relationships with ‘internal stakeholders’ such as; Commercial team, Ticketing team, Accounts team, Operations Director, Chief Executive and Chairman. 
  • Providing our customers with the right products and experience so that every customer leaves inspired to enjoy supporting AFC Bournemouth. 
  • Replenish stock and maintain high standards of merchandising by ensuring that products are attractively displayed, correctly barcoded and priced with relevant Point of Sale (POS) applied. 
  • Conduct till point operations in line with guidelines. 
  • Conduct shirt printing where applicable (following training). 
  • Understanding and operation of the Touch Office EPOS system. 
  • Conduct Stock Checks as requested. 
  • Maintain vigilance in store and awareness of security issues including for example, fraudulent bank notes, credit cards, theft and suspicious behaviour; escalate security concerns to management as and when required.  
  • Demonstrating commitment to the team, supporting and helping other colleagues with tasks. 
  • Displaying a genuine and positive attitude to help team and Superstore achieve its objectives. 
  • Getting behind Retail initiatives. 
  • Carrying out additional duties as when required. 
  • Commitment to undertaking identified training requirements and putting into place learnings. 
  • Ability and willingness to acquire job related skills and knowledge through self-development and by learning from others. 
  • As a member of staff to ensure in all matters, you follow and actively promote the club’s mental health policies and practices to ensure an open, non-judgmental and inclusive environment for everyone engaged with the club. 
  • As a member of staff to ensure that you to adhere to the club’s safeguarding policies and procedures and are committed to our safeguarding values, creating a safe and positive environment for all those who interact with the club. 
  • Obligation to adhere to the club’s health and safety policy and procedures. 
  • Responsibility to comply with the Health and Safety at Work etc. Act 1974, the Regulatory Reform (Fire Safety) Order 2005, and all related Company policies, taking reasonable care for their own safety and that of others, reporting hazards or incidents, following safe systems of work, and co-operating with all training and emergency procedures.
  • As a member of staff to ensure in all matters you follow and actively promote the club’s equality policies and practices to ensure a welcoming, safe and inclusive environment for everyone engaged with the club. 
The duties and responsibilities described are not a comprehensive list and additional tasks may be assigned to the employee from time to time; or the scope of the job may change as necessitated by business demands.
  • Enjoy helping others 
  • Comfortable working in a fast paced and busy environment  
  • Experience in customer service or sales 
  • Experience in retail (not essential) 
  • Good verbal and written communication 
  • Punctual and effective time keeping 

  • Free onsite parking.
  • Season ticket and allocation of complimentary/purchased tickets (subject to eligibility & availability).
  • Subsidised lunches and complimentary healthy snacks throughout the day.
  • Discounts at the club Superstore.
  • Access to Health Cash Plan with Simplyhealth.
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Contribution towards eye tests and glasses.
  • Discounts and benefits from partners and local businesses.
  • Club pension & Life Assurance Scheme.
  • Paid parental leave (bank of five days per year).
  • Club events or other social events throughout the year run by our club social team.
  • Paid volunteer opportunities (2 days per year).
  • Paid day’s leave on your birthday.

job.title: Mechanical Maintenance Technician
job.html_description:
Based across Manchester City sites, this role will deliver high-quality mechanical maintenance services that support the safe and reliable operation of our facilities and the experience of our employees, supporters and customers.

 

Who We Are

 

Manchester City is an English Premier League club whose roots began in East Manchester. From its first incarnation as St Mark’s West Gorton in 1880, the club became Manchester City FC in 1894. Behind each title lies emotion, moments and memories that resonate with millions of supporters around the world. Manchester City fans are known for their commitment and togetherness, as a Club that fights to the end.

 

MCFC is built on a vision for sustainability, from an academy structure designed to support long-term first team success to engagement with the communities in which we reside. Together with our passionate fans and valued network of partners, we are developing Manchester City’s future history. You will be responsible for the delivery of mechanical and HVAC maintenance services and processes that support the operation of all sites, setting and ensuring the highest standards of safety and maintenance for MCFC’s employees and customers.

 

The Role

 

You will deliver high-quality maintenance services at all MCFC sites to the highest standard, in line with MCFC policies, legislation, environmental requirements, certifying authorities’ requirements and best practice. You will ensure all Health and Safety requirements for each task are in line with Health and Safety legislation, best practice and MCFC Health and Safety policy.

 

You will manage allocated maintenance tasks from start to completion, including scoping the task, pricing and ordering materials, liaising with the customer, and undertaking the work personally or coordinating and supervising others to ensure timely completion.

 

You will monitor the results of the facilities maintenance service and suggest and deliver improvements. Working with the Maintenance Managers, you will support Planned Preventive Maintenance and lifecycle schedules for all buildings, ensuring tasks are undertaken and inspected and that schedules are reviewed and improved.

 

What You’ll Bring

  • Experience working in a mechanical or multi-skilled role.
  • A recognised mechanical qualification such as a NVQ Level 3 or equivalent.
  • Relevant industry experience ideally within a stadium or commercially operational environment.
  • Knowledge of Health and Safety legislation and processes.
  • The ability to diagnose faults and test, repair and maintain mechanical and electrical equipment.
  • Knowledge of BMS (Building Management Systems
  • Experience of daily preventative maintenance activities and routine safety inspections.
  • Experience of fault finding and diagnostics in reactive breakdown or planned situations.

 

Why Choose Us

As part of our team, you will be entitled to 26 days’ annual leave plus an additional day off for your birthday, private healthcare and dental cover, an annual discretionary bonus, plus a range of partnership and lifestyle discounts.

 

Working at Manchester City means being part of a team connected by a shared commitment to excellence, togetherness and creating memorable experiences for our employees, supporters and customers.

 

You will have the opportunity to work across a range of high-profile sporting and operational facilities, contributing directly to their safe, reliable and effective operation.

 

How to Apply

 

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by 30 November. Further details about the recruitment process will be shared with shortlisted candidates.

 

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

 

Equal Opportunities

 

Manchester City promotes equal opportunities in employment and positively welcomes applications from all candidates regardless of age, disability, gender identity or expression, marital status, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation or any other protected characteristic.

 

We will screen all applicants and select candidates whose skills and experience meet our needs. We will carefully consider your application during the recruitment process and encourage you to let us know if you need any adjustments. Please contact Hiring@cityfootball.com if you require support.

 

All recruitment communications originate from @cityfootball.com email addresses. If you receive communications from Gmail, Outlook.com or other personal email addresses claiming to represent Manchester City, please treat them as fraudulent.

 

 

Due to our safeguarding promise, all UK-based roles will be subject to an appropriate DBS check upon commencing employment with us. This will be either a basic, standard or enhanced check depending on the role.

job.title: Casual Groundsperson
job.html_description:
Based in Manchester, this casual role is an opportunity to help prepare and maintain the Etihad Stadium and Joie Stadium pitches on matchdays. Working alongside our experienced grounds team, you will help ensure the playing surfaces and equipment are ready before, during and after fixtures. The role requires flexibility to work evenings, weekends and bank holidays in line with the match schedule.

 

Who We Are

 

Manchester City is a football club rooted in East Manchester, with a story that began in 1880 and continues to grow today. Built on resilience, belief and togetherness, success on the pitch is driven by the moments and memories shared with millions of Fans around the world. City is known for its bravery, its determination to the very end and its strong connection to where we come from. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are creating the next chapter, the City way.

 

Our Matchday Grounds Team helps create the playing environment at the Etihad Stadium and Joie Stadium. Through careful preparation, responsive pitch care and close teamwork, the team supports the safe and effective delivery of every fixture.

 

The Role

 

You will support the preparation, repair and maintenance of both stadium pitches, helping to present high-quality playing surfaces throughout the matchday. Your contribution will cover the period before kick-off, during the game and after the final whistle.

 

Before fixtures, you will help prepare the pitches and set up goals, catch nets and corner flags. During warm-ups, at half-time and after matches, you will carry out divoting and pitch repairs. Post-match work may include pedestrian mowing with rotary and cylinder mowers, as well as positioning grow lights when required.

 

Working closely with the wider grounds team, you will also clean, maintain and store machinery and equipment after use. You will follow Health and Safety procedures, respond to instructions and help matchday operations run safely and efficiently.

 

What You’ll Bring

 

⚽ A practical approach and willingness to work outdoors in all weather conditions.

⚽ Ability to work collaboratively as part of a team.

⚽ Flexibility to work evenings, weekends and bank holidays in line with matchday requirements.

⚽ Clear and effective communication skills, with the ability to follow instructions.

⚽ A reliable and punctual approach, with care for the quality of your work.

⚽ Comfortable working efficiently in an active matchday environment.

 

How to Apply

 

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by 29 November 2026. We encourage you to apply as soon as you can.

 

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

 

Equal Opportunities

 

City Football Group promotes equal opportunities in employment and we positively welcome applications from all candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation.

 

We will screen all applicants and select candidates whose skills and experience seem to meet our needs. We will carefully consider your application during the initial screening and will contact you only if you are selected for an interview. If you require reasonable adjustments or any support throughout the process, please contact hiring@cityfootball.com and we will be happy to help.

 

All CFG recruitment communications originate from @cityfootball.com email addresses. If you receive communications from Gmail, Outlook.com or other personal email services claiming to represent CFG, please verify with the hiring team. Employment is subject to the provision of proof of eligibility to work in the UK.

 

Due to our safeguarding promise, all UK-based CFG roles will be subject to a DBS check upon commencing employment with us. This will be either a basic, standard or enhanced check depending on the job role and responsibilities.

job.title: Community Coach - Employability
job.html_description:
Community Coach – Employability (Part Time)

This Community Coach – Employability role is an opportunity to help young people across Greater Manchester build confidence, develop essential skills and take positive steps towards their future. Working closely with participants, colleagues and community partners, you will deliver engaging employability programmes that support young people into education, employment and training.

 

Who We Are

Established in 1986, City in the Community is Manchester City’s official charity. We support people across Manchester by empowering healthier lives through football. Our programmes place physical and mental wellbeing at their core, whilst also creating healthy futures and healthy communities.

Within our Education team, we support young people to develop the skills, confidence and experience needed to progress into positive futures. Through our Youth Hub, City Careers and volunteering programmes, we work alongside employers, education providers and community partners to help young people overcome barriers and access meaningful opportunities in education, employment and training.

 

The Role

This is a part time role working 22.5 hours across three days per week. You will support the planning and delivery of City in the Community's employability programmes for young people aged 16–25, including the Youth Hub, City Careers and volunteering, helping participants build confidence, resilience and essential skills for their future.

Day to day, you will deliver engaging employability, football and sport sessions, mentor participants and support their progression into education, employment or training. You will also work closely with employers, the DWP, referral agencies and community partners to support participant recruitment, work experience opportunities and positive outcomes.

Alongside programme delivery, you will monitor participant progress, maintain accurate records and contribute to programme reporting against agreed KPIs. You will also support wider CITC 16+ programmes where required, while ensuring safeguarding and organisational policies are embedded across all activities.

 

What You'll Bring

⚽ Experience planning and delivering employability or life skills programmes for young people aged 16–25.

⚽ A minimum Level 2 Coaching Certificate in any sport or relevant activity.

⚽ Strong knowledge of the local employability landscape, including barriers faced by young people not in education, employment or training (NEET).

⚽ Experience supporting young people facing complex barriers, with an understanding of safeguarding and behaviour management.

⚽ Experience building relationships with employers, schools, colleges and community partners.

⚽ Excellent communication and Microsoft Office skills, with a resilient and adaptable approach. Experience supporting young people with additional needs would be an advantage.

⚽ A full UK driving licence.

 

Why Choose Us

Guided by our values of being caring, inclusive, transformative and youth-led, we are committed to creating an environment where our team feel supported, valued and able to make a meaningful difference through the work they do every day.

As part of our team, you will receive 26 days’ annual leave plus a day off for your birthday and an annual discretionary bonus. You will also have access to a Health Cash Plan, Employee Assistance Programme with 24/7 GP support, and a company pension and life assurance.

You can enjoy a range of additional benefits, including discounted match tickets, savings in the City Store, a free City+ subscription, stadium tour discounts, and wider retail and lifestyle offers.

 

How to Apply

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by 1st December 2026.

 

Equal Opportunities

City Football Group is committed to achieving workforce diversity and we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, national origin, race, age, sex, gender identity, disability - physical or hidden, sexual orientation, veteran status, religious belief, or any other characteristics protected by law. We strive to provide a fully inclusive and accessible recruitment process. We encourage all applicants to reach out if they require any support or accommodation to enable them to thrive throughout our recruitment process. Please contact citcjobs@cityfootball.com.

Due to our safeguarding promise, all UK based CFG roles will be subject to a DBS check upon commencing employment with us. This will be either a basic, standard or enhanced check depending on the job role and responsibilities.
