job.title: Service Excellence Lead
job.html_description:
Based in Manchester, this 12-month fixed-term role is an exciting opportunity to help shape how Service Excellence comes to life across Manchester City and Medlock Square. You’ll take our service ambition and turn it into everyday experiences that feel consistent, inclusive and genuinely exceptional for every fan, visitor and colleague.

 

Working across Manchester City and Medlock Square, you’ll bring together standards, insight, coaching and continuous improvement to help teams deliver their best at every touchpoint. From face-to-face interactions and matchday experiences to calls, emails and digital channels, you’ll help make Service Excellence part of how we work every day and help set the standard for what best-in-class service looks like across the campus.

 

Who We Are

 

Manchester City is a football club rooted in East Manchester, with a story that began in 1880 and continues to grow today. Built on resilience, belief and togetherness, success on the pitch is driven by the moments and memories shared with millions of Fans around the world. City is known for its bravery, its determination to the very end and its strong connection to where we come from. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are creating the next chapter, the City way.

 

Our Service Support team works across visitor-facing operations to help make every interaction clear, welcoming and consistent. Working with operational teams and People Services, this role will support the practical adoption of Service Excellence as the programme develops across Medlock Square and Manchester City.

 

The Role

 

You will lead the operational follow-through that helps Service Excellence become part of how teams work every day. Partnering with People Services and operational leaders, you will translate the framework and training into clear, relevant standards for different teams, channels and settings, while supporting managers to embed expectations through coaching and practical tools.

 

You will build and coordinate a quality-assurance approach across service interactions, using appropriate sampling, observation, review and calibration. By bringing together customer feedback, complaints, service data and operational evidence, you will help teams understand what is working, identify recurring issues and turn insight into useful development and improvement activity.

 

The programme will grow in phases, beginning with Medlock Square and extending into Manchester City operations. You will work through service managers and a broad range of colleagues to support consistent, accessible experiences, strengthen capability and improve service processes. The role will help connect quality, customer experience and operational performance, while keeping thoughtful, inclusive service at the centre.

 

What You’ll Bring

 

  • Degree-level qualification or equivalent professional expertise in customer experience, service operations, quality, learning or continuous improvement.
  • Experience in customer service, service operations, visitor services, hospitality, sport, entertainment or another complex public-facing environment.
  • Proven experience designing, delivering or embedding training and development programmes, including the ability to translate service standards or frameworks into practical learning for different teams and audiences.
  • Experience designing or improving service standards, quality assurance, coaching, customer insight or operational performance approaches.
  • Ability to interpret service data, customer feedback and operational evidence and turn findings into practical action.
  • Clear communication, facilitation and influencing skills, including the ability to deliver engaging training, coach colleagues and advise or constructively challenge operational leaders.
  • Knowledge of inclusive customer service and how to apply accessibility principles in service standards, training and experiences.

 

Why Choose Us

 

Working at Manchester City means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.

 

As part of our team, you will receive 26 days’ annual leave plus a day off for your birthday, private healthcare and dental cover, and an annual discretionary bonus. You will also have access to a Health Cash Plan, Employee Assistance Programme with 24/7 GP support, and a company pension and life assurance.

 

Manchester-based employees also benefit from free on-site parking, complimentary breakfast and lunch, and access to a range of sports and leisure clubs.

 

You can enjoy a range of additional benefits, including cycle to work, Give As You Earn, discounted match tickets, savings in the City Store, a free City+ subscription, stadium tour discounts, and wider retail and lifestyle offers.

 

How to Apply

 

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by 30 November 2026. We encourage you to apply as soon as you can.

 

Our interview process begins with an application review by our Talent Acquisition team, followed by a first-stage interview, usually via Microsoft Teams, to meet the team and explore the opportunity. Next is a face-to-face interview with a task-based assessment to showcase your skills. If required, a final stage may offer the chance to meet wider teams, explore our facilities and experience life at CFG!

 

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

 

Equal Opportunities

 

City Football Group promotes equal opportunities in employment and we positively welcome applications from all candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation.

 

We will screen all applicants and select candidates whose skills and experience seem to meet our needs. We will carefully consider your application during the initial screening and will contact you only if you are selected for an interview. If you require reasonable adjustments or any support throughout the process, please contact hiring@cityfootball.com and we will be happy to help.

 

All CFG recruitment communications originate from @cityfootball.com email addresses. If you receive communications from Gmail, Outlook.com or other personal email services claiming to represent CFG, please verify with the hiring team. Employment is subject to the provision of proof of eligibility to work in the UK.

 

Due to our safeguarding promise, all UK-based CFG roles will be subject to a DBS check upon commencing employment with us. This will be either a basic, standard or enhanced check depending on the job role and responsibilities.

job.title: Senior Partnership Sales Manager APAC
job.html_description:
Based in Singapore, this role will help City Football Group grow its commercial partnerships across the APAC and MENA regions. You will identify and secure regional and global partners, build trusted relationships with senior decision-makers, and bring compelling partnership opportunities to life across CFG's football properties and commercial platform.

 

Who We Are

 

Founded in 2013, City Football Group is the world's leading private owner and operator of football clubs, with teams across the globe connected by a shared belief in doing things differently. Alongside our clubs, we invest in football-related businesses and build partnerships that help the game, and the communities around it, thrive. Everything we do is guided by our purpose: empowering better lives through football. Rooted in more than a century of "City" football, we are proud of the role our clubs play locally and globally, creating positive impact on and off the pitch.

 

Within our Partnership Sales team, we connect brands with City Football Group's global football platform through thoughtful, commercially relevant partnerships. Working across markets and functions, the team helps partners achieve their objectives while creating meaningful value for CFG, its clubs and Fans around the world.

 

The Role

 

As Senior Partnership Sales Manager, you will lead the acquisition of new regional and global partners across APAC and MENA, contributing directly to revenue growth for City Football Group. You will own a consistent pipeline of opportunities, forecast deal activity across upcoming seasons and work towards agreed sales targets with a clear focus on quality and long-term value.

 

You will guide opportunities from prospecting through to close, including partner meetings, commercial proposals, contract negotiations and due diligence. You will present CFG's story and commercial platform with clarity, working with design, planning and creative colleagues to develop proposals that are relevant, compelling and aligned to each prospective partner.

 

Success in this role will depend on how well you build trust across the business and with external stakeholders. You will collaborate with the Head of Partnership Sales, the wider Partnership functions and CFG's global sales network, using CRM information and consistent reporting to support sound commercial decisions and effective delivery across the region. Travel within APAC and MENA will be required to meet prospective partners as needed.

 

What You’ll Bring

 

⚽ A bachelor's degree or higher, or equivalent commercial experience, with a track record of representing premium rights holders or comparable commercial properties to deliver material revenue growth year-on-year.

⚽ Proven ability to prospect for new business, maintain a healthy sales pipeline and deliver against agreed commercial targets.

⚽ Experience leading senior-level partnership or sponsorship negotiations, including the commercial, product, legal and due diligence aspects of a deal.

⚽ Familiarity with the APAC and MENA market landscapes, cultures and business practices, with the flexibility to work across multiple markets.

⚽ Fluent written and spoken English (speaking and writing) is required, proficiency in an Asian language, including Mandarin, Korean, Japanese, would be an advantage.

⚽ Flexible and comfortable in a fast-paced working environment and hours, with a willingness to travel.

⚽ Comfortable using CRM tools and structured reporting, with a collaborative approach to stakeholder management and cross-functional delivery.

 

Why Choose Us

 

Working at City Football Group means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.

 

How to Apply

 

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by 30 November 2026. We encourage you to apply as soon as you can.

 

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

 

Equal Opportunities

 

City Football Group promotes equal opportunities in employment and we positively welcome applications from all candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation.

 

We will screen all applicants and select candidates whose skills and experience seem to meet our needs. We will carefully consider your application during the initial screening and will contact you only if you are selected for an interview. If you require reasonable adjustments or any support throughout the process, please contact hiring@cityfootball.com and we will be happy to help.

 

All CFG recruitment communications originate from @cityfootball.com email addresses. If you receive communications from Gmail, Outlook.com or other personal email services claiming to represent CFG, please verify with the hiring team. Employment is subject to the provision of proof of eligibility to work in Singapore.

job.title: Partnership Sales Manager, China
job.html_description:
Based in Shenzhen, China, this role will help City Football Group grow sponsorship revenue by developing commercial opportunities with leading Chinese brands. You will combine market insight and creative thinking with proactive business development, engaging prospective partners directly or through CFG colleagues and agency contacts. Working across Manchester City and wider CFG assets, you will help turn partner objectives into compelling proposals, client conversations and successful partnerships.

 

 

Who We Are

 

 

Founded in 2013, City Football Group is the world’s leading private owner and operator of football clubs, with teams across the globe connected by a shared belief in doing things differently. Alongside our clubs, we invest in football-related businesses and build partnerships that help the game, and the communities around it, thrive. Everything we do is guided by our purpose: empowering better lives through football. Rooted in more than a century of “City” football, we are proud of the role our clubs play locally and globally, creating positive impact on and off the pitch.

 

Within our Partnerships team, we bring together market insight, creativity and commercial expertise to build relationships that create value for partners, our clubs and Fans. The China partnership sales team works closely with colleagues across CFG to identify opportunities, shape relevant propositions and support high-quality engagement with prospective partners.

 

 

The Role

 

You will build and maintain a well-informed pipeline of prospective partners by researching Chinese industries, brands, consumer trends and investment themes. You will identify and qualify prospects, understand their business priorities and map relevant decision-makers, using market and category intelligence to focus effort on the strongest opportunities.

 

You will help open doors and create momentum with prospective clients. This includes initiating and coordinating outreach, securing introductions and meetings, building relationships with brand and agency contacts, following up consistently and keeping opportunities moving. You may lead these conversations yourself or work alongside senior CFG colleagues and agency partners, depending on the opportunity.

 

You will contribute throughout the sales process, from first discussion through proposal, presentation and follow-up. You will listen for client objectives, shape relevant partnership propositions, present CFG rights and activation ideas, respond to questions and support commercial discussions and negotiations. You will work with colleagues across Partnerships to progress qualified opportunities towards signed agreements and sponsorship revenue.

 

Working from prospect objectives, you will create tailored proposals, pitch decks, rights packages and activation platforms. You will adapt global CFG materials for the China market, combining cultural relevance, language quality and commercial accuracy, and develop ideas for content, fan engagement, events and partner campaigns.

 

You will maintain accurate CRM records and support pipeline reporting, meeting preparation and wider sales activity so the team can track prospect engagement, next steps and opportunity progress. You will collaborate with the global Business Intelligence team and colleagues across Partnerships. Responsible use of approved AI and productivity tools will help improve research, analysis and creative development, with human judgement and careful review guiding every output.

 

What You’ll Bring

 

  • Experience in partnership sales, sponsorship, business development or another client-facing commercial role. Sports marketing, agency, consulting, market research or proposal experience is also valuable.
  • Evidence of identifying prospects, initiating or supporting client outreach, developing relationships and helping progress commercial opportunities towards revenue.
  • Ability to research Chinese markets, brands and commercial trends, analyse information and turn useful insights into clear sales opportunities and recommendations.
  • Experience creating client proposals, presentations or sales materials that connect business objectives with relevant partnership ideas.
  • Clear and effective written and verbal communication skills in Mandarin and English, with the confidence to engage clients and coordinate stakeholders.
  • Comfortable using CRM and collaboration tools. 

 

Why Choose Us

 

 

Working at City Football Group means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.

 

 

How to Apply

 

 

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by 6 December 2026. We encourage you to apply as soon as you can.

 

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

 

 

Equal Opportunities

 

 

City Football Group promotes equal opportunities in employment and we positively welcome applications from all candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation.

 

We will screen all applicants and select candidates whose skills and experience seem to meet our needs. We will carefully consider your application during the initial screening and will contact you only if you are selected for an interview. If you require reasonable adjustments or any support throughout the process, please contact hiring@cityfootball.com and we will be happy to help.

 

All CFG recruitment communications originate from @cityfootball.com email addresses. If you receive communications from Gmail, Outlook.com or other personal email services claiming to represent CFG, please verify with the hiring team.

job.title: Apprentice Groundsperson
job.html_description:
Based on-site at City Football Group’s Manchester HQ and across the Etihad Campus, this two-year, full-time fixed-term apprenticeship offers the opportunity to learn how world-class playing surfaces and surrounding areas are prepared and maintained. Working 37.5 hours per week, with 20% of your time allocated to training, you will complete the Level 2 Sports Turf Operative Standard while building practical skills alongside an experienced grounds team. Shift patterns vary and include early mornings and some weekend working.

 

For more information on the available apprenticeship, please see Sports turf operative / Skills England.

 

Who We Are

 

Founded in 2013, City Football Group is the world’s leading private owner and operator of football clubs, with teams across the globe connected by a shared belief in doing things differently. Alongside our clubs, we invest in football-related businesses and build partnerships that help the game, and the communities around it, thrive. Everything we do is guided by our purpose: empowering better lives through football. Rooted in more than a century of “City” football, we are proud of the role our clubs play locally and globally, creating positive impact on and off the pitch.

 

Our Grounds team helps ensure that playing surfaces used for training and competitive fixtures are prepared safely and to an elite standard, while caring for the wider stadium and training-pitch environment. The team combines practical turf expertise, specialist equipment and close collaboration so that football activity can take place as planned across the Etihad Campus.

 

The Role

 

You will learn alongside experienced grounds staff, supporting the day-to-day maintenance and preparation of pitches and surrounding areas across the Etihad Campus. Your work will contribute to safe, reliable playing surfaces for training and fixtures, while helping maintain a professional environment for colleagues, players and visitors.

 

Through workplace learning and structured training, you will develop practical skills in mowing, aeration, irrigation and product application. You will also learn how to operate and care for specialist grounds-maintenance equipment and apply health and safety standards in a professional sporting environment.

 

This apprenticeship is designed to support your development into a qualified grounds person. You will work towards the Level 2 Sports Turf Operative Standard over two years, with the potential to progress into a permanent Assistant Grounds Person role following successful completion of the apprenticeship.

 

What You’ll Bring

 

⚽ A genuine interest in grounds maintenance and landscaping, with enthusiasm for learning practical sports-turf skills.

⚽ Willingness to work outdoors in all weather conditions.

⚽ Ability to work collaboratively as part of a small team and communicate clearly with colleagues.

⚽ Ability to understand and follow instructions, including safe working practices connected with the role.

⚽ Comfortable working variable shifts, including early mornings and some weekends.

⚽ Ability to work at Level 1 Functional Skills in maths and English, as required to undertake the apprenticeship.

 

Why Choose Us

 

Working at City Football Group means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.

 

As part of our team, you will receive 26 days’ annual leave plus a day off for your birthday, private healthcare and dental cover, and an annual discretionary bonus. You will also have access to a Health Cash Plan, Employee Assistance Programme with 24/7 GP support, and a company pension and life assurance.

 

Manchester-based employees also benefit from free on-site parking, complimentary breakfast and lunch, and access to a range of sports and leisure clubs.

 

You can enjoy a range of additional benefits, including cycle to work, Give As You Earn, discounted match tickets, savings in the City Store, a free City+ subscription, stadium tour discounts, and wider retail and lifestyle offers.

 

How to Apply

 

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by 6 December 2026. We encourage you to apply as soon as you can.

 

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

 

Equal Opportunities

 

City Football Group promotes equal opportunities in employment and we positively welcome applications from all candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation.

 

We will screen all applicants and select candidates whose skills and experience seem to meet our needs. We will carefully consider your application during the initial screening and will contact you only if you are selected for an interview. If you require reasonable adjustments or any support throughout the process, please contact hiring@cityfootball.com and we will be happy to help.

 

All CFG recruitment communications originate from @cityfootball.com email addresses. If you receive communications from Gmail, Outlook.com or other personal email services claiming to represent CFG, please verify with the hiring team. Employment is subject to the provision of proof of eligibility to work in the UK.

 

Due to our safeguarding promise, all UK-based CFG roles will be subject to a DBS check upon commencing employment with us. This will be either a basic, standard or enhanced check depending on the job role and responsibilities.

job.title: Service Support Apprentice
job.html_description:
Based at Manchester HQ, this 18-month, full-time fixed-term apprenticeship provides an opportunity to start a career in customer service while working towards the Level 3 Customer Service Specialist apprenticeship standard. You will work 37.5 hours per week - including protected time for apprenticeship training and study. As part of this apprenticeship, you will play a key role in delivering exceptional support to Manchester City supporters and visitors across a range of sales and service channels.  

 

Month one will focus on onboarding and familiarisation, followed by two seven-month placements: one in Visitor Services (face-to-face customer service) and one in the Service Delivery team (contact centre experience).  

 

Practical experience will be combined with protected, paid time for apprenticeship training in line with the agreed training plan. 

 

For more information on the apprenticeship please see Customer service specialist / Skills England.

 

Who We Are  

 

Manchester City is a football club rooted in East Manchester, with a story that began in 1880 and continues to grow today. Built on resilience, belief and togetherness, success on the pitch is driven by the moments and memories shared with millions of Fans around the world. City is known for its bravery, its determination to the very end and its strong connection to where we come from. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are creating the next chapter, the City way.  

 

The Service & Accessibility department supports Manchester City's sales, service and visitor operations, helping supporters, visitors and guests access information, products and services across a range of channels. The team works across contact centre and visitor-facing environments, supporting matchdays, stadium events and everyday campus operations. 

 

The Role  

 

As a Service Support Apprentice, you will develop your customer service skills across two seven-month placements in Visitor Services and Service Delivery.  

Your first month will focus on onboarding, including an introduction to our teams, systems, customer service standards and safe ways of working. You will have an accountable manager for the apprenticeship, support from a supervisor during each placement and a planned handover between placements. 

 

During your Visitor Services placement, you will provide welcoming frontline support at visitor service points across the Etihad Campus, including Medlock Square and designated matchday and major stadium event activities. You will assist with wayfinding, provide accurate venue and event information, resolve routine queries and help visitors access the services they need. You will learn to provide inclusive, accessible service, record feedback and escalate concerns appropriately. 

 

During your Service placement, you will respond to enquiries through agreed phone and digital channels, support sales, bookings, fulfilment and administration, and maintain accurate customer records. With guidance, you will take ownership of enquiries and follow-up actions, develop your ability to handle more complex queries and complaints, and identify opportunities to improve service. You will protect confidential information and promptly refer safeguarding, safety and other concerns to the appropriate team. 

 

Alongside both placements, you will work towards the Level 3 Customer Service Specialist apprenticeship with Manchester City's approved learning provider. Dedicated training, supervision and regular progress reviews will support your development and help you work towards agreed service targets. Any opportunity to progress into a permanent role in Service or Visitor Services teams will depend on available vacancies and the relevant recruitment process. 

 

What You’ll Bring  

 

⚽ Eligibility to undertake an apprenticeship in England, including being aged 16 or over, having the right to live and work in England, and not being in full-time education when the programme begins. 

⚽ Ability to work at Level 1 in Functional Skills English and maths, which will be assessed during the recruitment process. 

⚽ Commitment to learning new skills, completing the apprenticeship programme and taking an active role in personal development. 

⚽ Comfortable following instructions, applying agreed processes and quality checks, and working towards service targets with support. 

⚽ Customer-facing experience is desirable and may come from paid work, volunteering or work experience. 

⚽ Ability to embrace change. 

⚽ Ability to communicate effectively with people at all levels. 

⚽ A customer-focused approach and a willingness to develop your customer sales and service skills. 

⚽ Good organisational skills and the ability to manage priorities and ask for support when needed. 

 

Why Choose Us 

 

Working at Manchester City means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.  

 

As part of our team, you will receive 26 days’ annual leave plus a day off for your birthday, private healthcare and dental cover, and an annual discretionary bonus. You will also have access to a Health Cash Plan, Employee Assistance Programme with 24/7 GP support, and a company pension and life assurance. 

 

Manchester-based employees also benefit from free on-site parking, complimentary breakfast and lunch, and access to a range of sports and leisure clubs.  

 

You can enjoy a range of additional benefits, including cycle to work, Give As You Earn, discounted match tickets, savings in the City Store, a free City+ subscription, stadium tour discounts, and wider retail and lifestyle offers.  

 

How to Apply  

 

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by 6 December 2026. We encourage you to apply as soon as you can.  

 

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.  

 

Equal Opportunities  

 

City Football Group promotes equal opportunities in employment and we positively welcome applications from all candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation.  

 

We will screen all applicants and select candidates whose skills and experience seem to meet our needs. We will carefully consider your application during the initial screening and will contact you only if you are selected for an interview. If you require reasonable adjustments or any support throughout the process, please contact hiring@cityfootball.com and we will be happy to help.  

 

All CFG recruitment communications originate from @cityfootball.com email addresses. If you receive communications from Gmail, Outlook.com or other personal email services claiming to represent CFG, please verify with the hiring team. Employment is subject to the provision of proof of eligibility to work in the UK.  

Due to our safeguarding promise, all UK-based CFG roles will be subject to a DBS check upon commencing employment with us. This will be either a basic, standard or enhanced check depending on the job role and responsibilities.

job.title: Community Mentoring Lead Coach - Targeted Interventions
job.html_description:
Community Mentoring Lead Coach – Targeted Interventions

This Community Mentoring Lead Coach – Targeted Interventions role is an opportunity to make a meaningful difference to vulnerable young people across Manchester. Working closely with participants, delivery coaches and external partners, you will lead high-quality targeted mentoring provision that supports young people to overcome challenges, build positive relationships and make progress towards their goals.

 

Who We Are

Established in 1986, City in the Community is Manchester City’s official charity. We support people across Manchester by empowering healthier lives through football. Our programmes place physical and mental wellbeing at their core, whilst also creating healthy futures and healthy communities.

Within our Targeted Interventions team, we deliver mentoring and community programmes that support vulnerable young people facing a range of challenges. Working alongside schools, community organisations and strategic partners, we create safe, supportive environments that help young people develop confidence, resilience and positive pathways for the future.

 

The Role

You will lead the delivery of targeted mentoring provision across our community programmes, ensuring sessions are engaging, safe and delivered to the highest standards. You will work closely with Programme Officers, delivery staff and external partners to ensure participants receive consistent and effective support.

Day to day, you will mentor vulnerable young people, develop and review individual action plans and support participants to make positive progress. You will also supervise delivery coaches, providing guidance, feedback and support to maintain high standards of delivery across each site.

Alongside delivery, you will build and maintain strong relationships with schools, community organisations, local authorities and key partners, contributing to programme outcomes and supporting the development of CITC's reach across Manchester. You will also play a key role in embedding safeguarding and ensuring CITC and CFG policies are consistently followed.

 

What You'll Bring

⚽ Experience delivering youth work programmes, including 1-2-1 mentoring with vulnerable young people.

⚽ A minimum Level 2 qualification in Youth Work.

⚽ Experience working with schools, community organisations and facility partners.

⚽ Strong knowledge of youth work theory and practice, with an understanding of safeguarding and supporting vulnerable young people.

⚽ GCSEs in English, Maths and Science, alongside strong Microsoft Office skills.

⚽ Excellent communication and team-working skills, with a creative, resilient and adaptable approach.

⚽ A full, clean UK driving licence and access to your own vehicle.

 

Why Choose Us

Guided by our values of being caring, inclusive, transformative and youth-led, we are committed to creating an environment where our team feel supported, valued and able to make a meaningful difference through the work they do every day.

As part of our team, you will receive 26 days’ annual leave plus a day off for your birthday and an annual discretionary bonus. You will also have access to a Health Cash Plan, Employee Assistance Programme with 24/7 GP support, and a company pension and life assurance.

You can enjoy a range of additional benefits, including discounted match tickets, savings in the City Store, a free City+ subscription, stadium tour discounts, and wider retail and lifestyle offers.

 

How to Apply

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by 2nd December 2026.

 

Equal Opportunities

City Football Group is committed to achieving workforce diversity and we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, national origin, race, age, sex, gender identity, disability - physical or hidden, sexual orientation, veteran status, religious belief, or any other characteristics protected by law. We strive to provide a fully inclusive and accessible recruitment process. We encourage all applicants to reach out if they require any support or accommodation to enable them to thrive throughout our recruitment process. Please contact citcjobs@cityfootball.com.

Due to our safeguarding promise, all UK based CFG roles will be subject to a DBS check upon commencing employment with us. This will be either a basic, standard or enhanced check depending on the job role and responsibilities.

job.title: Community Mentor
job.html_description:
Community Mentor 

This Community Mentor role is an opportunity to make a meaningful difference to young people across Greater Manchester. Working across schools and education settings, you will deliver mentoring, education and sport-based sessions that help young people build confidence, resilience and positive behaviours, whilst supporting them to explore their future pathways.

 

Who We Are

Established in 1986, City in the Community is Manchester City’s official charity. We support people across Manchester by empowering healthier lives through football. Our programmes place physical and mental wellbeing at their core, whilst also creating healthy futures and healthy communities.

Within our Community Mentoring team, we deliver targeted mentoring and early intervention programmes that support young people who may need additional help to engage, develop and achieve their potential. Working closely with schools, colleges and education partners, we use positive relationships, mentoring and sport to help young people build confidence, resilience and aspirations for the future.

 

The Role

You will deliver the City Inspires and Building Futures programmes across partner schools, colleges and sixth forms in Greater Manchester. Through a combination of classroom and practical sport sessions, one-to-one mentoring and personalised interventions, you will support young people to develop confidence, resilience, positive behaviour and awareness of future pathways.

Day to day, you will plan and deliver engaging sessions that respond to individual and group needs, working closely with the Community Mentoring Officer – Inspires and education partners to identify goals and provide tailored support. You will build positive relationships with participants, monitor attendance, engagement, wellbeing and behaviour, and maintain accurate records of progress and mentoring activity.

Alongside delivery, you will identify opportunities for participants to develop their skills and aspirations, supporting progression into further education, training, volunteering, employment and wider personal development opportunities. You will also play an important role in maintaining high safeguarding standards and ensuring CITC and CFG policies are embedded across all activities.

 

What You'll Bring

⚽ Experience delivering high-quality coaching or education sessions and structured one-to-one mentoring.

⚽ A strong understanding of youth mentoring, early intervention and relationship-based support.

⚽ Experience working with schools, colleges and education partners.

⚽ A minimum Level 2 Coaching Certificate in any sport.

⚽ Excellent communication skills, with a creative, resilient and adaptable approach.

⚽ Confidence managing multiple projects and working effectively as part of an inclusive team.

⚽ A full, clean UK driving licence and access to your own vehicle.

 

Why Choose Us

Guided by our values of being caring, inclusive, transformative and youth-led, we are committed to creating an environment where our team feel supported, valued and able to make a meaningful difference through the work they do every day.

As part of our team, you will receive 26 days’ annual leave plus a day off for your birthday and an annual discretionary bonus. You will also have access to a Health Cash Plan, Employee Assistance Programme with 24/7 GP support, and a company pension and life assurance.

You can enjoy a range of additional benefits, including discounted match tickets, savings in the City Store, a free City+ subscription, stadium tour discounts, and wider retail and lifestyle offers.

 

How to Apply

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by 2nd December 2026.

 

Equal Opportunities

City Football Group is committed to achieving workforce diversity and we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, national origin, race, age, sex, gender identity, disability - physical or hidden, sexual orientation, veteran status, religious belief, or any other characteristics protected by law. job.title: Football Data Analyst - Academy
job.html_description:
Based at City Football Academy in Manchester, this permanent full-time role will turn football data into clear insight that supports player development, performance and decision-making across the Academy. You will connect technical, tactical and contextual information to the questions that matter to coaches and multidisciplinary colleagues, helping data-informed insights become embedded into daily football practice.

 

Who We Are

 

Manchester City is a football club rooted in East Manchester, with a story that began in 1880 and continues to grow today. Built on resilience, belief and togetherness, success on the pitch is driven by the moments and memories shared with millions of Fans around the world. City is known for its bravery, its determination to the very end and its strong connection to where we come from. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are creating the next chapter, the City way.

 

Within our Academy Football Insights and Innovation team, we connect football understanding, analysis and technology to support the development of future players. Our work spans system, team and individual player contexts, with a focus on making objective insight accessible, relevant and useful to the people working in the Academy every day.

 

The Role

 

You will translate football questions, concepts and data into meaningful analysis that informs coaching practice, performance processes and key football decisions. Working across the Academy, you will provide contextualised and holistic insight alongside coaches, performance staff, analysis colleagues and multidisciplinary stakeholders.

 

Your work will include combining technical, tactical and contextual information from different sources, identifying relevant trends and patterns, and creating clear reporting tools, dashboards and player profiling outputs. You will help stakeholders move from a question to measurable analysis, then from analysis to practical action.

 

In partnership with CFG Football Intelligence and Academy teams, you will contribute to reliable data infrastructure, analytical processes and scalable insight solutions. You will communicate findings to technical and non-technical audiences while helping maintain high standards of data quality, integrity, governance, continuous improvement and innovation.

 

What You’ll Bring

 

  • Experience applying football data analysis in a practical football, performance, academic or equivalent environment.
  • Knowledge of football event and/or tracking data and applied football analytics methods.
  • Clear understanding of football performance, tactical concepts and player roles.
  • Ability to translate technical and tactical data into clear, practical insight for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Proficiency in tools such as Python, R or SQL, alongside visualisation platforms such as Tableau or Power BI.
  • Experience working collaboratively with attention to detail, data quality and the needs of multidisciplinary colleagues.

 

Why Choose Us

 

Working at Manchester City means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.

 

As part of our team, you will receive 26 days’ annual leave plus a day off for your birthday, private healthcare and dental cover, and an annual discretionary bonus. You will also have access to a Health Cash Plan, Employee Assistance Programme with 24/7 GP support, and a company pension and life assurance.

 

Manchester-based employees also benefit from free on-site parking, complimentary breakfast and lunch, and access to a range of sports and leisure clubs.

 

You can enjoy a range of additional benefits, including cycle to work, Give As You Earn, discounted match tickets, savings in the City Store, a free City+ subscription, stadium tour discounts, and wider retail and lifestyle offers.

 

How to Apply

 

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by 29 November 2026. We encourage you to apply as soon as you can.

 

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

 

Equal Opportunities

 

City Football Group promotes equal opportunities in employment and we positively welcome applications from all candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation.

We will screen all applicants and select candidates whose skills and experience seem to meet our needs. We will carefully consider your application during the initial screening and will contact you only if you are selected for an interview. If you require reasonable adjustments or any support throughout the process, please contact hiring@cityfootball.com and we will be happy to help.

All CFG recruitment communications originate from @cityfootball.com email addresses. If you receive communications from Gmail, Outlook.com or other personal email services claiming to represent CFG, please verify with the hiring team. Employment is subject to the provision of proof of eligibility to work in the UK.

Due to our safeguarding promise, all UK-based CFG roles will be subject to a DBS check upon commencing employment with us. This will be either a basic, standard or enhanced check depending on the job role and responsibilities.

job.title: Data Scientist - Academy
job.html_description:
Based at City Football Academy in Manchester, this permanent full-time role will shape how advanced data science supports player development and performance across Manchester City Academy, one of the world’s leading football academies. You will turn complex football data into robust models, explainable insight and practical tools that help colleagues understand long-term player pathways and make informed decisions.

 

Who We Are

 

Manchester City is a football club rooted in East Manchester, with a story that began in 1880 and continues to grow today. Built on resilience, belief and togetherness, success on the pitch is driven by the moments and memories shared with millions of Fans around the world. City is known for its bravery, its determination to the very end and its strong connection to where we come from. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are creating the next chapter, the City way.

 

Within our Academy Football Insights and Innovation team, we bring together football expertise, data and technology to support the development of future players. We work closely with coaches, analysts and multidisciplinary colleagues to make evidence-based insight useful in the daily environment and across the wider Academy pathway.

 

The Role

 

As the technical data science specialist within the Academy Football Insights and Innovation team, you will design, build and deploy analytical solutions that deepen understanding of player performance and development. Your work will help the Academy use data science thoughtfully, with outputs that are robust, explainable and connected to real football questions.

 

You will develop models that support player profiling, development pathways, trajectories and performance, while creating scalable data pipelines and workflows for complex football datasets. You will apply statistical modelling, machine learning and data science methods, then translate the results into clear, actionable insight for coaches, system leaders and multidisciplinary staff.

 

Working across the Academy data ecosystem and with CFG Football Intelligence and wider data teams, you will help maintain high standards of reproducibility, version control, documentation and validation. You will also contribute to responsible innovation by evaluating new methods, tools and technologies and applying them where they add genuine value.

 

What You’ll Bring

 

  • Experience applying data science, machine learning or applied statistics to complex questions.
  • Proficiency in Python and SQL, with familiarity with relevant data science libraries such as pandas, scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow.
  • Experience working with large datasets, including data wrangling, pipeline development and data-quality considerations.
  • Understanding of statistical modelling and experimental design, including longitudinal or hierarchical approaches where appropriate.
  • Ability to explain complex analytical work clearly and turn models into practical insight for non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience using version control such as Git and producing clean, maintainable and reproducible code.

 

Why Choose Us

 

Working at Manchester City means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.

 

As part of our team, you will receive 26 days’ annual leave plus a day off for your birthday, private healthcare and dental cover, and an annual discretionary bonus. You will also have access to a Health Cash Plan, Employee Assistance Programme with 24/7 GP support, and a company pension and life assurance.

 

Manchester-based employees also benefit from free on-site parking, complimentary breakfast and lunch, and access to a range of sports and leisure clubs.

 

You can enjoy a range of additional benefits, including cycle to work, Give As You Earn, discounted match tickets, savings in the City Store, a free City+ subscription, stadium tour discounts, and wider retail and lifestyle offers.

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

job.title: Operations Manager - Fleet and Travel
job.html_description:
Based in Manchester, this permanent role sits within City Football Group’s People Team and plays a central role in the day-to-day delivery of our fleet and corporate travel services. Working across internal teams and external providers, you will coordinate a wide range of activity across fleet, travel, employee services and relocation, ensuring issues are resolved effectively and our people receive a well-organised and responsive service.

 

This is a broad operational role for someone who enjoys bringing people, processes and suppliers together. You do not need to have built your career specifically within fleet or travel; strong operational, coordination and service-management experience is the key foundation of this role.  

 

Who We Are

 

Manchester City is a football club rooted in East Manchester, with a story that began in 1880 and continues to grow today. Built on resilience, belief and togetherness, success on the pitch is driven by the moments and memories shared with millions of Fans around the world. City is known for its bravery, its determination to the very end and its strong connection to where we come from. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are creating the next chapter, the City way.

 

Within City Football Group’s People Team, we provide the services and support that enable our people and businesses to operate effectively across a global organisation. This role sits at the centre of a number of these services, working closely with Reward, Payroll, Finance, People Services, Procurement, Security and external providers.

 

The Role

 

As an Operations Manager, you will be the day-to-day point of contact for CFG’s fleet and corporate travel services.

 

You will coordinate activity across company cars, our electric vehicle salary sacrifice scheme, corporate travel, insurance, vehicle movements, supplier relationships and related employee support. You will work closely with external providers and internal teams, ensuring queries are managed effectively, actions are followed through and issues are escalated appropriately.

 

The role also provides an opportunity to improve how these services operate. You will establish and maintain clear processes, identify opportunities to improve the employee experience and use service issues and feedback to make practical improvements.

 

You will work across a broad and varied area of the organisation, so this role will suit someone who is naturally organised, conscientious and proactive, with the ability to connect the dots and take ownership of delivery.

 

What You’ll Bring

  • Strong operational or service-management experience, with a track record of coordinating activity and delivering outcomes across multiple stakeholders.
  • Excellent organisation, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, cases and deadlines.
  •  Experience working with and coordinating external suppliers, with the confidence to follow up actions, resolve issues and hold providers accountable.
  •  Strong communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to work effectively across different teams and levels of an organisation.
  • Experience establishing, managing or improving processes and ways of working.
  •  The ability to handle complex or non-standard queries, apply judgement within agreed frameworks and know when to resolve, redirect or escalate.
  • Confidence working with spreadsheets, systems, data and confidential information.
  • A proactive and hands-on approach, with the ability to take ownership and drive activity through to completion.

 

Experience within fleet, travel, HR, People Services, Reward, insurance, salary sacrifice or a similar environment would be beneficial but is not essential. We would also consider candidates from project management or broader operational backgrounds where they can demonstrate strong delivery, coordination and ownership.

 

Why Choose Us

 

Working at City Football Group means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.

 

As part of our team, you will receive 26 days’ annual leave plus a day off for your birthday, private healthcare and dental cover, and an annual discretionary bonus. You will also have access to a Health Cash Plan, Employee Assistance Programme with 24/7 GP support, and a company pension and life assurance.

 

Manchester-based employees also benefit from free on-site parking, complimentary breakfast and lunch, and access to a range of sports and leisure clubs.

 

You can enjoy a range of additional benefits, including cycle to work, Give As You Earn, discounted match tickets, savings in the City Store, a free City+ subscription, stadium tour discounts, and wider retail and lifestyle offers.

 

How to Apply

 

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by 29 November 2026.

 

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

 

Equal Opportunities

 

City Football Group promotes equal opportunities in employment and we positively welcome applications from all candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation.

 

We will screen all applicants and select candidates whose skills and experience seem to meet our needs. We will carefully consider your application during the initial screening and will contact you only if you are selected for an interview. If you require reasonable adjustments or any support throughout the process, please contact hiring@cityfootball.com and we will be happy to help.

 

All CFG recruitment communications originate from @cityfootball.com email addresses. If you receive communications from Gmail, Outlook.com or other personal email services claiming to represent CFG, please verify with the hiring team. Employment is subject to the provision of proof of eligibility to work in the UK.

 

Due to our safeguarding promise, all UK-based CFG roles will be subject to a DBS check upon commencing employment with us. This will be either a basic, standard or enhanced check depending on the job role and responsibilities.

job.title: Restaurant and Bars Marketing Executive
job.html_description:
Based at Medlock Square in Manchester, this permanent, full-time role will support the day-to-day marketing of five distinctive food and drink venues: Zadies, Little Beast, Three Rivers, Blend and Brickworks. You will help bring campaigns, content and customer-facing materials to life, giving each venue a clear presence while contributing to the wider Medlock Square destination.

 

Who We Are

 

Medlock Square is a destination where sport, music, food and entertainment come together to create something truly special. Located in the heart of East Manchester, between the Etihad Stadium and Co-op Live, it is a place to meet, explore and make memories all year round. From live events and immersive experiences to great food, drink and hospitality, there is always something to bring people together. Inspired by the heritage and energy of the area, Medlock Square is the next chapter in the evolution of the Etihad Campus, welcoming our local communities and visitors from around the world.

 

Discover more at www.medlocksquare.com.

 

Within the Medlock Square food and beverage team, we work across a varied portfolio of venues and experiences. Our marketing activity helps customers discover what is happening across the destination, supports venue teams to deliver memorable visits and gives each food and drink concept its own character within the wider Medlock Square offer.

 

The Role

 

As Restaurant and Bars Marketing Executive, you will help keep marketing activity moving from brief to delivery across Medlock Square's food and drink venues. You will coordinate practical work that makes a visible difference, from keeping menus and printed materials accurate to supporting seasonal, event and destination campaigns.

 

Working closely with the Marketing Manager and venue teams, you will prepare clear Marketing briefs, manage campaign calendars and trackers, coordinate approvals and help deliver content across digital, social and on-site channels. You will also support CRM activity by gathering accurate offers, menu and event details, preparing copy and assets, and checking links, dates, terms and calls to action before content is scheduled.

 

The role also includes coordinating photography and video shoots, influencer and creator visits, and the follow-up needed to capture agreed content and permissions. You will build productive relationships with restaurant and bar teams, chefs, designers, printers, photographers, PR contacts and internal marketing colleagues, bringing care, clarity and reliable follow-through to day-to-day delivery.

 

What You’ll Bring

 

  • Experience in a marketing, communications, content or coordination role – ideally from within the Hospitality or Food and Beverage sector.
  • Ability to organise multiple projects, stakeholders and deadlines with care and follow-through.
  • Clear communication skills, with the ability to gather information, write customer-facing copy and brief creative partners.
  • A careful approach to checking details such as prices, dates, booking links, offer terms, allergens and spelling.
  • Comfortable working across social and digital channels, with an interest in how content supports awareness, bookings and footfall.
  • Ability to work collaboratively and flexibly around occasional shoots, events and key trading dates when required.

 

Why Choose Us

 

Working at Medlock Square means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.

 

As part of our team, you will receive 26 days’ annual leave plus a day off for your birthday, private healthcare and dental cover, and an annual discretionary bonus. You will also have access to a Health Cash Plan, Employee Assistance Programme with 24/7 GP support, and a company pension and life assurance.

 

Manchester-based employees also benefit from free on-site parking, complimentary breakfast and lunch, and access to a range of sports and leisure clubs.

 

You can enjoy a range of additional benefits, including cycle to work, Give As You Earn, discounted match tickets, savings in the City Store, a free City+ subscription, stadium tour discounts, and wider retail and lifestyle offers.

 

How to Apply

 

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by 30 November 2026. We encourage you to apply as soon as you can.

 

The recruitment process will include an initial application review followed by interviews for shortlisted candidates.

 

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

 

Equal Opportunities

 

City Football Group promotes equal opportunities in employment and we positively welcome applications from all candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation.

 

We will screen all applicants and select candidates whose skills and experience seem to meet our needs. We will carefully consider your application during the initial screening and will contact you only if you are selected for an interview. If you require reasonable adjustments or any support throughout the process, please contact hiring@cityfootball.com and we will be happy to help.

 

All CFG recruitment communications originate from @cityfootball.com email addresses. If you receive communications from Gmail, Outlook.com or other personal email services claiming to represent CFG, please verify with the hiring team. Employment is subject to the provision of proof of eligibility to work in the UK.

 

Due to our safeguarding promise, all UK-based CFG roles will be subject to a DBS check upon commencing employment with us. This will be either a basic, standard or enhanced check depending on the job role and responsibilities.

job.title: Graduate Software Engineer
job.html_description:
Take what you’ve learnt about coding and put it to work in global football, building tools for the people who work in the game and the fans who follow it. Based in Manchester, City Football Group’s two-year Software Engineering Graduate Programme is your chance to build, test and improve software in a global football business.

Bring the curiosity that makes you want to know why a line of code works, or why it doesn’t. You’ll work alongside experienced engineers, share your ideas and see what it takes to turn a first attempt into software people can rely on.

Who We Are

City Football Group brings together clubs from around the world, including Manchester City, New York City FC, Girona FC and Melbourne City FC. Each club has its own identity and local fanbase, while the Group shares expertise across football, technology and entertainment. Our purpose is to empower better lives through football.

In East Manchester, the Etihad Campus is home to the Etihad Stadium and the City Football Academy, where Manchester City’s men’s, women’s and academy teams train. Across the Group, technology supports everything from performance analysis to the way fans experience matchday. The official Man City app, for example, lets supporters follow live updates, listen to commentary and catch up on highlights wherever they are.

The Role

You’ll help design, build, test and maintain software. You’ll learn how to take a problem from an initial conversation through to a working solution: understand what users need, break the problem down, write code and check that it does what you intended.

You’ll fix bugs, contribute to features and learn how teams use version control, automated testing and code reviews to build reliable software. You’ll also learn about APIs, software architecture and cloud technologies. Working alongside experienced engineers, you’ll get feedback on your code, talk through your decisions and build confidence taking ownership of your work.

You could work in Football Technology Solutions, building tools for coaches and players; Fan Technology Solutions, developing websites, apps and online shops for supporters; or Foundational Solutions, working on the cloud, data and cybersecurity services that support the Group.

Depending on your project, you could work with technologies such as C#/.NET, Python, TypeScript, React, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Databricks and Microsoft Azure.  You’ll also learn how our engineers use AI-assisted development tools such as OpenAI Codex in their day-to-day work. You don’t need experience with these specific tools or languages to apply.

What You’ll Bring

 

  • You’ve completed, or are currently completing, a degree with a coding element. That could be from any STEM discipline including ; Computer Science, Software Engineering, Maths, Engineering or another subject where you’ve written code as part of your studies.
  • You’re interested in a career in software development and can talk us through something you’ve coded in at least one programming language. A university assignment, dissertation, personal project or placement is a good example.
  • You are driven like an engineer: you break problems into smaller steps, investigate what went wrong, test your assumptions and explain why you chose your approach.
  •  You’re open to feedback, willing to ask questions and enjoy working with others to make things better.

 

We’re interested in how you approach tasks and what you’ve learnt.

 

Why Choose Us

You’ll build skills that stay with you long after the programme: how to find your way into an unfamiliar problem, write code other people can build on and explain the decisions you made along the way. You’ll learn by contributing to real projects and getting feedback from the engineers working alongside you.

 

Our benefits include 26 days’ annual leave plus a day off for your birthday, private healthcare and dental cover, a company pension and life assurance. On our Manchester campus, you’ll also have access to complimentary breakfast and lunch, free on-site parking, and sports and leisure clubs.

 

How to Apply

Apply through the City Football Group careers site by 3 January 2027. Tell us about one thing you’ve built or improved with code.

What did it do, what did you contribute and how did you check it worked? A small project is fine. We’re more interested in your approach than the size of the project. After submitting your application, you can expect:

Online testing: If you’re invited to the next stage, you’ll start with an online assessment.  

Screening: If you are successful in progressing, we will arrange a screening call to understand more about you.

Assessment centre: Next, you’ll be invited to meet the team, show us how you tackle problems and get a feel for what it’s like to start your software engineering career at CFG.

 

You’re welcome to use AI to help prepare or structure your application, but your answers must reflect your own experience and your ability to code without AI.

Equal Opportunities

City Football Group promotes equal opportunities in employment and we positively welcome applications from all candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation.

We will screen all applicants and select candidates whose skills and experience seem to meet our needs. We will carefully consider your application during the initial screening and will contact you only if you are selected for an interview. If you require reasonable adjustments or any support throughout the process, please contact hiring@cityfootball.com and we will be happy to help.

All CFG recruitment communications originate from @cityfootball.com email addresses. If you receive communications from Gmail, Outlook.com or other personal email services claiming to represent CFG, please verify with the hiring team. Employment is subject to the provision of proof of eligibility to work in the UK.

Due to our safeguarding promise, all UK-based CFG roles will be subject to a DBS check upon commencing employment with us. This will be either a basic, standard or enhanced check depending on the job role and responsibilities.

Apply through the City Football Group careers site by 3 January 2027. Tell us about one thing you’ve built or improved with code.
What did it do, what did you contribute and how did you check it worked? A small project is fine. We’re more interested in your approach than the size of the project. After submitting your application, you can expect:
Online testing: If you’re invited to the next stage, you’ll start with an online assessment.
Screening: If you are successful in progressing, we will arrange a screening call to understand more about you.
Assessment centre: Next, you’ll be invited to meet the team, show us how you tackle problems and get a feel for what it’s like to start your software engineering career at CFG.
You’re welcome to use AI to help prepare or structure your application, but your answers must reflect your own experience and your ability to code without AI.

job.title: Venue Sales Executive B2B
job.html_description:
Based in Manchester, this permanent, full-time role will help grow B2B revenue across Manchester City’s venue portfolio. You will manage inbound event enquiries, shape thoughtful proposals and client experiences, and help businesses discover the spaces, services and possibilities available across the stadium. Working within the Venue Sales team, you will contribute to memorable events while building trusted relationships with clients and colleagues.

 

Who We Are

 

Manchester City is a football club rooted in East Manchester, with a story that began in 1880 and continues to grow today. Built on resilience, belief and togetherness, success on the pitch is driven by the moments and memories shared with millions of Fans around the world. City is known for its bravery, its determination to the very end and its strong connection to where we come from. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are creating the next chapter, the City way.

Our Venue Sales team creates opportunities for businesses to connect, celebrate and build relationships through the Etihad Stadium and its event spaces. Working closely with Venue Sales Planning and wider stadium teams, we deliver welcoming, well-organised experiences that reflect the quality and character of Manchester City.

 

The Role

 

As Venue Sales Executive (B2B), you will be a key point of contact for businesses looking to host events at Manchester City. You will respond to inbound enquiries with care and pace, understand what each client is looking to achieve, and turn those conversations into clear, engaging event proposals that meet company standards and venue policies.

You will arrange and lead client show-rounds and appointments, bringing the stadium’s event spaces, products and services to life. You will also prepare event contracts and invoices, making sure agreed costs, requirements and minimum numbers are accurately recorded and communicated.

Working collaboratively with Venue Sales Planning and colleagues across the stadium, you will maintain a practical understanding of venue operations and contribute to the marketing plan that supports B2B growth. Your organised, client-focused approach will help turn enquiries into successful events and lasting commercial relationships.

 

What You’ll Bring

 

  • A clear focus on achieving agreed sales and revenue objectives.
  • Experience managing customer or client enquiries and progressing opportunities through to an agreed outcome.
  • Ability to organise and prioritise multiple activities while maintaining accurate records and follow-up.
  • Clear and effective written, verbal and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Comfortable using CRM systems and Microsoft Office tools to manage information and prepare client materials.
  • A collaborative and flexible approach, with an interest in understanding venue operations and supporting colleagues.

 

Why Choose Us

 

Working at Manchester City means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.

 

As part of our team, you will receive 26 days’ annual leave plus a day off for your birthday, private healthcare and dental cover, and an annual discretionary bonus. You will also have access to a Health Cash Plan, Employee Assistance Programme with 24/7 GP support, and a company pension and life assurance.

 

Manchester-based employees also benefit from free on-site parking, complimentary breakfast and lunch, and access to a range of sports and leisure clubs.

 

You can enjoy a range of additional benefits, including cycle to work, Give As You Earn, discounted match tickets, savings in the City Store, a free City+ subscription, stadium tour discounts, and wider retail and lifestyle offers.

 

How to Apply

 

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by 6 December 2026. We encourage you to apply as soon as you can.

 

The first-stage interviews are planned for the week commencing 7 December 2026, with final-stage interviews planned for the week commencing 14 December 2026.

 

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

 

Equal Opportunities

 

City Football Group promotes equal opportunities in employment and we positively welcome applications from all candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation.

 

We will screen all applicants and select candidates whose skills and experience seem to meet our needs. We will carefully consider your application during the initial screening and will contact you only if you are selected for an interview. If you require reasonable adjustments or any support throughout the process, please contact hiring@cityfootball.com and we will be happy to help.

 

All CFG recruitment communications originate from @cityfootball.com email addresses. If you receive communications from Gmail, Outlook.com or other personal email services claiming to represent CFG, please verify with the hiring team. Employment is subject to the provision of proof of eligibility to work in the UK.

 

Due to our safeguarding promise, all UK-based CFG roles will be subject to a DBS check upon commencing employment with us. This will be either a basic, standard or enhanced check depending on the job role and responsibilities.
