job.title: Catering Assistant
job.html_description:
Based in Manchester, this full-time, permanent role supports the daily catering service at the City Football Academy. You will help create a welcoming experience for Academy and support staff by preparing service areas, supporting food and drink service, and helping maintain a clean, safe and professional environment across everyday catering and events.

Who We Are

 

Manchester City is a football club rooted in East Manchester, with a story that began in 1880 and continues to grow today. Built on resilience, belief and togetherness, success on the pitch is driven by the moments and memories shared with millions of Fans around the world. City is known for its bravery, its determination to the very end and its strong connection to where we come from. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are creating the next chapter, the City way.

 

The Facilities team helps create a welcoming, well-run environment across the City Football Academy. Our catering service plays an important part in supporting Academy and support staff, from daily meals and refreshments to internal and external events.

 

The Role

 

As a Catering Assistant, you will be part of a team that provides friendly, efficient and professional service across the City Football Academy. You will help prepare the refectory and Parents Lounge for breakfast, lunch and dinner where provided, ensuring each area is clean, presentable and ready for service.

 

You will support the serving of food and drinks, taking care with portion control and responding thoughtfully to customer needs. You will also contribute to the smooth delivery of internal and external events, helping every service feel organised and welcoming.

 

Working with the wider catering and Facilities teams, you will help maintain high standards of food safety, health and safety, cleanliness and presentation. Your care and attention will make a practical difference to the daily experience of the people who use the Academy.

 

What You’ll Bring

 

  • Experience working in a catering or hospitality environment.
  • Clear communication and customer care skills, with a welcoming and helpful approach.
  • The ability to work independently and contribute positively as part of a team.

 

Why Choose Us

 

Working at Manchester City means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.

 

As part of our team, you will receive 26 days’ annual leave plus a day off for your birthday, private healthcare and dental cover, and an annual discretionary bonus. You will also have access to a Health Cash Plan, Employee Assistance Programme with 24/7 GP support, and a company pension and life assurance.

 

Manchester-based employees also benefit from free on-site parking, complimentary breakfast and lunch, and access to a range of sports and leisure clubs.

 

You can enjoy a range of additional benefits, including cycle to work, Give As You Earn, discounted match tickets, savings in the City Store, a free City+ subscription, stadium tour discounts, and wider retail and lifestyle offers.

 

How to Apply

job.title: Head of Physical Performance
job.html_description:
Based in Shenzhen, this role leads the physical performance function at Shenzhen Peng City FC, with responsibility for maximising player availability, developing physical capability and supporting competitive team performance. Working closely with the Head Coach, Head of Medical, Sporting Director and City Football Group (CFG), you will lead an integrated, multidisciplinary performance system aligned to the club’s football strategy and performance objectives.

 

Who We Are

 

Shenzhen Peng City FC is part of City Football Group, a global football organisation committed to developing high-performance environments across its clubs and football operations.

 

At Shenzhen Peng City FC, the football department works closely across coaching, medical and performance disciplines to support player development, availability and team performance.

 

As part of CFG, the club also benefits from opportunities to share knowledge, best practice and innovation across the wider network.

 

The Role

 

As Head of Physical Performance, you will lead, organise and operationally manage associated services across Shenzhen Peng City FC.

 

You will set the physical performance philosophy, standards and operating plans for the club, while leading and developing the multidisciplinary performance team. You will work closely with the Head Coach, Head of Medical, Sporting Director and CFG to ensure performance services are aligned with the club’s football objectives.

 

You will oversee physical preparation across strength, speed, power, conditioning and physical profiling, ensuring individual development and team preparation reflect the demands of the Head Coach’s game model and competitive schedule.

 

A key part of the role will be managing workload, readiness, recovery and periodisation across the season. You will translate performance information into clear actions for coaches and players, while ensuring planning responds to fixture demands, travel and the environmental conditions in Shenzhen.

 

You will also lead the integration of performance and medical services around rehabilitation and return to performance, support multidisciplinary individual development plans and establish meaningful performance indicators and reporting routines.

 

Working across the club and CFG network, you will contribute to innovation, share best practice and help develop a high-performance culture that supports players, staff and the coaching team.

 

What You'll Bring

 

⚽ A degree in an appropriate discipline such as strength and conditioning, sports science, physiology or a related field.

⚽ Verifiable experience as an applied physical performance practitioner in elite international or professional sport, including direct responsibility for designing and delivering first-team physical preparation programmes.

⚽ Experience working within multidisciplinary high-performance teams and leading practitioners across more than one performance discipline.

⚽ Strong knowledge of strength and conditioning, physical preparation, recovery, player monitoring and performance support in elite team sport.

⚽ Proven ability to lead and develop staff and build effective relationships with players, coaches, medical staff and senior leaders.

⚽ Understanding of clinical governance, confidentiality, accurate record keeping and safe professional practice.

⚽ Fluent professional English and Mandarin Chinese, or the ability to lead effectively within a multilingual team.

 

Why Choose Us

 

This is an opportunity to lead physical performance within a professional football club environment and contribute to the development of an integrated, high-performance system.

 

You will work closely with senior football and performance stakeholders while also benefiting from the wider CFG network, creating opportunities to share knowledge, learn from different environments and contribute to performance innovation across the Group.

 

How to Apply

 

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by 6 December 2026. 

 

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

 

Equal Opportunities

 

City Football Group promotes equal opportunities in employment and we positively welcome applications from all candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation.

 

We will screen all applicants and select candidates whose skills and experience seem to meet our needs. If you require reasonable adjustments or any support throughout the process, we are committed to supporting you throughout the recruitment process.

 

Employment is subject to the provision of proof of eligibility to work in the relevant jurisdiction.

job.title: Casual Coach Intern (MCWFC Girls Academy)
job.html_description:
Based at the Manchester City Football Academy, this casual opportunity offers university students and people studying sports coaching, sports development, sport and exercise science or a related subject the chance to learn alongside an experienced coaching team.

 

You will support the Manchester City Women Academy programme through coaching administration, player development activity and practical support across training and matchdays. The core working pattern is Monday, Tuesday and Friday from 9:00am to 1:00pm, and Wednesday from 12:00pm to 4:00pm. 

 

As a casual role, hours are not guaranteed beyond agreed assignments.

 

Who We Are

 

Manchester City Women is a team driven by ambition, belief and a desire to keep pushing the game forward. Founded in 1988 and relaunched in 2014, we have grown into a consistent force in the women’s game, competing at the highest level in the UK and Europe. Progress, performance and pride sit at the heart of everything we do. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are building what comes next, the City way.

 

Within the Manchester City Women Academy, we support the development of young players through a structured, collaborative environment. Our coaching and multidisciplinary teams work together to help players grow on and off the pitch, while creating a positive pathway for long-term development.

 

The Role

 

As a Casual Coach Intern, you will work alongside the Academy coaching team to support the smooth delivery of the programme and contribute to player development. This is a practical learning opportunity where you will build experience across coaching support, programme administration and the wider day-to-day operation of an academy environment.

 

You will help maintain accurate records of coaching, playing and individual learning plan minutes on Smartabase, coordinate player schedules and share updates with relevant colleagues. During training, you will support defined activities under the direction of coaches, help manage equipment and contribute to a well-organised learning environment. You will also assist with programme administration, including responding to requests, taking meeting notes and sharing information through agreed channels.

 

You will support matchday arrangements by helping prepare team sheets, completing practical tasks and welcoming guests and visitors. Working with coaching, sports science, medicine, analysis and operations colleagues, you will contribute to a respectful, organised and safeguarding-focused environment for players and staff. Additional evening, weekend or matchday work may be discussed in advance where programme needs require it.

 

What You’ll Bring

 

⚽ Experience or an active course of study in sports coaching, sports development, sport and exercise science or a related subject.

⚽ Administrative skills, including maintaining accurate records, managing schedules and completing tasks to agreed deadlines.

⚽ A reliable and organised approach, with the ability to follow guidance and respond thoughtfully to changing priorities.

⚽ Clear communication skills and a collaborative approach to working with colleagues across different departments.

⚽ Confidence using digital systems, with the willingness to learn Smartabase and other club processes.

⚽ A discreet and professional approach to sensitive information, with a clear commitment to safeguarding.

⚽ A UEFA C Licence would be welcome but is not essential.

 

Why Choose Us

 

Working at Manchester City Women means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.

 

This is a casual role with no guaranteed hours beyond agreed assignments. The core working pattern is Monday, Tuesday and Friday from 9:00am to 1:00pm, and Wednesday from 12:00pm to 4:00pm. Any additional evening, weekend or matchday support will be discussed in advance in line with programme needs.

 

How to Apply

 

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by Monday 30 November 2026. We encourage you to apply as soon as you can.

 

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

job.plain_text_description:
Based at the Manchester City Football Academy, this casual opportunity offers university students and people studying sports coaching, sports development, sport and exercise science or a related subject the chance to learn alongside an experienced coaching team.
You will support the Manchester City Women Academy programme through coaching administration, player development activity and practical support across training and matchdays. The core working pattern is Monday, Tuesday and Friday from 9:00am to 1:00pm, and Wednesday from 12:00pm to 4:00pm.
As a casual role, hours are not guaranteed beyond agreed assignments.
Who We Are
Manchester City Women is a team driven by ambition, belief and a desire to keep pushing the game forward. Founded in 1988 and relaunched in 2014, we have grown into a consistent force in the women’s game, competing at the highest level in the UK and Europe. Progress, performance and pride sit at the heart of everything we do. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are building what comes next, the City way.
Within the Manchester City Women Academy, we support the development of young players through a structured, collaborative environment. Our coaching and multidisciplinary teams work together to help players grow on and off the pitch, while creating a positive pathway for long-term development.
The Role
As a Casual Coach Intern, you will work alongside the Academy coaching team to support the smooth delivery of the programme and contribute to player development. This is a practical learning opportunity where you will build experience across coaching support, programme administration and the wider day-to-day operation of an academy environment.
You will help maintain accurate records of coaching, playing and individual learning plan minutes on Smartabase, coordinate player schedules and share updates with relevant colleagues. During training, you will support defined activities under the direction of coaches, help manage equipment and contribute to a well-organised learning environment. You will also assist with programme administration, including responding to requests, taking meeting notes and sharing information through agreed channels.
You will support matchday arrangements by helping prepare team sheets, completing practical tasks and welcoming guests and visitors. Working with coaching, sports science, medicine, analysis and operations colleagues, you will contribute to a respectful, organised and safeguarding-focused environment for players and staff. Additional evening, weekend or matchday work may be discussed in advance where programme needs require it.
What You’ll Bring
⚽Experience or an active course of study in sports coaching, sports development, sport and exercise science or a related subject.
⚽Administrative skills, including maintaining accurate records, managing schedules and completing tasks to agreed deadlines.
⚽A reliable and organised approach, with the ability to follow guidance and respond thoughtfully to changing priorities.
⚽Clear communication skills and a collaborative approach to working with colleagues across different departments.
⚽Confidence using digital systems, with the willingness to learn Smartabase and other club processes.
⚽A discreet and professional approach to sensitive information, with a clear commitment to safeguarding.
⚽A UEFA C Licence would be welcome but is not essential.
Why Choose Us
Working at Manchester City Women means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.
This is a casual role with no guaranteed hours beyond agreed assignments. The core working pattern is Monday, Tuesday and Friday from 9:00am to 1:00pm, and Wednesday from 12:00pm to 4:00pm. Any additional evening, weekend or matchday support will be discussed in advance in line with programme needs.
How to Apply
If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by Monday 30 November 2026. We encourage you to apply as soon as you can.
We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.
Equal Opportunities
City Football Group promotes equal opportunities in employment and we positively welcome applications from all candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation.
We will screen all applicants and select candidates whose skills and experience seem to meet our needs. We will carefully consider your application during the initial screening and will contact you only if you are selected for an interview. If you require reasonable adjustments or any support throughout the process, please contact hiring@cityfootball.com and we will be happy to help.
All CFG recruitment communications originate from @cityfootball.com email addresses. If you receive communications from Gmail, Outlook.com or other personal email services claiming to represent CFG, please verify with the hiring team. Employment is subject to the provision of proof of eligibility to work in the UK.
Due to our safeguarding promise, all UK-based CFG roles will be subject to a DBS check upon commencing employment with us. This will be either a basic, standard or enhanced check depending on the job role and responsibilities.

job.title: Matchday Steward (casual contract)
job.location: Selhurst Park Stadium, London, London, SE25 6PU, GB
job.html_description:
Job Location:      Selhurst Park Stadium, SE25 6PU

Contract Type:   0-hour, Casual Contract

Salary/ ROP:       £13.15 per hour


Who we are:

We are Crystal Palace Football Club, a Premier League Football Club with more than 160 years of proud history. Spread across three different sites - brand new main offices at Selhurst Park Stadium, our London office, and our Training Ground/Academy, we offer the best atmosphere and culture for our fans and our employees. 


We strive for excellence in the workplace with a philosophy of high standards, professionalism, and a strong work ethic from our employees. We are constantly trying to grow, diversify and build with not only our team on the pitch, but also our team in the offices and on the ground.

About this role:

Crystal Palace FC is looking for passionate, well-presented, and engaging individuals to join our Security matchday team. You’ll play a key role in ensuring the safety, safeguarding, and enjoyment of all our guests at Selhurst Park. Representing Crystal Palace FC on the front line, you’ll deliver outstanding service with a smile, support fans, and help create an unforgettable matchday experience. Be part of the energy, excitement, and pride of Selhurst Park as you play a key role in bringing our club to life on matchdays.


Responsibilities:

  • Commit to and attend all Premier League fixtures (schedule to be announced in June) as well as FA Cup games as required

  • Be responsible for the safe access and comfort of spectators visiting the stadium

  • Identify and report any incident, occurrence or hazard among spectators and report to a supervisor

  • Ensure that CPFC standards are upheld by being the first line of contact with guests and provide a welcoming environment to provide the best experience and visit at Selhurst Park Stadium.

  • Maintain an immaculate personal presentation with a polished professional appearance.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.


Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

• You must be over 18 (Essential)

• NVQ Level 2 in Spectator Safety (desirable)

• Friendly and happy to help all clients with patience and good manners

• Be mature and be able to handle situations calmly

• Possess excellent interpersonal skills and be polite and courteous

• A strong focus on accuracy and diligence in every aspect

• Good communication skills

• An understanding of body search regulations and processes

• Experience working at a football stadium and/or similar spectator events (Desirable)


Our commitment to Equality

At Crystal Palace Football Club, Equality, Diversity & Inclusion is spirited and continues to grow due to the working environment, which makes all staff feel appreciated and welcomed. Crystal Palace Football Club do this by encouraging good relations and practices towards different groups and are committed to promoting employment opportunities that celebrate diversity.

We are committed to attracting, recruiting, and retaining the most talented candidates and the club intends to ensure that everyone who wishes to engage with the club, whether as matchday fans, staff, players, board members, participants in Foundation programmes and any other person engaged with the club's activities, has a real and equal opportunity to do so.


Reasonable Adjustment

We are proud to be a Disability Confident Employer. We guarantee an interview to all disabled applicants who meet the essential criteria for the role, ensuring equitable opportunities for everyone.

If you require disability-related adjustments during the recruitment process, please contact DLO@cpfc.co.uk (DLO inbox is for disability-related queries only, if you wish to gain further information regarding this vacancy, please contact cpfc.recruitment@cpfc.co.uk). We are here to help you through the whole recruitment process including trying to apply for a vacancy, getting in touch with us through the process, and/or helping with access in case you are required to come in for an interview.


Safeguarding

Crystal Palace Football Club is committed to safeguarding and ensuring the welfare and protection of children and vulnerable people and expects all staff to share this commitment. As such, the post holder will be required to undergo any relevant security checks, including a comprehensive background check, Enhanced Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) to ensure the safety and protection of children and vulnerable individuals.

You want to be a part of the buzz and excitement of a match day by being the face of Crystal Palace Football Club and providing excellent service to the customers of our many bars and kiosks.

 

Our match days are typically on Saturdays with some weekday evening and Sunday matches and the typical shift day is 6-8 hours depending on the game.


Responsibilities:

  • Take initiative and participate in the set-up of kiosks and bars, stock and supplies

  • Welcome guests and taking orders

  • Process payments on POS devices in an efficient manner

  • Maintain counters and fridges with sufficient supplies of stock throughout the service period, as guided by your manager.

  • Ensure stock rooms and areas are organised and clean, to ensure easy stock rotation and reconciliation.

  • Where necessary, assist in the back of house areas: kitchen and food preparation, pot wash and stock deliveries

  • Perform clean-up duties after each shift and ensure that concession stand is sanitized and tidied to a high standard

  • Serving alcohol responsibly and following the club’s Challenge 25 Policy

  • Adhering to all Health & Safety policies including the club’s Food Safety Management Systems

  • Carrying out any other reasonable duties asked of you from within your team and management including being flexible in covering tasks outside of your role-specific duties.

  • Maintain an immaculate personal presentation with a polished professional appearance.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.


Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

  • Experience in catering, hospitality or food service

  • Strong customer service and communication skills

  • Engaging and easy to talk to

  • Reliable, punctual and trustworthy

About this role:

Crystal Palace Football Club are looking for a self-motivated, detail orientated and hardworking cleaner to join our team. You will be responsible for making sure that the site is clean, presentable. This can entail dusting, polishing, mopping, sweeping, vacuuming, and cleaning smudges off windows and doors.


Responsibilities:

  • Being responsible for all basic cleaning in and around the building.

  • Cleaning floors and rooms - including dust mopping, damp mopping, sweeping, vacuuming, dusting, picking up objects off the floor, and spot cleaning glass and windows.

  • Cleaning restrooms, including restocking dispensers, emptying trash, cleaning and sanitizing fixtures, cleaning mirrors, spot cleaning partition doors and walls, sweeping and mopping tile floors, and cleaning toilets and urinals.

  • Emptying trash, cleaning vacuums and replacing liners

  • Setting up, stocks, and maintains cleaning equipment and supplies.

  • Monitoring and maintaining sanitation and organization of assigned areas.

  • Assisting other departments when needed to ensure optimum service to guests.

  • Liaising with the line manager to ensure that you have sufficient cleaning products at all times.

  • Reporting any breakages that occur during the cleaning process.

  • Informing the line manager of repairs that need to be done.

  • Reporting any large objects obstructing fire exit.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.

Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

  • Experience in professional cleaning with exceptionally high standards

  • Attention to detail

  • High standard of discretion and confidentiality

  • Have a strong work ethic, be loyal, passionate, and friendly.

  • Team player – expected to work well and communicate effectively with the team

  • Checkable reference

  • Ability to work with high profile professionals

  • Understanding that our commercial premises may contain confidential paperwork etc

  • Ensuring compliance to sanitation, hygiene, health and safety legislation and organisational and quality requirements and working policies and procedures.

  • Flexible and adaptable at all times

job.location: Selhurst Park Stadium, London, London, SE25 6PU, GB
job.html_description:
Job Location:      Selhurst Park Stadium, SE25 6PU

Contract Type:   0-hour, Fixed-Term Contract

Who we are:

We are Crystal Palace Football Club, a Premier League Football Club with more than 160 years of proud history. Spread across three different sites - brand new main offices at Selhurst Park Stadium, our London office, and our Training Ground/Academy, we offer the best atmosphere and culture for our fans and our employees. 


We strive for excellence in the workplace with a philosophy of high standards, professionalism, and a strong work ethic from our employees. We are constantly trying to grow, diversify and build with not only our team on the pitch, but also our team in the offices and on the ground.

About this role:

If you have experience in preparing and cooking hot food or as a grill chef with a passion for customer service – we want to hear from you! You will be engaging, enthusiastic and have a thirst to learn and grow. You want to be a part of the buzz and excitement of a match day by being the face of Crystal Palace Football Club and serving high quality products throughout the match.

Our match days are typically on Saturdays with some weekday evening and Sunday matches and the typical shift day is 8 hours depending on the game.

Responsibilities:

  • Understanding all menus, product offerings, packaging and pricing

  • Responsible for preparing and cooking all the hot food such as burgers, pies, hot dogs nachos and specialty items for a unit on match day and meeting peak periods with appropriate food levels

  • Maintain high standards of food presentation and quality with regular controls

  • Ensure all products are accounted for, prepared and distributed according to cook-off numbers and instructions from your manager

  • Restock and ensure the food prep area is clean at the end of your shift

  • Ensure all kitchen unit equipment (electrical or otherwise) is cleaned down and properly maintained at the end of every shift

  • Adhere and keep up to date records for food and health and safety standards such as food temperature control levels and following the club’s Food Safety Management System

  • Adhering to all Health & Safety policies and Security policies

  • Carrying out any other reasonable duties asked of you from within your team and management including being flexible in covering tasks outside of your role-specific duties.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.


Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

  • Food Safety Level 2 certificate and strong knowledge of proper food handling procedures

  • Experience grilling or cooking food in mass quantities, particularly in a busy or similar environment

  • A can-do attitude and be prepared to help the rest of the team out with a positive attitude

  • Immaculate grooming standards and overall appearance

  • Always look for ways to improve

  • Can work in high pressure situations

job.location: Copers Cope Road, Beckenham, London, BR3 1NZ, GB
job.html_description:
Job Location:     Academy Training Ground, BR3 1NZ

Contract Type:   Full-time


Who we are:

We are Crystal Palace Football Club, a Premier League Football Club with more than 160 years of proud history. Spread across three different sites - brand new main offices at Selhurst Park Stadium, our London office, and our Training Ground/Academy, we offer the best atmosphere and culture for our fans and our employees. 


We strive for excellence in the workplace with a philosophy of high standards, professionalism, and a strong work ethic from our employees. We are constantly trying to grow, diversify and build with not only our team on the pitch, but also our team in the offices and on the ground.

About this role:

Crystal Palace Football Club are looking for an experienced and skilled Maintenance operative to perform and upkeep tasks such as repairs, inspections, plumbing, carpentry, painting, decorating, general maintenance and planned improvement services to our facilitates. The individual will be responsible for assisting other trades when required to ensure the highest level of service across our sites.


Responsibilities:

  • Undertake the day-to-day general maintenance repairs in-house for all our facilities but mainly at our Academy Training Ground.

  • Undertake painting work, such as preparing painting surfaces, removing old paint, mixing and matching paints, and to use correct utilities to prepare the surrounding areas in order to prevent messes.

  • Undertake plumbing work, such as fixing leaks, unblocking drains and gutters, shower fitting, and more.

  • Undertake tiling and decorating work, such as, preparing surfaces by levelling off with the correct material, measuring and applying tiles, repairing/removing old surfaces, add more.

  • Undertake carpentry work, such as taking measurements and installing shelves, cabinets, handles, locks and more.

  • Preparation of the facilities for home matches

  • Regular checks and repairs on lights, toilets, and seats.

  • Completing work in accordance with the Crystal Palace specifications and in compliance with the relevant Legislation and industry best practices

  • Working to operational procedures, safe working practices and Health and Safety procedures as required.

  • Providing general support and assistance to the Maintenance Manager

  • Inspecting the Training ground and Academy and it’s adjoining structures on a daily and weekly basis to ensure they are all well-kept and in order.

  • Completing works at other Crystal Palace Football Club grounds and facilities including the Academy Training Ground.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.


Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

  • Experience in a maintenance environment.

  • Experience in plumbing, painting, decorating, carpentry, and general maintenance.

  • Basic knowledge of maintenance systems such as HVAC, plumbing, electrical etc.

  • Ability to read manuals and drawings.

  • Experience using hand and electrical tools.

  • Experience working in large scale stadiums/ buildings.


Benefits:

  • Complimentary match day ticket

  • Reward and Discount Scheme through our Tech Scheme and Simple Health app

  • Health and Wellbeing benefit scheme

  • 20% Discount in our Retail Stores

  • Discounts in various gyms through GymFlex

  • Volunteering Day - 1 Workday off to support a charity of your choice.

  • Travel Season Ticket loan

  • Holiday allowance: 25 Days

Crystal Palace FC is looking for passionate, well-presented, and engaging individuals to join our Security matchday team. You’ll play a key role in ensuring the safety, safeguarding, and enjoyment of all our guests at Selhurst Park. Representing Crystal Palace FC on the front line, you’ll deliver outstanding service with a smile, support fans, and help create an unforgettable matchday experience. Be part of the energy, excitement, and pride of Selhurst Park as you play a key role in bringing our club to life on matchdays.


Responsibilities:

  • Commit to and attend all Premier League fixtures (schedule to be announced in June) as well as FA Cup games as required

  • Be responsible for the safe access and comfort of spectators visiting the stadium

  • Identify and report any incident, occurrence or hazard among spectators and report to a supervisor

  • Ensure that CPFC standards are upheld by being the first line of contact with guests and provide a welcoming environment to provide the best experience and visit at Selhurst Park Stadium.

  • Maintain an immaculate personal presentation with a polished professional appearance.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.

Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

  • You must be over 18 (Essential).

  • SIA Door Supervisor Badge (Essential).

  • NVQ Level 2 in Spectator Safety (Desirable).

  • Friendly and happy to help all clients with patience and good manners.

  • Mature and able to handle situations calmly.

  • Possess excellent interpersonal skills and be polite and courteous.

  • A strong focus on accuracy and diligence in every aspect.

  • Good communication skills.

  • An understanding of body search regulations and processes.

If you have experience in or are passionate about customer service and working in the fast paced environment of football we want to hear from you! You will be well presented, engaging and committed to meeting and allowing the entry of all of guests to the stadium. You are approachable, hardworking and enjoy helping others with a smile; whist also keepings safety and security at the forefront of everything you do.

Responsibilities:

  • Providing an excellent service to Home/Away supporters.

  • Attending the match briefing as given by the Head of Ticketing, and Turnstile Supervisor to understand the ticketing arrangements for each fixture

  • Ensuring that the area around the turnstile where deployed is clear of obstructions and operates freely.

job.title: Logistics & Fulfilment Operative (Casual Contract)
job.location: Selhurst Park Stadium, London, London, SE25 6PU, GB
job.html_description:
Job Location:      Selhurst Park Stadium, SE25 6PU

Contract Type:   0-hour, Casual Contract

Salary/ ROP:       £13.15 per hour

Who we are:

We are Crystal Palace Football Club, a Premier League Football Club with more than 160 years of proud history. Spread across three different sites - brand new main offices at Selhurst Park Stadium, our London office, and our Training Ground/Academy, we offer the best atmosphere and culture for our fans and our employees. 


We strive for excellence in the workplace with a philosophy of high standards, professionalism, and a strong work ethic from our employees. We are constantly trying to grow, diversify and build with not only our team on the pitch, but also our team in the offices and on the ground.

About this role:

The Logistics Operative plays a vital role in supporting the successful delivery of matchdays and events across Selhurst Park. Responsible for the movement, storage and organisation of food, beverages, equipment and disposables, the role ensures kiosks, bars and hospitality areas are fully stocked, organised and operational.

Working as part of the Public Catering team, the Logistics Operative helps maintain high standards of cleanliness, food safety and operational efficiency, ensuring an exceptional experience for supporters, guests and clients.

Responsibilities:

  • Receive, check and store food, beverage and equipment deliveries.

  • Ensure stock is rotated and stored in accordance with company procedures.

  • Support stock counts and stock reconciliation activities.

  • Report shortages, damages and discrepancies to management.

  • Maintain accurate stock records where required.

  • Prepare kiosks, bars and catering areas for operation.

  • Distribute food, beverage, equipment and disposable stock throughout the stadium.

  • Support premium areas and event spaces with operational requirements.

  • Ensure units are replenished efficiently throughout service.

  • Respond quickly and effectively to operational requests during matchdays and events.

  • Maintain cellar areas to a high operational standard.

  • Support beer line cleaning procedures where required.

  • Ensure food stores, disposable stock rooms and chemical storage areas are clean, organised and compliant.

  • Assist with the movement and handling of kegs and heavy stock items using safe working practices.

  • Complete HACCP, delivery, temperature and cleaning records accurately.

  • Follow all Health & Safety, Food Safety, COSHH and manual handling procedures.

  • Maintain high standards of cleanliness throughout operational areas.

  • Report maintenance issues, hazards and incidents promptly.

  • Work closely with the Stock Controller, Hub Leaders and management team to ensure operational requirements are met.

  • Support colleagues across the department where required.

  • Communicate shortages, equipment failures and operational issues promptly.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.


Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

  • Experience working within hospitality, catering, logistics, warehouse or customer-facing environments.

  • Flexible approach to working hours, including evenings, weekends and matchdays.

  • Strong communication and teamwork skills.

  • Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.

  • Ability to work independently and use initiative.

  • Previous experience within logistics, cellar operations or stock control. (Desirable)

  • Experience working in a stadium, arena or large-scale event environment. (Desirable)

  • Experience handling food and beverage stock. (Desirable)

  • Level 2 Food Safety Certificate. (Desirable)

  • Manual Handling Certificate. (Desirable)

  • Counterbalance Forklift Licence. (Desirable)

  • Personal Licence Holder. (Desirable)

  • First Aid qualification. (Desirable)

job.location: Copers Cope Road, Beckenham, London, BR3 1NZ, GB
job.html_description:
Job Location:     Academy Training Ground, BR3 1NZ

Contract Type:   Fixed-Term Contract (Part-time)

Roles: This vacancy is for multiple roles supporting both our Foundation Phase and Youth Development Phase (YDP).

Who we are:

We are Crystal Palace Football Club, a Premier League Football Club with more than 160 years of proud history. Spread across three different sites - brand new main offices at Selhurst Park Stadium, our London office, and our Training Ground/Academy, we offer the best atmosphere and culture for our fans and our employees. 


We strive for excellence in the workplace with a philosophy of high standards, professionalism, and a strong work ethic from our employees. We are constantly trying to grow, diversify and build with not only our team on the pitch, but also our team in the offices and on the ground.

About this role:

Crystal Palace FC Academy are looking for driven, reliable, and passionate people to strengthen the scouting department. Ideally located in London, the chosen individual will play a key role in building relationships with local grassroots clubs and identifying talented players at either YDP or Foundation phase ages. As the club continues to establish itself as a Category 1 Academy, we are keen to develop our scouting and talent identification. Successful candidates would need to be available to watch grassroots games in London at weekends and have an existing knowledge of local football in London.

You will need to have a proven track record of building relationships in the local community and experience of identifying talent in the local area.

Responsibilities:

  • Identifying and monitoring local grassroots talent to join our Academy by attending games and tournaments in London

  • Helping to build and maintain relationships with local grassroots clubs & coaches.

  • Writing reports to help improve knowledge of players via the club’s scouting system.

  • Attending CPFC Academy Talent ID events and showcase games as requested by your coordinator.

  • Liaising with your coordinator and communicating your weekly scouting activity.

  • Ensuring you are available to attend recruitment department meetings and CPD events.

  • Be available to attend up to 4 games per week

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.


Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

  • An FA Level 1 in Talent ID

  • A Valid Driving License

  • Excellent IT skills

  • Completed an FA Safeguarding Children Course

  • Full Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) Criminal Record Check (CRC)

  • Experience of working in football talent identification

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills

  • Flexible and available to work unsociable hours

  • Able to work using your own initiative and as part of a team

job.title: Matchday Hub Leader (Casual)
job.location: Selhurst Park Stadium, London, London, SE25 6PU, GB
job.html_description:
Job Location:      Selhurst Park Stadium, SE25 6PU

Contract Type:   0-hour, Casual Contract

Salary/ ROP:       £16.67 p/h

Who we are:

We are Crystal Palace Football Club, a Premier League Football Club with more than 160 years of proud history. Spread across three different sites - brand new main offices at Selhurst Park Stadium, our London office, and our Training Ground/Academy, we offer the best atmosphere and culture for our fans and our employees. 


We strive for excellence in the workplace with a philosophy of high standards, professionalism, and a strong work ethic from our employees. We are constantly trying to grow, diversify and build with not only our team on the pitch, but also our team in the offices and on the ground.

About this role:

The Hub Leader is a senior front-line catering team member responsible for the safe and efficient operation of a designated concession or bar unit on matchdays and events. Acting as the main point of contact within their area, the Hub Leader is responsible for ensuring excellent guest service, accurate stock control and that all team members operate in accordance with Club standards and legal requirements.

Responsibilities:

  • Oversee the full operation of a designated concession or bar unit from set-up to close-down.

  • Attend pre-match/pre-event briefings and prepare the unit for service.

  • Complete close-down duties and support final counts and cleaning.

  • Liaise with the Concessions Supervisor and management team to ensure the smooth operation of the area.

  • Deliver exceptional service to supporters and guests, including dealing with customer complaints and resolving issues in a professional manner.

  • Promote product knowledge and upselling opportunities.

  • Ensure accurate counting and control of food, beverages and disposables.

  • Ensure stock is handled securely and replenished accurately throughout service.

  • Monitor stock usage during the event and communicate shortages proactively.

  • Record wastage, transfers and returns in accordance with training.

  • Maintain regular communication with the Concessions Supervisor and management team.

  • Communicate shortages, equipment failures and maintenance issues promptly.

  • Escalate concerns proactively to minimise disruption to service.

  • Lead by example while supporting, motivating, and developing team members.

  • Ensure key information is effectively communicated to team members.

  • Ensure food safety, hygiene and operational standards are maintained at all times.

  • Ensure all required documentation is completed accurately and on time.

  • Ensure licensing regulations are followed, with particular attention to Challenge 25 and protecting children from harm.

  • Monitor the correct use of PPE, handwashing and food handling procedures.

  • Ensure products are served to agreed specifications and brand standards.

  • Support stock accuracy and waste reduction initiatives.

  • Complete all paperwork accurately and within required timescales.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.


Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

  • Previous experience in hospitality, retail, catering, or other fast-paced customer-facing environments.

  • Strong communication, leadership, and customer service skills.

  • Ability to work independently, use initiative, and remain calm under pressure.

  • Previous team leader or supervisory experience.

  • Experience with EPOS systems, cash handling, and stock control.

  • Availability to work evenings, weekends, and public holidays

  • Personal Licence Holder (desirable)

  • Reliable, responsible, and professional, consistently leading by example.

  • Positive and supportive, with the ability to motivate others and remain calm under pressure.

Our commitment to Equality

At Crystal Palace Football Club, Equality, Diversity & Inclusion is spirited and continues to grow due to the working environment, which makes all staff feel appreciated and welcomed. Crystal Palace Football Club do this by encouraging good relations and practices towards different groups and are committed to promoting employment opportunities that celebrate diversity.

We are committed to attracting, recruiting, and retaining the most talented candidates and the club intends to ensure that everyone who wishes to engage with the club, whether as matchday fans, staff, players, board members, participants in Foundation programmes and any other person engaged with the club's activities, has a real and equal opportunity to do so.

- Previous experience in hospitality, retail, catering, or other fast-paced customer-facing environments. - Strong communication, leadership, and customer service skills. - Ability to work independently, use initiative, and remain calm under pressure. - Previous team leader or supervisory experience. - Experience with EPOS systems, cash handling, and stock control. - Availability to work evenings, weekends, and public holidays - Personal Licence Holder (desirable) - Reliable, responsible, and professional, consistently leading by example. - Positive and supportive, with the ability to motivate others and remain calm under pressure.

job.location: Selhurst Park Stadium, London, London, SE25 6PU, GB
job.html_description:
Job Location:      Selhurst Park Stadium, SE25 6PU

Contract Type:   0-hour, Casual Contract

Salary/ ROP:       £13.15

Who we are:

We are Crystal Palace Football Club, a Premier League Football Club with more than 160 years of proud history. Spread across three different sites - brand new main offices at Selhurst Park Stadium, our London office, and our Training Ground/Academy, we offer the best atmosphere and culture for our fans and our employees. 


We strive for excellence in the workplace with a philosophy of high standards, professionalism, and a strong work ethic from our employees. We are constantly trying to grow, diversify and build with not only our team on the pitch, but also our team in the offices and on the ground.

About this role:

To support the smooth running of Public Catering operations at Crystal Palace Football Club by maintaining excellent standards of cleanliness, hygiene and organisation across our kitchens, kiosks, concessions and associated facilities. The role focuses on deep cleaning and post-matchday recovery, alongside providing practical support to the wider catering and logistics teams.

Responsibilities:

  • Deep clean catering kitchens, kiosks, concessions and food preparation areas.

  • Clean and sanitise cooking equipment, extraction areas, work surfaces and storage facilities.

  • Complete scheduled cleaning tasks and post-matchday cleaning procedures.

  • Ensure all areas are maintained to the Club's food safety and hygiene standards.

  • Dispose of waste correctly and maintain clean, organised working environments.

  • Follow all food safety, health and safety and COSHH procedures.

  • Use cleaning chemicals and equipment safely and correctly.

  • Work effectively with colleagues and complete assigned tasks to the required standard.

  • Undertake other reasonable duties to support Public Catering operations.

Operational & Logistics Support

  • Assist with the breakdown, cleaning and resetting of catering facilities following matchdays and events.

  • Support the movement, storage and organisation of catering equipment, stock and supplies.

  • Assist the logistics team with deliveries, stock movements and general operational duties when required.

  • Identify and report equipment faults, damage or maintenance requirements.

  • Undertake other reasonable duties to support Public Catering operations.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.


Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

  • Reliable, hardworking and positive attitude.

  • Excellent attention to detail and high standards of cleanliness.

  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

  • Comfortable undertaking physical duties and manual handling.

  • Previous experience in commercial cleaning, catering or hospitality.

  • Knowledge of food hygiene and COSHH procedures.

  • Experience working in commercial kitchens or large venues.

  • Flexibility to work evenings, weekends and around matchday schedules.

job.location: Selhurst Park Stadium, London, London, SE25 6PU, GB
job.html_description:
Job Location:      Selhurst Park Stadium, SE25 6PU

Contract Type:   0-hour, Casual Contract

Salary/ ROP:       £14.15

Who we are:

We are Crystal Palace Football Club, a Premier League Football Club with more than 160 years of proud history. Spread across three different sites - brand new main offices at Selhurst Park Stadium, our London office, and our Training Ground/Academy, we offer the best atmosphere and culture for our fans and our employees. 


We strive for excellence in the workplace with a philosophy of high standards, professionalism, and a strong work ethic from our employees. We are constantly trying to grow, diversify and build with not only our team on the pitch, but also our team in the offices and on the ground.

About this role:

To support the preparation and delivery of food across Crystal Palace Football Club by assisting chefs with the assembly, wrapping and presentation of products whilst maintaining the highest standards of food safety, cleanliness and organisation. The role is responsible for ensuring products are prepared and distributed to specification, supporting efficient service on matchdays and events.

Responsibilities:

  • Assist chefs with food preparation and general kitchen duties.

  • Prepare, cook and assemble food products, including hot dogs, pizzas, pies, burgers and other menu items, in line with Club specifications and portion sizes.

  • Maintain food quality, consistency and presentation standards.

  • Follow stock rotation procedures, complete date checks and accurately record food temperatures, wastage and stock counts.

  • Maintain high standards of cleanliness, hygiene and organisation across food preparation and storage areas. Including, following daily cleaning schedules and end-of-shift procedures.

  • Follow all food safety, hygiene, allergen management and health and safety procedures, ensuring food is prepared, stored and handled safely.

  • Ensure waste is disposed of correctly and report equipment faults, maintenance requirements, incidents or hazards promptly.

  • Comply with relevant legislation, Club policies and operational standards.

  • Assist with the distribution and replenishment of food products across kiosks and designated service points.

  • Work collaboratively with chefs, Hub Leaders and the wider catering team to support the smooth running of operations, particularly during busy periods.

  • Demonstrate flexibility in responding to operational requirements, assist other areas when required and undertake any other reasonable duties within the scope of the role.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.


Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

Previous experience within hospitality, catering or food preparation.

Experience working in a kitchen or fast-paced food environment.

Experience working at sporting events or large venues.

Level 2 Food Safety Certificate. (desirable)

job.title: Marketing & Communications Executive (focused on CPFC Women)
job.location: Copers Cope Road, Beckenham, London, BR3 1NZ, GB | London, London, W1F 9SJ, GB
job.html_description:
Job Location:      Academy Training Ground, BR3 1NZ

Contract Type:   Full-time

Deadline:            29th November 2026

Who we are:

We are Crystal Palace Football Club, a Premier League Football Club with more than 160 years of proud history. Spread across three different sites - brand new main offices at Selhurst Park Stadium, our London office, and our Training Ground/Academy, we offer the best atmosphere and culture for our fans and our employees. 


We strive for excellence in the workplace with a philosophy of high standards, professionalism, and a strong work ethic from our employees. We are constantly trying to grow, diversify and build with not only our team on the pitch, but also our team in the offices and on the ground.

About this role:

The Marketing & Communications Executive will be focusing mainly on our Women’s Team. We are seeking someone who is dynamic, energetic, proactive, flexible and works at pace, with a passion for growing the women’s game.

The successful candidate will play an integral role in growing the women’s team audience, and work with the wider marketing team to target record attendances both at 360 Engage Stadium and at Selhurst Park, as well as providing regular written news and content for the website and app. The successful candidate will also lead all media requirements for the Women’s team, both in the week and on matchdays.

Predominantly based at our state-of-the-art academy in Beckenham, the Marketing & Communications Executive would be required to work alongside the club’s Social Media & Content Executive throughout the week and on matchdays. The role will also work closely with, and support, the club’s wider marketing, content and communication teams.

Responsibilities:

Marketing

  • Planning and delivering marketing campaigns across email, website, app, social (organic and paid) and print, including: Season Tickets and half Season Tickets; Home and away match tickets; Kit launches.

  • Focus on growth of the CPFC Women audience and increased matchday attendances, including targeting local schools, businesses and grassroots clubs.

  • Organise matchday activations and enhance the matchday experience, including working with external suppliers.

  • Write Women’s editorial content for the Club website and app, including match reports, previews, reaction, contracts/signings and partner announcements.

  • Schedule app notifications where appropriate, with support from the Editorial Manager.

  • Write and collect content for matchday programmes.

Communications / Media

  • Deliver manager press conferences (offering both virtual and in-person access) ahead of every game (league and cup).

  • Deliver contractual media requirements/interviews with the manager and/or players, both on matchday (pre/post-match interviews) and non-matchday, as well as fielding any media enquiries regarding the Women’s team.

  • Prepare media briefings for the manager/players ahead of all interviews.

  • Proactively conduct media outreach and pitch interviews to promote the team in line with Club objectives.

  • Monitor wider media coverage of the team and wider topics within women’s football.

  • Deliver the Women’s matchday programme for all home fixtures.

Other

  • Develop and maintain working relationships with the Head of Women’s Football, team manager, players and coaching staff, as well as the Football Association, WSL and key media.

  • Attend FA workshops when required.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.


Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

  • A clear passion for Women’s football and the Women’s Super League.

  • A Bachelor-level degree or equivalent in a relevant area, such as Marketing, Business/Economics or English.

  • An understanding of consumer media habits, as well as the various marketing channels to reach audiences.

  • Excellent communication skills.

  • Excellent time management, organisational and prioritisation skills.

  • An eye for detail.

  • The ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-moving environment.

Benefits:

  • Complimentary match day ticket

  • Reward and Discount Scheme through our Tech Scheme and Simple Health app

  • Health and Wellbeing benefit scheme

  • 20% Discount in our Retail Stores

  • Discounts in various gyms through GymFlex

  • Volunteering Day - 1 Workday off to support a charity of your choice.

  • Travel Season Ticket loan

  • Holiday allowance: 25 Days

  • Carrying out grounds maintenance works to the training pitches, stadium pitch and associated grounds and facilities as instructed, to a satisfactory standard.

  • Undertaking maintenance of grass areas hedgerows, trees and shrubs.

  • Competent level of numeracy and literacy

job.title: Greenkeeper (m/w/d)
job.html_description:
Wir sind Borussia Dortmund. Nicht nur ein weltweit bekannter Fußballverein, sondern auch ein börsennotiertes Unternehmen mit über 900 Mitarbeiter*innen. Neben unserem Kerngeschäft des Fußballs sind wir in zahlreichen weiteren Geschäftsfeldern tätig. Die Borussia Dortmund GmbH & Co. KGaA fungiert als Dachgesellschaft für neun Tochterunternehmen.

Zur Unterstützung unseres Rasenteams in der BVB Stadionmanagement GmbH suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Greenkeeper (m/w/d) im Rahmen einer Vollzeitbeschäftigung (42 Std./Woche).

Deine Aufgaben
  • Professionelle Pflege und Unterhaltung der Sportrasenflächen und Grünanlagen, z. B. Mähen, Düngen, Bewässern, Nachsäen, Vertikutieren, Aerifizieren, Besanden etc.
  • Beseitigung von Unkräutern, Laub, Grün- und Grasschnitt, Unrat, Abfällen usw.
  • Bedienung und Führung von Arbeitsmaschinen und -geräten sowie deren Pflege und Instandhaltung
  • Vorbereitung und Pflege der Spielfelder und Nebenflächen für den Trainings- und Spielbetrieb im SIGNAL IDUNA PARK und am Trainingsgelände Brackel
  • Auf- und Abbau sowie Kontrolle von baulichen und technischen Anlagen, z. B. Tore, Ballfangnetze, Eckfahnen etc.
  • Spielfeldbetreuung an Heimspieltagen der Profi- und Nachwuchsmannschaften
Dein Profil
  • Abgeschlossene handwerkliche Ausbildung, idealerweise im Garten- bzw. Landschaftsbau oder einschlägige Berufserfahrung in der Rasenpflege
  • Handwerkliches Geschick sowie ein gutes Gespür für die Maschinenführung
  • Selbstständige, strukturierte und proaktive Arbeitsweise
  • Spaß an der Zusammenarbeit im Team
  • Hohes Maß an Zuverlässigkeit und Verantwortungsbewusstsein
  • Hohe Einsatzbereitschaft und Flexibilität sowie Bereitschaft zu Arbeitszeiten an Spieltagen, Wochenenden und am Abend
  • Führerschein Klasse B, Klasse BE wünschenswert
Das erwartet Dich
  • Ein Platz in einem dynamischen Team, das sich stark mit seinen Aufgaben identifiziert
  • Spannende und vielseitige Tätigkeiten in einem einzigartigen Arbeitsumfeld
  • Kurze Entscheidungswege und viel eigenverantwortlicher Gestaltungsspielraum
  • Persönliches Mitarbeiter-Ticket für unsere Heimspiele
  • Individuelle Maßnahmen zur beruflichen und persönlichen Weiterentwicklung
  • Kostenfreie Mitgliedschaft im Fitnessstudio sowie Unterstützung für einen gesunden Arbeitsalltag
  • Weitere Mehrwerte, wie z. B. flexible Arbeitszeiten, Dienstrad-Leasing, Team-Events, Mitarbeiter-Bistro, Altersvorsorge etc.
Jetzt bewerben

Dann freuen wir uns auf Deine aussagekräftige Bewerbung mit Anschreiben, Lebenslauf und Zeugnissen. Bitte bewirb Dich online über den "Jetzt-bewerben Button".

job.title: Chef Tournant (m/w/d)
job.html_description:
Wir sind Borussia Dortmund. Nicht nur ein weltweit bekannter Fußballverein, sondern auch ein börsennotiertes Unternehmen mit über 900 Mitarbeiter*innen. Neben unserem Kerngeschäft des Fußballs sind wir in zahlreichen weiteren Geschäftsfeldern tätig. Die Borussia Dortmund GmbH & Co. KGaA fungiert als Dachgesellschaft für neun Tochterunternehmen.

Die BVB Event & Catering GmbH ist für die Vermarktung des SIGNAL IDUNA PARK als einzigartige Eventlocation verantwortlich und bewirtschaftet die gastronomischen Flächen des Stadions an Spieltagen sowie bei zahlreichen weiteren Events. Dazu zählen neben Firmen-, Incentive- und Privatveranstaltungen aller Art auch Tagungen, Konferenzen und Messen, die auf allen Tribünen und Ebenen im Stadion stattfinden.

Für unsere Küchenbereiche im SIGNAL IDUNA PARK, im Bistro 09 sowie auf dem BVB- Trainingsgelände suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Chef Tournant (m/w/d) im Rahmen einer Vollzeitanstellung (40h/Woche).

Deine Aufgaben
  • Zubereitung von warmen und kalten Gerichten, insbesondere im Bankett und à-la-carte-Bereich sowie im Rahmen von sportgerechter Ernährung
  • Sicherstellung eines reibungslosen Arbeitsablaufs in den Küchen, einschließlich der Anleitung und Führung von Fremdpersonal sowie unserer Küchenhilfen
  • Überwachung und Einhaltung der Hygienevorschriften nach dem HACCP-Konzept
  • Warenbedarfsermittlung und Annahme von Lieferungen sowie Mitwirkung bei Inventuren
  • Qualitätskontrolle der Lebensmittel und Speisen
  • Verantwortung für die fachgerechte Trennung und Entsorgung von Küchenabfällen (No waste Philosophie/Abfallminderung)

 

Dein Profil
  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung zum Koch (m/w/d)
  • Einschlägige Berufserfahrung in der gehobenen Hotellerie sowie Erfahrung auf der Position als Chef de Partie (m/w/d)
  • Idealerweise Kenntnisse im Umgang mit Personaldienstleistern
  • Hohe Anpassungsfähigkeit, Flexibilität sowie ein ausgeprägtes Qualitätsbewusstsein
  • Zuverlässige, strukturierte und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise
  • Hohe Einsatzbereitschaft und Leidenschaft

 

Das erwartet Dich
  • Einen Platz in einem dynamischen Team, das sich stark mit seinen Aufgaben identifiziert
  • Spannende und vielseitige Tätigkeiten in einem einzigartigen Arbeitsumfeld
  • Kurze Entscheidungswege und viel eigenverantwortlicher Gestaltungsspielraum
  • Persönliches Mitarbeiter-Ticket für unsere Heimspiele
  • Individuelle Maßnahmen zur beruflichen und persönlichen Weiterentwicklung
  • Kostenfreie Mitgliedschaft im Fitnessstudio sowie Unterstützung für einen gesunden Arbeitsalltag
  • Weitere Mehrwerte, wie z. B. flexible Arbeitszeiten, Dienstrad-Leasing, Team-Events, Mitarbeiter-Bistro, Altersvorsorge etc.

Das Bistro 09 ist das kulinarische Highlight im Herzen der BVB-Gemeinschaft. Unweit der BVB-Geschäftsstelle und nur einen Steinwurf vom schönsten Stadion der Welt entfernt heißen wir in unserer Gaststätte jeden willkommen, der lokale Spezialitäten und internationale Gerichte schätzt. Im Bistro 09 zelebrieren wir mit Frühstück, Mittag- und Abendessen täglich unsere Leidenschaft für Fußball und exzellente Küche.

Für das Bistro 09 der BVB Event & Catering GmbH suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Chef de Partie (m/w/d) für den kalten Posten im Rahmen einer Vollzeitanstellung (40h/Woche).

Deine Aufgaben
  • Zubereitung und Präsentation kalter Speisen wie Salate, Desserts etc. im Mittags- und Abendbetrieb
  • Sicherstellung eines reibungslosen und effizienten Arbeitsablaufes in der Küche
  • Anleitung und fachliche Kontrolle unserer Küchenhilfen
  • Warenbedarfsermittlung sowie Annahme und Kontrolle von Lieferungen
  • Überwachung und Einhaltung der Qualitätsstandards sowie der Hygienevorschriften nach dem HACCP-Konzept
Dein Profil
  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung zum Koch (m/w/d)
  • Berufserfahrung im à-la-carte-Bereich, idealerweise auf der Position als Chef de Partie (m/w/d)
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse der Hygienevorschriften nach dem HACCP-Konzept
  • Ausgeprägtes Qualitätsbewusstsein sowie ein hohes Maß an Kreativität und Detailorientierung
  • Zuverlässige, strukturierte und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise
  • Sichere mündliche Kommunikation in deutscher Sprache
  • Bereitschaft zu Wochenendeinsätzen sowie Einsätzen im Abendbereich
Das erwartet Dich
  • Einen Platz in einem dynamischen Team, das sich stark mit seinen Aufgaben identifiziert
  • Spannende und vielseitige Tätigkeiten in einem einzigartigen Arbeitsumfeld
  • Kurze Entscheidungswege und viel eigenverantwortlicher Gestaltungsspielraum
  • Persönliches Mitarbeiter-Ticket für unsere Heimspiele
  • Individuelle Maßnahmen zur beruflichen und persönlichen Weiterentwicklung
  • Kostenfreie Mitgliedschaft im Fitnessstudio sowie Unterstützung für einen gesunden Arbeitsalltag
  • Weitere Mehrwerte, wie z. B. flexible Arbeitszeiten, Dienstrad-Leasing, Team-Events, Altersvorsorge etc.

job.title: Praktikant (m/w/d) Mädchen- und Frauenfußball
job.html_description:
Wir sind Borussia Dortmund. Nicht nur ein weltweit bekannter Fußballverein, sondern auch ein börsennotiertes Unternehmen mit über 900 Mitarbeiter*innen. Neben unserem Kerngeschäft des Fußballs sind wir in zahlreichen weiteren Geschäftsfeldern tätig. Die Borussia Dortmund GmbH & Co. KGaA fungiert als Dachgesellschaft für neun Tochterunternehmen.

In der Abteilung Mädchen- und Frauenfußball fördern wir seit Oktober 2020 leidenschaftlich die sportliche Entwicklung des Frauenfußballs bei Borussia Dortmund. Seit ihrem Bestehen sind unsere BVB-Frauen vier Mal in Folge aufgestiegen und spielen in der aktuellen Saison in der Regionalliga West, der dritten Liga im deutschen Frauenfußball. Dies markiert einen weiteren Schritt auf unserem ambitionierten Weg in die Bundesliga. Zusätzlich stärken unsere 2. Frauenmannschaft, die U17-Mädchenmannschaft und unsere neu-gegründete U16 Mädchenmannschaft unsere nachhaltige Entwicklung im Bereich des Frauenfußballs.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir zum 01.04.2027 einen Praktikanten (m/w/d) Mädchen- und Frauenfußball idealerweise im Rahmen eines Pflichtpraktikums über 6 Monate oder eines freiwilligen Praktikums für 3 Monate.

Deine Aufgaben
  • Schnittstelle zwischen Teammanagement und der operativen Abteilung Mädchen- und Frauenfußball
  • Assistenz des Teammanagements bei der Vorbereitung und Organisation von Trainingseinheiten, einschließlich der Bereitstellung von Ausrüstung und Materialien
  • Unterstützung bei der Planung und Durchführung von Spieltagen am Wochenende, einschließlich der Koordination von Marketingmaßnahmen und mannschaftsbezogener Prozesse
  • Mitwirkung bei der Pflege und Verwaltung von internen und externen Kommunikationskanälen
  • Unterstützung bei der Planung und Durchführung von Projekten und Mannschaftsveranstaltungen
  • Betreuung und Unterstützung der Spielerinnen in organisatorischen und administrativen Belangen
Dein Profil
  • Studium im Bereich Sportwissenschaften, Sportmanagement oder ein vergleichbarer Studiengang idealerweise mit Sport- oder Wirtschaftsbezug
  • Erste Berufserfahrungen im Sport wünschenswert
  • Ausgeprägte Kontaktstärke und Empathie sowie ein gutes Gespür für den Umgang mit Jugendlichen und Erwachsenen
  • Affinität zu Borussia Dortmund und dem Mädchen- und Frauenfußball
  • Zuverlässige, strukturierte und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise
  • Hohe Flexibilität sowie Einsatzbereitschaft, Ambition und Leidenschaft
  • Herzliches, authentisches Auftreten und Spaß an der Arbeit im Team
Das erwartet Dich
  • Tiefe Einblicke hinter die Kulissen von Borussia Dortmund
  • Einen Platz in einem dynamischen Team, das sich stark mit seinen Aufgaben identifiziert
  • Spannende und vielseitige Tätigkeiten in einem einzigartigen Arbeitsumfeld
  • Kurze Entscheidungswege und viel eigenverantwortlicher Gestaltungsspielraum
Jetzt bewerben

Wir freuen uns auf Deine aussagekräftige Bewerbung mit Motivationsschreiben, Lebenslauf, Zeugnissen und Praktikumsbescheinigung. Bitte bewirb Dich online über den "Jetzt-bewerben-Button".

job.title: Controller (m/w/d)
job.html_description:
Wir sind Borussia Dortmund. Nicht nur ein weltweit bekannter Fußballverein, sondern auch ein börsennotiertes Unternehmen mit über 900 Mitarbeiter*innen. Neben unserem Kerngeschäft des Fußballs sind wir in zahlreichen weiteren Geschäftsfeldern tätig. Die Borussia Dortmund GmbH & Co. KGaA fungiert als Dachgesellschaft für neun Tochterunternehmen.

Unser Controlling-Team leistet einen entscheidenden Beitrag zur finanziellen Stabilität und zum wirtschaftlichen Erfolg von Borussia Dortmund. Durch die kontinuierliche Überwachung der Finanzergebnisse, die Identifikation von Abweichungen sowie die gezielte finanzielle Steuerung schafft das Team fundierte Grundlagen für die Geschäftsführung bei strategischen Entscheidungen.

Für die Direktion Finanzen der Borussia Dortmund GmbH & Co. KGaA suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Controller (m/w/d) im Rahmen einer Vollzeitanstellung (40h/Woche).

Deine Aufgaben
  • Entwicklung realistischer und umsetzbarer Budgetpläne in enger Abstimmung mit den Fachabteilungen
  • Laufende Überwachung der Budgeteinhaltung inkl. Analyse von Abweichungen sowie Ableitung und Kommunikation konkreter Handlungsoptionen und Einsparpotenziale
  • Erstellung regelmäßiger Reports zur Darstellung der Budgetentwicklung
  • Aktive Mitarbeit an den Lizenzierungsverfahren der Bundesliga sowie der UEFA einschließlich Bearbeitung definierter Teilbereiche
  • Mitwirkung bei der Erstellung von Finanzprognosen, Hochrechnungen und Szenarioanalysen sowie Erstellung von Ad-hoc-Reports
  • Kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung und Optimierung bestehender Reportingstrukturen und Prozesse
Dein Profil
  • Abgeschlossenes Studium der Betriebswirtschaftslehre mit dem Schwerpunkt Controlling oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Einschlägige Berufserfahrung im Controlling, idealerweise im Konzernumfeld
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in der Rechnungslegung nach HGB und IFRS
  • Fundierte Praxiserfahrung in der Arbeit mit ERP-Systemen, idealerweise Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central (BC)
  • Erfahrung im Umgang mit BI-Tools, Kenntnisse in der eigenständigen Erstellung von Berichten und Dashboards von Vorteil
  • Sicherer Umgang mit MS Office, insbesondere Excel
  • Erfahrungen mit KI-Anwendungen oder KI-gestützten Analysetools im beruflichen Kontext wünschenswert
  • Ausgeprägtes analytisches Denkvermögen, hohes Zahlenverständnis sowie eine strukturierte und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise
  • Kommunikationsstärke sowie ein freundliches und souveränes Auftreten gegenüber unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern
  • Spaß an der Zusammenarbeit im Team
  • Stilsichere Kommunikation in Deutsch und Englisch
Das erwartet Dich
  • Einen Platz in einem dynamischen Team, das sich stark mit seinen Aufgaben identifiziert
  • Spannende und vielseitige Tätigkeiten in einem einzigartigen Arbeitsumfeld
  • Kurze Entscheidungswege und viel eigenverantwortlicher Gestaltungsspielraum
  • Persönliches Mitarbeiter-Ticket für unsere Heimspiele
  • Individuelle Maßnahmen zur beruflichen und persönlichen Weiterentwicklung
  • Kostenfreie Mitgliedschaft im Fitnessstudio sowie Unterstützung für einen gesunden Arbeitsalltag
  • Weitere Mehrwerte, wie z. B. flexible Arbeitszeiten, Dienstrad-Leasing, Team-Events, Mitarbeiter-Bistro, Altersvorsorge etc.

job.title: Mitarbeiter (m/w/d) Event-Logistik
job.html_description:
Wir sind Borussia Dortmund. Nicht nur ein weltweit bekannter Fußballverein, sondern auch ein börsennotiertes Unternehmen mit über 990 Mitarbeiter*innen. Neben unserem Kerngeschäft des Fußballs sind wir in zahlreichen weiteren Geschäftsfeldern tätig. Die Borussia Dortmund GmbH & Co. KGaA fungiert als Dachgesellschaft für acht Tochterunternehmen.

Die BVB Event & Catering GmbH ist für die Vermarktung des SIGNAL IDUNA PARK als einzigartige Eventlocation verantwortlich und bewirtschaftet die gastronomischen Flächen des Stadions an Spieltagen sowie bei zahlreichen weiteren Events. Dazu zählen neben Firmen-, Incentive- und Privatveranstaltungen aller Art auch Tagungen, Konferenzen und Messen, die auf allen Tribünen und Ebenen im Stadion stattfinden.

Für die BVB Event & Catering GmbH suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Mitarbeiter (m/w/d) Event-Logistik in Vollzeit (40 Stunden/Woche).

Deine Aufgaben
  • Koordination, Durchführung und Überwachung des gesamten Auf- und Abbaus von Veranstaltungsflächen – inklusive Möblierung, Tagungstechnik (Licht, Boxen, Fernseher, Mikrofone) sowie weitere Aufgaben im Servicebereich (z.B. Tagungs- und Tischsetups)
  • Ressourcenplanung und Stundenverteilung von Dienstleisterpersonal; Anleitung, Aufgabenverteilung und Qualitätssicherung vor Ort
  • Erstellung und Pflege von Zeit-, Ablauf- und Einsatzplänen für alle Veranstaltungsformate einschließlich Spieltagen
  • Verwaltung und Bereitstellung von Eventmaterialien sowie Sicherstellung von Ordnung, Struktur und Sauberkeit in den Lagerräumen
  • Dokumentation von Abläufen durch Checklisten, Inventarlisten und Abnahmeprotokolle; regelmäßige Durchführung von Inventuren
Dein Profil
  • Idealerweise abgeschlossene Ausbildung im Bereich Eventmanagement, Logistik, Veranstaltungsorganisation oder einschlägige Berufserfahrungen in diesen Bereichen
  • Ausgeprägtes Organisationstalent und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise
  • Authentisches und souveränes Auftreten sowie ein hohes Maß an Diskretion
  • Hohe Stressresistenz und diplomatisches Auftreten auch in schwierigen Situationen
  • Ausgeprägte Leistungsmotivation und Durchsetzungskraft
  • Stilsichere Kommunikation in deutscher Sprache
  • Sicherer Umgang in MS-Office Anwendungen
  • Gute Kenntnisse in englischer Sprache
  • Idealerweise Erfahrungen mit gängiger Tagungstechnik
Das erwartet Dich
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten, die sich an Spiel- und Veranstaltungstagen orientieren
  • Einen Platz in einem dynamischen Team, das sich stark mit seinen Aufgaben identifiziert
  • Spannende und vielseitige Tätigkeiten in einem einzigartigen Arbeitsumfeld
  • Kurze Entscheidungswege und viel eigenverantwortlicher Gestaltungsspielraum
  • Persönliches Mitarbeiter-Ticket für unsere Heimspiele
  • Individuelle Maßnahmen zur beruflichen und persönlichen Weiterentwicklung
  • Kostenfreie Mitgliedschaft im Fitnessstudio sowie Unterstützung für einen gesunden Arbeitsalltag
  • Weitere Mehrwerte, wie z. B. flexible Arbeitszeiten, Dienstrad-Leasing, Team-Events, Mitarbeiter-Bistro, Altersvorsorge etc.

job.title: Küchenchef (m/w/d) BVB
job.html_description:
Wir sind Borussia Dortmund. Nicht nur ein weltweit bekannter Fußballverein, sondern auch ein börsennotiertes Unternehmen mit über 900 Mitarbeiter*innen. Neben unserem Kerngeschäft des Fußballs sind wir in zahlreichen weiteren Geschäftsfeldern tätig. Die Borussia Dortmund GmbH & Co. KGaA fungiert als Dachgesellschaft für neun Tochterunternehmen.
