Position Summary: Inter Miami CF is looking for an Intern, Foundation to to support the Foundation team with fundraising initiatives, game day operations, administrative projects, and community impact programs. This role will assist with the planning, coordination and execution of Foundation campaigns and events while providing exposure to nonprofit operations within professional sports.


This is a paid, part-time internship within our Number 10 Internship program for the 2027 Sprint Season cohort.


Responsibilities:

  • Assist with Foundation fundraising initiatives, including the 50/50 Raffle, Round-Up Campaign, Scoreboard Shoutouts, and Florida Specialty License Plate Program.
  • Support Foundation matchday activations by assisting with event setup, breakdown, logistics, and fan engagement.
  • Assist with recruiting, scheduling, communicating with and managing Foundation volunteers for events and matchdays.
  • Provide administrative support, including data entry, organizing documents, preparing reports, and maintaining records.
  • Assist with project management and task tracking using Monday.com.
  • Coordinate prize fulfillment, donor acknowledgments, and supporter communications.
  • Maintain Foundation inventory and event materials.
  • Assist with Foundation events and fundraising activations throughout the season.
  • Support day-to-day Foundation operations and special projects as assigned.
  • Collaborate with internal departments and external partners to ensure successful execution of Foundation programs.
  • Work from both IMCF Stadium in Fort Lauderdale and NU Stadium, as needed.
  • Work evenings, weekends, holidays, and other non-traditional hours, as needed. 

Requirements

  •  Currently pursuing an undergraduate or graduate degree in Sports Management, Nonprofit Management, Business, Marketing, Event Management, or a related field, or recently graduated from a related program
  • Strong organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills
  • Detail-oriented with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office; experience with Monday.com is a plus
  • Ability to work independently and in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment
  • Passion for nonprofit work, fundraising, and community impact
  • Bilingual (English and Spanish) fluency is a plus 
  • Passion for fútbol is a plus

All applicants must pass a pre-employment background check.


Additional Information:

· Start date: January 11, 2027

· End date: June 4, 2027

· Schedule: Part-time, fewer than 20 hours per week


Inter Miami CF is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status,  or any other characteristics protected by the law.

Position Summary: Inter Miami CF is looking for an Intern, Software Engineer to support the development of internal applications, tools, and technology solutions. This role will contribute to both front-end and back-end development, helping build scalable solutions that improve internal processes, data accessibility, and business operations across the organization.

  • Experience or coursework using programming languages such as PHP, Java, JavaScript, Python, or similar
  • Familiarity with SQL, relational databases, APIs, and web application development
  • Understanding of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and modern web development concepts
  • Familiarity with Git/version control and software development workflows is a plus
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail

Position Summary: Inter Miami CF is looking for an Intern, Business Intelligence to assist the BI team with routine and ad hoc customer insights research and reporting. This position is designed to develop foundational skills in business intelligence and customer behavior analytics.


This is a paid, part-time internship within our Number 10 Internship program for the 2027 Sprint Season cohort.


Responsibilities:

  • Conduct market research to help ideate and develop innovative activation concepts and marketing campaigns for prospective and existing partners.
  • Generate targeted lead lists to support sales efforts for both ticketing campaigns and corporate sponsorship procurement.
  • Update and maintain accurate tracking of sponsorship asset inventory.
  • Compile weekly newsletters summarizing trends, financial news, and significant developments within the sports industry.
  • Monitor and track the performance of the team’s social media channels, creating reports to summarize engagement and ways to improve performance.
  • Execute industry research to inform team of trends emerging across brands, teams, and leagues to assist in the development of new business for the club.

Requirements

  • Currently pursuing an undergraduate or graduate degree in Business Administration, Finance, Business Analytics, or a related field, or recently graduated from a related program
  • Working knowledge of algorithms for classification, regression, clustering, and anomaly detection 
  • Excellent communication and organization skills, capable of conveying complex data in a clear and concise manner
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel and PowerPoint; experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) is a plus
  • Bilingual (English and Spanish) fluency is a plus 
  • Passion for fútbol is a plus

All applicants must pass a pre-employment background check.

job.title: Vice President, Partnership Activation
job.location: 800 S Douglas Road, Coral Gables, FL, 33134, US
job.html_description:
Description

Inter Miami CF is seeking an accomplished Vice President of Partnership Activation to lead the Club’s Partnership Activation department and oversee the strategic management, delivery and long-term development of its premium global commercial partnership portfolio.


Reporting to the Senior Vice President of Partnerships, this executive will provide VP level leadership to the department’s Directors and their teams, establish best in class standards of partner service and operational accountability, and personally develop trusted relationships with C-suite executives and senior decision-makers at the Club’s most significant partners, in close collaboration with the Senior Vice President and Chief Revenue Officer.


The role is central to protecting and growing the long-term value of the Club’s partnerships, ensuring exceptional experiences and measurable business outcomes as Inter Miami CF and Miami Freedom Park enter their next chapter.


Responsibilities & Duties:  

  • Lead the entire Partnership Activation function, providing strategic direction, coaching and performance oversight to Directors and their respective account management teams.
  • Establish clear departmental objectives, service standards, KPIs, accountability frameworks and consistent operating processes across the partner portfolio.
  • Build a high-performance culture rooted in ownership, creativity, commercial awareness, collaboration and continuous improvement; develop talent and succession plans.
  • Oversee departmental resourcing, prioritisation, budgets and workload allocation to ensure scalable, consistently excellent delivery.
  • Executive Relationships & Strategic Partner Management
  • Personally own and cultivate executive-level relationships with C-suite leaders and senior stakeholders at the Club’s most significant global partners, alongside the Senior Vice President of Partnerships and Chief Revenue Officer. 
  • Set multi-year strategic account plans informed by each partner’s business priorities, brand objectives and measures of success.
  • Lead senior partner business reviews and strategic discussions; serve as an executive escalation point for complex issues and lead timely, solutions-oriented resolution.
  • Ensure Directors and account teams build strong day-to-day relationships while maintaining clear executive sponsorship and coordinated engagement across accounts.
  • Activation Strategy & Partner Experience
  • Oversee the planning and fulfilment of all contractual partnership rights and obligations, with a focus on quality, timeliness and measurable partner impact.
  • Drive innovative, integrated activation across matchday, stadium, digital, content, experiential, retail and community platforms, leveraging Club and Miami Freedom Park assets.
  • Partner across Marketing, Communications, Digital, Operations, Finance, Legal and other functions to deliver coordinated, premium partner experiences.
  • Implement robust account planning, partner feedback, reporting and executive recap processes that demonstrate value and inform continuous improvement.
  • Retention, Renewal Readiness & Commercial Growth
  • Own departmental accountability for partner satisfaction, retention and renewal readiness, identifying risks early and implementing proactive recovery plans.
  • Work closely with the Senior Vice President of Partnerships and Partnership Development to strengthen renewal positioning, identify organic growth opportunities and support commercial negotiations.
  • Track partner health, delivery performance, engagement and commercial outcomes through regular reporting and actionable insights.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in sponsorship, strategic account management, integrated marketing or commercial partnerships within sports, entertainment, agencies or leading global brands.
  • Proven senior leadership experience managing managers and developing high-performing, multi-layered teams.
  • Demonstrated success overseeing complex, high-value global partnerships and engaging credibly with C-suite executives.
  • Strong strategic, commercial, financial and operational judgement, with experience driving retention, renewal readiness and partnership value.
  • Exceptional relationship-building, communication, presentation, negotiation and cross-functional leadership skills.
  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred. English fluency required; Spanish proficiency preferred.
  • Ability to work evenings, weekends, matchdays and special events as business needs require.

  

Equal Opportunity Statement

Inter Miami CF is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law.


Must have work authorization to work in the U.S. on a permanent and ongoing basis and must not require work visa sponsorship from Inter Miami CF now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States.

Description

  

About Us: Miami is a global city fueled by culture, connection and ambition. At Inter Miami CF, we reflect the community we call home through our courage, creativity and passion for the game. We challenge convention, celebrate what makes Miami extraordinary and bring world-class fútbol to a world-class city. We are here to change the game.


Number 10 Internship | Be a Playmaker

The Number 10 Internship is our commitment to developing the next generation of leaders in sports and entertainment. Inspired by fútbol’s No. 10, the visionary, creator and playmaker, our interns gain hands-on experience through meaningful projects, cross-functional collaboration and full immersion in the Club’s day-to-day. It’s an opportunity to learn, contribute and make an impact while building your career in the game.


Position Summary: Inter Miami CF is looking for an Intern, Human Resources to work on a wide range of projects related to HR compliance, recruiting, onboarding and administration support. This person will also be responsible for helping develop and execute various managerial projects and completing special projects as delegated by the Human Resources team.

This is a paid, part-time internship within our Number 10 Internship program for the 2027 Sprint Season cohort.


Responsibilities:

  • Assist in recruitment efforts for all personnel, interns, Gameday staff and temporary employees. 
  • Assist in onboarding process including generating offer letters, preparing new hire packets, drafting internal communications, revising organizational chart and scheduling meetings. 
  • Assists in organizing and conducting new hire orientations, training and development sessions, and employee events. 
  • Conduct audits of personnel files and assists with filings to ensure compliance with federal and state regulations.
  • Assists with planning and preparation for employee appreciation events. 
  • Responds to all staff and employment inquiries promptly and professionally. 
  • Maintains the highest levels of confidentiality of sensitive information. 
  • Performs organizational and special projects as assigned. 

Requirements

  • Currently pursuing an undergraduate or graduate degree in Business, Human Resources, or a related field, or recently graduated from a related program
  • Ability to professionally and confidently interact with members at all levels of the organization. 
  • Exceptional reliability, interpersonal, communication and organizational skills required. 
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite of products. 
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment. 
  • Ability to work non-traditional hours, in non-traditional settings, within a team atmosphere. 
  • Bilingual (English and Spanish) fluency is a plus 
  • Passion for fútbol is a plus
  • All applicants must pass a pre-employment background check.


Additional Information:

Start date: January 11, 2027

End date: June 4, 2027

Schedule: Part-time, fewer than 20 hours per week

Inter Miami CF is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status,  or any other characteristics protected by the law.

job.title: Stadium Operations Crew (Fort Lauderdale Training Facility)
job.location: 1350 NW 55 Street, Fort Lauderdale, FL, 33309, US
job.html_description:
Description

Inter Miami CF is looking for Part-Time Operations Crew supporting the Facilities and Operations Department with event set-up, execution, teardown, changeovers and daily operational tasks at the Fort Lauderdale Training Facility.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities: 

  • Participate in the execution of stadium and training facility events & games, including set-up and post-event breakdown. 
  • Assist with maintenance, upkeep, and organization around the facility. 
  • Maintain a safe work environment. 
  • Perform other related duties as assigned. 
  • Must be able to lift 50+lbs and walk for extended periods of time. 

Requirements

  • Past employment or internship experience in game operations or facility management preferred. 
  • Exceptional reliability, interpersonal, communication and organizational skills required. 
  • Possess strong attention to detail. 
  • Must be able to perform manual labor duties and tasks. 
  • Ability to work non-traditional hours, in non-traditional settings, within a team atmosphere. 

Other Details: 

  • Hours of work are based off our events schedule and may vary. 
  • Bilingual applicants not required, but preferred. 
  • All applicants must pass a pre-employment background check.

Must have work authorization to work in the U.S. on a permanent and ongoing basis and must not require work visa sponsorship from Inter Miami CF now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States.  All applicants must pass a pre-employment background check. 


Inter Miami CF is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law

job.title: Intern, Communications | Sprint Season
job.html_description:
Description

 About Us: Miami is a global city fueled by culture, connection and ambition. At Inter Miami CF, we reflect the community we call home through our courage, creativity and passion for the game. We challenge convention, celebrate what makes Miami extraordinary and bring world-class fútbol to a world-class city. We are here to change the game. 


Number 10 Internship | Be a Playmaker 

The Number 10 Internship is our commitment to developing the next generation of leaders in sports and entertainment. Inspired by fútbol’s No. 10, the visionary, creator and playmaker, our interns gain hands-on experience through meaningful projects, cross-functional collaboration and full immersion in the Club’s day-to-day. It’s an opportunity to learn, contribute and make an impact while building your career in the game. 

 

Position Summary: Inter Miami CF is looking for an Intern, Communicationss to support the Communications Department with daily media relations and event press operations.


This is a paid, part-time internship within our Number 10 Internship program for the 2027 Sprint Season cohort.

 

 Responsibilities:

  • Send out weekly credential advisories to media, including application deadlines, event details, and credential portal links 
  • Respond to inquiries from media regarding event and media credential information 
  • Gather additional information from media as needed to complete the credentialing process
  • Lead credentialing efforts through our online credential system  
  • Work with security to ensure credentials are printed on time, and all info on credentials is correct, including access 
  • Organize credentials before event day to ensure a smooth check-in process 
  • Create seating charts and name tags for media ahead of each event hosted at Inter Miami’s facilities 
  • Compile event information, including event timeline and parking information, and distribute to media  
  • Assist the Communications Department with matchday media relations responsibilities, including press box management, media credentialing, digital content, and post-match quotes.  
  • Maintain Club’s current media distribution list, and assist in developing segmented lists, along with research of new potential media outlets and blogs to foster relationships.  
  • Archive and track ongoing media coverage by putting together daily media clips packs.  
  • Other duties and projects as assigned.  

Requirements

  • Currently pursuing an undergraduate or graduate degree in Journalism, Communication, or a related field, or recently graduated from a related program 
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal 
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office. Knowledge of Adobe products (InDesign, Photoshop) a plus 
  • Knowledge of global soccer, Inter Miami CF and Major League Soccer is preferred 
  • Strong understanding of digital and social media platforms 
  • Maintain the highest level of professionalism within a pro team environment and in media work zones 
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills 
  • Outgoing, engaging and professional demeanor
  • Bilingual (English and Spanish) fluency is a plus  
  • Passion for fútbol is a plus 


All applicants must pass a pre-employment background check. 


Additional Information: 

Start date: January 11, 2027 

End date: June 4, 2027 

Schedule: Part-time, fewer than 20 hours per week 


Inter Miami CF is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status,  or any other characteristics protected by the law.

job.title: Manager, BI (Partnership & Digital Analytics)
job.location: 800 S Douglas Road, Coral Gables, FL, 33134, US
job.html_description:
Description

Inter Miami CF is looking for a Manager, BI (Partnership & Digital Analytics) to lead analytics and insights across the club’s Partnerships and Digital functions as part of the Business Intelligence & Strategy team.


This role will be responsible for using data to support commercial decision-making, partnership valuation, sponsorship performance, digital strategy and fan engagement. A key responsibility will be leading the valuation of partnership assets and sponsorship packages, developing valuation methodologies and measuring partner performance.


The Manager will also oversee Digital & Marketing Analytics, ensuring the organization effectively measures fan behavior, digital engagement, campaign performance and audience growth across digital platforms. This position will manage and develop analysts supporting Partnerships and Digital & Marketing Analytics.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead Partnerships and Digital Analytics, serving as the primary analytical partner for both business areas.
  • Lead the valuation of partnership assets, sponsorship packages and commercial opportunities to support pricing, negotiations and partnership strategy.
  • Own and continuously improve partnership valuation models, methodologies and supporting data.
  • Lead sponsorship performance measurement and reporting, providing insights to support renewals, upsell opportunities and new business.
  • Develop benchmarks, case studies and industry research to support partnership strategy and value propositions.
  • Lead Digital & Marketing Analytics across websites, social media, email, CRM, app, paid media and other digital platforms.
  • Analyze fan acquisition, engagement, audience growth, content and campaign performance to identify opportunities and support digital strategy.
  • Establish KPIs, benchmarks and measurement frameworks for Partnerships, Digital and Marketing.
  • Develop dashboards and reporting to monitor performance and translate data into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Collaborate with Partnerships, Digital, Marketing and other departments to support strategic and commercial initiatives.
  • Manage, mentor and develop analysts supporting Partnerships and Digital & Marketing Analytics.
  • Continuously evaluate new data sources, technologies and methodologies to strengthen the club’s analytics capabilities.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Statistics, Marketing, Data Analytics or a related field. Advanced degree is a plus.
  • Minimum of 4 years of professional experience in analytics, sponsorship, partnership valuation, digital analytics, marketing analytics or a related field.
  • Strong understanding of sponsorship valuation, partnership measurement and digital analytics.
  • Strong analytical and commercial skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable business recommendations.
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel; experience with SQL is preferred.
  • Experience with data visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
  • Familiarity with digital and sponsorship measurement platforms such as Google Analytics, Relo Metrics, Blinkfire or similar tools is a plus.
  • Experience within sports, entertainment, sponsorship or media is preferred.
  • Strong leadership, communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and projects in a fast-paced environment.

job.title: Commercial Matchday Hosts
job.html_description:
Job Title: Commercial Matchday Hosts

Responsible to: Head of Commercial

Apply here: https://forms.office.com/e/12c4GXBGmg

About The Role:

As a host at Elland Road, you will be the first point of contact for many of our VIP hospitality guests. In this role you would be required to act as the face of the Club within your allocated hospitality lounge, creating a seamless link between our hospitality department, our catering department and our VIP matchday guests. This will ensure that our guests receive the highest possible standard of service and have an exceptional hospitality experience.

Allocation Main Responsibilities

  • Positions are offered for matchdays only, with a typical shift lasting approximately seven to eight hours.

  • Attending pre-match hospitality host / hostess briefing prior to each shift;

  • Familiarise yourself with your designated suite (which may change each shift), checking the suite and other guests facilities meet required standards and ensuring corporate lanyards and programmes are set out as per the guests chosen package;

  • Welcoming all guests into your suite, building relationships by using eye contact and escorting guests to their assigned dining area / table;

  • Build relationships with customers pre-match, at half time and full time.

  • Continuously managing the flow of guests in to the suite ensuring all

    guests catering needs are being met and all guests are happy;

  • Be particularly attentive to new guests to ensure they are comfortable in their surroundings whilst being observant towards and engaging with all guests at all times to ensure the highest levels of service throughout the day;

  • Resolving any issues as they arise to ensure the guests' matchday experience is not effected, raising to the next level and / or appropriate departments as required (usually Duty Manager in your allocated lounge)

  • Directing guests to the appropriate match seats;

  • Answering any questions hospitality guests may have about other events

    and fixtures;

  • Report any faults with facilities and any catering issues without delay;

  • Any other reasonable duties

Required Technical Skills

  • Previous experience as a host or hostess, or hospitality waiter or waitress in a hospitality environment, or front of house experience, is preferred.

Required Behavioural Attitudes

  • Strong interpersonal skills

  • Candidates must be well presented, mature, professional and have an outgoing personality

  • The ability to work efficiently in a high pressured and dynamic sporting environment

  • A good approach to teamwork and ability to manage a busy hospitality area

  • Ability to troubleshoot under pressure

  • Excellent customer service skills and spoken English required

  • Ability to use initiative and be creative

  • Strong customer service skills

  • Excellent communication skills

  • Ability to prioritise case load and manage time effectively

  • Confident and assertive

  • Ambition, passion and willingness to learn

Leeds United Football Club are now seeking experienced and motivated chefs to work home fixtures for the upcoming 2025/2026 football season. As a Chef, you will be contributing to the efficient running of one of our many kitchens and food offerings.

You will have the skills and passion to produce great food. You will be able to work independently or as part of a team whilst ensuring that you adhere to food health and hygiene regulations.

  • Calm and adaptable problem solver with a natural flair for hospitality

  • Basic Food Hygiene knowledge.

  • Must be over 18 years old

job.title: Casual Matchday Stewards
job.location: Anfield Stadium, Anfield Road Anfield Liverpool, United Kingdom
job.html_description:
What will you be doing?

  • Help provide a safe and secure environment on match days
  • Support and guide spectators, ensuring they feel welcome and informed
  • Enforce stadium regulations and promote fan safety
  • Respond to incidents calmly and professionally
  • Conduct security checks, including personal searches
  • Record and report incidents clearly and accurately
  • Work closely with your team to manage large crowds effectively.

Who are we looking for?

We’re looking for people who are:

  • Confident communicators who can engage with the public
  • Able to stay calm under pressure and handle challenging situations
  • Professional, reliable, and team-oriented
  • Comfortable managing conflict appropriately
  • Able to write clear and accurate reports
  • Aged 18 or over (required for this role).

About the Recruitment Process

Shortlisted candidates will be invited to attend a group induction and interview, which includes:

  • An introduction to the role from our Safety Team
  • Key responsibilities and expectations
  • A 1:1 interview to assess your suitability.

Our next recruitment event is scheduled for the evening of 12 October 2026. Suitable candidates will be invited to book onto an interview slot once the vacancy has closed and all applications have been reviewed.

Please submit your application to be considered for an invitation.

Training Requirement

This role requires you to complete a Level 2 Certificate in Spectator Safety
 (as required by the Sports Grounds Safety Authority).

  • This must be completed within 12 months of your first induction training
  • By applying, you confirm your commitment to completing this qualification.

Please note we may not be able to progress your application if this qualification is not completed within the required timeframe.

This is a casual position, offering variable hours including evenings and weekends on a flexible assignment basis.

Liverpool FC is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and vulnerable adults and expects all Colleagues and Volunteers to share this commitment.

At Liverpool Football Club, we have an unwavering commitment to equality, diversity and inclusion and are always looking to making a positive difference in the communities that we operate within. We are proud of our achievements in this area; maintaining the Premier League Equality Standard Advanced Level, becoming a founding signatory of the Football Association’s Football Leadership Diversity Code and being recognised as a leader in this important area on and off the pitch. We take our responsibilities in this area seriously and through the work being done across the club, we are committed to increasing the diversity of our people and becoming an increasingly inclusive workplace for all. We are committed to hiring great people representative of diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and skills across our entire business. If you share our enthusiasm and passion for inclusivity, then we want to hear from you.

job.html_description:
This role is ideal for individuals who enjoy working in fast-paced environments and take pride in delivering a high standard of service. Whether you have hospitality, bar experience, or are keen to develop your skills, we’d love to hear from you.

What will you be doing?

In this role, you will:

  • Deliver high-quality service within our hospitality lounges.
  • Provide bar service, including draft, bottled, and premium beverages (where applicable).
  • Serve food and drinks efficiently during busy service periods.
  • Support smooth and coordinated service during peak matchday times.
  • Maintain high presentation standards across dining and bar areas.
  • Follow food safety guidelines, including basic allergen awareness.

Please be aware that this role involves the handling and serving of alcoholic beverages, as well as various food products, including pork.

Who are we looking for?

We’re looking for people who are:

  • Confident working in a fast-paced, customer-facing environment.
  • Friendly, professional, and able to deliver great guest experiences.
  • Comfortable working as part of a team during busy events.
  • Willing to learn and follow service standards and procedures.
  • Committed to maintaining cleanliness and safety standards.
  • Experience in hospitality, customer service, or bar work is beneficial but not essential.

Please note: We may close this vacancy earlier than the advertised closing date if we receive a high volume of suitable applications. We therefore encourage interested candidates to apply as soon as possible.

This is a casual position, offering variable hours including evenings and weekends on a flexible assignment basis.

job.title: Casual Hospitality Hosts
job.location: Anfield Stadium, Anfield Road Anfield Liverpool, United Kingdom
job.html_description:
What will you be doing?

  • Welcome guests and deliver a high standard of customer service.
  • Carry out ticket checks, bag searches, and security wanding.
  • Escort guests to boxes, suites, and tables with professionalism.
  • Manage access points (doors, escalators, lifts) to ensure smooth guest flow.
  • Work closely with management, stewards, and safety teams.
  • Help create a safe, organised, and enjoyable environment for all guests.

Who are we looking for?

We’re looking for people who are:

  • Experienced in front-of-house or customer-facing roles.
  • Confident communicators with a calm and professional approach.
  • Passionate about delivering excellent customer service.
  • Experienced in front-of-house or customer-facing roles.
  • Friendly, approachable, and take pride in creating a welcoming atmosphere.
  • Able to remain calm and professional in busy environments.
  • Comfortable standing in one position for extended periods.

Additional Requirements

  • A strict dress code applies (full uniform provided).
  • Must be aged 18 or over (required for this role).

Training Requirement

This role requires you to complete a Level 2 Certificate in Spectator Safety (as required by the Sports Grounds Safety Authority).

  • This must be completed within 12 months of your first induction training.
  • By applying, you confirm your commitment to completing this qualification

Please note we may not be able to progress your application if this qualification is not completed within the required timeframe.

job.title: Steven Morgan SEN Senior Coordinator - LFC Foundation
job.location: Anfield Sports & Community Centre, United Kingdom
job.html_description:
We have an exciting opportunity for an individual to join our Liverpool FC Foundation Learning Department team as a SEN SMF - Senior Coordinator on a Fixed Term contract. 

This is an exciting opportunity to support the delivery of the Steve Morgan Foundation SEN Schools programme, delivered by LFC Foundation. Using the power of football and the appeal of Liverpool FC, the programme aims to inspire children and young people to learn, be active, improve their wellbeing and develop important life skills.

You will plan and deliver engaging sport, health, wellbeing and educational activities across schools and colleges, including PE sessions, classroom-based interventions and enrichment activities. You’ll also support teachers, coordinate key areas of the programme and build strong relationships with schools and other stakeholders.

We’re looking for someone who is flexible, professional and passionate about supporting children and young people with SEN, with the ability to adapt to the needs of the programme and wider LFC Foundation.

What will you be doing?

  • Support the Programme Manager with planning, developing and improving the SEN Schools programme and curriculum.
  • Lead on key areas of the programme, including education and PE delivery, and take responsibility for a designated group of schools.
  • Line manage and support the delivery team, including delivering CPD and sharing best practice.
  • Plan and deliver high-quality, inclusive sport, education and wellbeing interventions for children and young people of different ages, abilities and SEND needs.
  • Work closely with teachers, providing support, advice and training to build confidence in delivering high-quality PE.
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with partner schools and key stakeholders, promoting wider LFC Foundation opportunities.
  • Monitor programme performance against KPIs, producing reports, case studies and evidence of impact.
  • Maintain accurate programme data and monitoring information, including Salesforce reporting.
  • Ensure sessions meet relevant curriculum, risk assessment, health and safety and safeguarding requirements.
  • Support wider programme activity, including events, holiday camps and half-term provision, when required.
  • Commit to ongoing CPD and professional development.

Who are we looking for?

To be successful in this role, you will have previous experience of line managing and managing a team. You will have a passion for young people, the community and making a change and a proven track record of delivering sports coaching in schools to young people of all ages and abilities. You will have comprehensive knowledge of the PE national curriculum across KS1, KS2 & KS3 and an understanding of different teaching and learning styles. It is important you have a sound understanding on equality, diversity and inclusion and its application in the role of coach and awareness of safeguarding issues when working with children and young people.

You will be able to manage challenging behaviours, can perform under pressure and adapt accordingly to any situation. You will have the ability to organise and prioritise your workload effectively with a can-do attitude. You will have excellent communication skills and able to build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders. 

Essential qualifications

  • Hold or working towards the Level 3 TA & Level 4 HLTA award
  • Level 2 award in multi skills development in sport.

Why should you apply?

This is a full-time fixed term role (12 months) working 35 hours per week, 5 from 7 days with some weekend work required. The role is based at Anfield Sports Community Centre, Liverpool however the post holder will also be required to work from other locations across Merseyside from time to time and be willing to travel within England and Wales.

Please note, this vacancy may close early if we receive a high volume of applications, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

To reward your hard work and commitment we offer a competitive salary, 25 days holiday (plus 8 bank holidays and the option to purchase up to an additional 5 days) and access to our benefits kit bag which includes but not limited to:

  • Contributory pension scheme matching up to 5.5%
  • Life Assurance Cover
  • Free financial guidance and mortgage advice
  • Car salary sacrifice scheme for affordable driving
  • Cycle to Work scheme to keep you active
  • Purchase season ticket loans for easier commuting
  • Exclusive shopping discounts & cashback with top retailers
  • Will Writing Service for future planning
  • Employee Assistance Programme for confidential support
  • Medicash Health Cash Plan for everyday healthcare needs
  • Volunteering opportunities to give back to the community
  • Special LFC perks – retail discounts, partner offers, free LFCTV GO access, and priority tickets for matches, events & concerts

…and much more! LFC Benefits.pdf

At Liverpool Football Club, we have an unwavering commitment to equality, diversity and inclusion and are always looking to making a positive difference in the communities that we operate within. We are proud of our achievements in this area; maintaining the Premier League Equality Standard Advanced Level, becoming a founding signatory of the Football Association’s Football Leadership Diversity Code and being recognised as a leader in this important area on and off the pitch. We take our responsibilities in this area seriously and through the work being done across the club, we are committed to increasing the diversity of our people and becoming an increasingly inclusive workplace for all. We are committed to hiring great people representative of diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and skills across our entire business. If you share our enthusiasm and passion for inclusivity, then we want to hear from you.

Liverpool FC is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and vulnerable adults and expects all Colleagues and Volunteers to share this commitment. This role is subject to a satisfactory enhanced DBS check.

job.title: Casual Experienced Kitchen Assistants
job.location: Anfield Stadium, Anfield Road Anfield Liverpool, United Kingdom
job.html_description:
Based out of Anfield Stadium, you will be supporting our kitchen operation in a fast-paced, high-volume environment. Play a key role in maintaining high standards of cleanliness, hygiene and food safety, while supporting the wider kitchen team with day-to-day duties. 

This is a casual position offering variable hours on a flexible assignment basis. Due to the nature of the role, shifts may include early mornings, evenings, weekends, and bank holidays, as required.

Who are we looking for?

You will have:

  • Proven experience working as a Kitchen Assistant or in a similar back-of-house role. 
  • Experience working in a fast-paced, high-volume kitchen environment. 
  • Good understanding of kitchen hygiene, food safety and cleaning standards. 
  • Experience operating commercial dishwashers and pot wash equipment. 
  • Ability to safely handle and store cleaning chemicals. 
  • Able to undertake the manual handling requirements of the role, including standing for extended periods and lifting, carrying and moving stock or equipment. 
  • Ability to follow instructions, work effectively with colleagues and work independently when required.

Desirable Skills and Experience

  • Experience working in a stadium, hotel, event venue or similar fast-paced hospitality setting.
  • A Food Safety Level 2 qualification.
  • COSHH awareness or training.
  • Experience with stock deliveries, storage and stock rotation.
  • Experience assisting chefs with basic food preparation tasks.

Due to the nature of this role, applicants must be 18 years of age or over at the time of application. Unfortunately, we are unable to consider applications from anyone under the age of 18 for this role.

Please note: We may close this vacancy earlier than the advertised closing date if we receive a high volume of suitable applications. We therefore encourage interested candidates to apply as soon as possible.

Why should you apply?

This is a casual position, offering variable hours including evenings and weekends on a flexible assignment basis.

job.title: Premier League Kicks Community Coach (15-hour FTC) - LFC Foundation
job.location: Anfield Sports & Community Centre, United Kingdom
job.html_description:
Join Premier League Kicks, the Premier League’s flagship community programme, using the power of football to inspire and support young people aged 8–18 across the Liverpool City Region.

You’ll deliver safe, engaging football and youth-led sessions that encourage participation, inclusion and personal development. Working within local communities, you’ll help engage young people who may be at risk of anti-social behaviour or youth violence, creating positive opportunities and helping to build stronger, safer communities.

This is a 15-hour-per-week role, with evening delivery required on four out of five weekdays, primarily after 5pm.

Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities: 

  • Deliver high-quality, engaging football sessions to young people aged 8 to 17 years old.
  • Support our Mini-Kicks fundamentals programme for ages 4-7.
  • Deliver support to young people focusing on building skills, character and confidence to help them steer away from engaging in offending behaviour.  
  • Deliver and support the development of high-quality sessions, ensuring they are inclusive to all participants who access the provision.  
  • Deliver high-quality appropriate to the age and ability of participants.  
  • Deliver and support PL Kicks sessions which engage and support young people within our communities.  
  • Deliver PL Kicks sessions which are safe to all.  
  • Deliver and support half-term provisions across the Sport and Football Department, primarily led by The PL Kicks programme. This will be a wide range of sessions such as workshops, tournaments and half-term football camps.  
  • To produce and evaluate all activities, following all quality assurance procedures to ensure we consistently deliver high-quality provision.  
  • To undertake dynamic risk assessments.  
  • To always adhere to LFC Foundation Safeguarding procedures and policies.  
  • To ensure that all LFC Foundation equipment is in good working order and assembled properly – to report to the Foundation any equipment that needs attention.  
  • To support the programme to develop all reporting requirements which are set by stakeholders such as mid-year, end-of-year and case studies.  
  • Manage risks across all venues to ensure the safety of all young people and staff.  
  • To support other areas of the LFC Foundation when required.  
  • Ensure the safeguarding of young people is at the forefront of all decisions and that the Foundation’s safeguarding policy is always adhered to.  
  • Develop lasting relationships with key stakeholders across Merseyside.  
  • Manage relationships with stakeholders highlighting those who are ‘at risk’.  
  • Support across all of The PL Kicks programme to help contribute to provisions working towards KPI’s.  

Who we are looking for:

Essential Knowledge  

  • Planning and delivering structured and engaging football sessions  
  • Working with vulnerable children and young people 
  • Understanding of inclusive youth work practice  
  • Knowledge of mentoring in a youth work context  
  • Build relationships with key stakeholders  
  • Experience in signposting young people to further opportunities  
  • Commitment to Liverpool FC Foundation mission and values 
  • Excellent verbal, written and presentation skills  
  • Ability to evaluate successes and areas for development  
  • Strong organisation skills.   

Essential Functional / Technical Skills 

  • FA Level 1 Qualification 
  • Youth work qualification or experience with youth work modules.   
  • Level 1 in Safeguarding Young People 
  • Competency in Word, Excel and PowerPoint 
  • Experience in collecting and analysing data 

Why should you apply? 

 This is a part time position, offering 15 hours including evenings and ocasional weekends on a Fixed Term Contract. Your main base will be Anfield Sports & Community Centre, but our programmes are mainly delivered across Liverpool City Region.

Please note, this vacancy may close early if we receive a high volume of applications, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

To reward your hard work and commitment we offer a competitive salary, 25 days holiday (plus 8 bank holidays and the option to purchase up to an additional 5 days) and access to our benefits kit bag which includes but not limited to:

  • Contributory pension scheme matching up to 5.5%
  • Life Assurance Cover
  • Free financial guidance and mortgage advice
  • Car salary sacrifice scheme for affordable driving
  • Cycle to Work scheme to keep you active
  • Purchase season ticket loans for easier commuting
  • Exclusive shopping discounts & cashback with top retailers
  • Will Writing Service for future planning
  • Employee Assistance Programme for confidential support
  • Medicash Health Cash Plan for everyday healthcare needs
  • Volunteering opportunities to give back to the community
  • Special LFC perks – retail discounts, partner offers, free LFCTV GO access, and priority tickets for matches, events & concerts

…and much more! LFC Benefits.pdf

- Deliver high-quality, engaging football sessions to young people aged 8 to 17 years old. - Support our Mini-Kicks fundamentals programme for ages 4-7. - Deliver support to young people focusing on building skills, character and confidence to help them steer away from engaging in offending behaviour. - Deliver and support the development of high-quality sessions, ensuring they are inclusive to all participants who access the provision. - Deliver high-quality appropriate to the age and ability of participants. - Deliver and support PL Kicks sessions which engage and support young people within our communities. - Deliver PL Kicks sessions which are safe to all. - Deliver and support half-term provisions across the Sport and Football Department, primarily led by The PL Kicks programme. This will be a wide range of sessions such as workshops, tournaments and half-term football camps. - To produce and evaluate all activities, following all quality assurance procedures to ensure we consistently deliver high-quality provision. - To undertake dynamic risk assessments. - To always adhere to LFC Foundation Safeguarding procedures and policies. - To ensure that all LFC Foundation equipment is in good working order and assembled properly – to report to the Foundation any equipment that needs attention. - To support the programme to develop all reporting requirements which are set by stakeholders such as mid-year, end-of-year and case studies. - Manage risks across all venues to ensure the safety of all young people and staff. - To support other areas of the LFC Foundation when required. - Ensure the safeguarding of young people is at the forefront of all decisions and that the Foundation’s safeguarding policy is always adhered to. - Develop lasting relationships with key stakeholders across Merseyside. - Manage relationships with stakeholders highlighting those who are ‘at risk’. - Support across all of The PL Kicks programme to help contribute to provisions working towards KPI’s.
Who we are looking for:
Essential Knowledge
- Planning and delivering structured and engaging football sessions - Working with vulnerable children and young people - Understanding of inclusive youth work practice - Knowledge of mentoring in a youth work context - Build relationships with key stakeholders - Experience in signposting young people to further opportunities - Commitment to Liverpool FC Foundation mission and values - Excellent verbal, written and presentation skills - Ability to evaluate successes and areas for development - Strong organisation skills.
Essential Functional / Technical Skills
- FA Level 1 Qualification - Youth work qualification or experience with youth work modules. - Level 1 in Safeguarding Young People - Competency in Word, Excel and PowerPoint - Experience in collecting and analysing data
Why should you apply?
This is a part time position, offering 15 hours including evenings and ocasional weekends on a Fixed Term Contract. Your main base will be Anfield Sports & Community Centre, but our programmes are mainly delivered across Liverpool City Region.
Please note, this vacancy may close early if we receive a high volume of applications, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.
To reward your hard work and commitment we offer a competitive salary, 25 days holiday (plus 8 bank holidays and the option to purchase up to an additional 5 days) and access to our benefits kit bag which includes but not limited to:
- Contributory pension scheme matching up to 5.5% - Life Assurance Cover - Free financial guidance and mortgage advice - Car salary sacrifice scheme for affordable driving - Cycle to Work scheme to keep you active - Purchase season ticket loans for easier commuting - Exclusive shopping discounts & cashback with top retailers - Will Writing Service for future planning - Employee Assistance Programme for confidential support - Medicash Health Cash Plan for everyday healthcare needs - Volunteering opportunities to give back to the community - Special LFC perks – retail discounts, partner offers, free LFCTV GO access, and priority tickets for matches, events & concerts
…and much more! LFC Benefits.pdf

We are committed to hiring great people representative of diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and skills across our entire business. job.title: Academy Talent ID Lead
job.location: The Academy, Liverpool Way, Kirkby, United Kingdom
job.html_description:
Responsible for leading the strategic identification and recruitment of elite academy talent aged 13-18 across the UK and Ireland. This role will define and execute talent identification strategy for players requiring compensation, oversee all stages of the scouting and assessment process, and lead a team of scouts to deliver high-quality player recommendations that strengthen the Academy's long-term talent pipeline.

What you will be doing:

  • Develop a robust strategy and lead all aspects of scouting and talent identification for UK and Ireland based players aged 13 – 18, where compensation is payable.
  • Develop and line manage a team of full-time staff and casual staff responsible for UK and Ireland based players.  
  • Recommend and present high potential young players to senior staff on a regular basis. 
  • Work in collaboration with the Academy Chief Scout to support our recruitment strategy to sign high potential players who can join the academy.  
  • Maintain an expert knowledge of LFC academy players aged 13 – 18 and play a critical role in squad planning, supporting the retention of our high potential signed players including discussions about scholarship and professional contract offers. 
  • Oversee the UK and Ireland trialist process and coordinate player visits with academy coaches and staff.
  • Drive innovation across our UK scouting and develop strategic partnerships to support the progression of our UK scouting strategy.
  • Lead on the promotion, training and adherence of the clubs grading procedure across UK and Ireland scouts.
  • Oversee and execute CPD for all UK and Ireland scouts, linked with the LFC Football Methodology.
  • Abide by the FA & LFC Safeguarding rules and regulations working with young children. 
  • Oversee UK and Ireland scouting budget. 

What we are looking for:
Essential Knowledge / Behaviours  

  • A thorough understanding of Premier League/EFL rules and Elite Player Performance Plan 
  • A robust network across the North West to source information on available players.
  • Knowledge of essential developmental periods surrounding player growth and maturation. 
  • Knowledge of recruitment processes, specifically related to FA/FAW 
  • Effective and efficient in a dynamic, fast-paced environment  
  • Strong communication and presentation skills in a variety of settings
  • Ability to work as part of a broader multidisciplinary team  
  • Competent IT skills e.g., Microsoft Office, PMA familiarity.  
  • Ability to maintain absolute confidentiality 
  • Passionate, hard working with a desire to make a contribution. 
  • Proactive ‘can-do’ approach to work and those around them 
  • Work to our ‘We not Me’ ethos and culture 
  • Self-motivated within a team and capable of motivating those around them  

Essential Functional / Technical Skills 

  • Talent ID Level 4
  • Experience of working within an elite sporting environment 
  • Working with player representatives 
  • Experience working within player recruitment in a football academy environment  
  • Experience of developing player databases  

Please note, this vacancy may close early if we receive a high volume of applications, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

To reward your hard work and commitment we offer a competitive salary, 25 days holiday (plus 8 bank holidays and the option to purchase up to an additional 5 days) and access to our benefits kit bag which includes but not limited to:

  • Contributory pension scheme matching up to 5.5%
  • Life Assurance Cover
  • Free financial guidance and mortgage advice
  • Car salary sacrifice scheme for affordable driving
  • Cycle to Work scheme to keep you active
  • Purchase season ticket loans for easier commuting
  • Exclusive shopping discounts & cashback with top retailers
  • Will Writing Service for future planning
  • Employee Assistance Programme for confidential support
  • Medicash Health Cash Plan for everyday healthcare needs
  • Volunteering opportunities to give back to the community
  • Special LFC perks – retail discounts, partner offers, free LFCTV GO access, and priority tickets for matches, events & concerts

…and much more! LFC Benefits.pdf

We are proud of our achievements in this area; maintaining the Premier League Equality Standard Advanced Level, becoming a founding signatory of the Football Association’s Football Leadership Diversity Code and being recognised as a leader in this important area on and off the pitch. job.title: Academy- Lead Athletic Development Coach
job.location: GEODIS Park, 2226 Bransford Ave, Nashville, Tennessee, United States of America
job.html_description:
NO PHONE CALLS OR EMAILS, PLEASE.  Thanks for your interest! Due to the volume of applications, we’re unable to respond to individual status inquiries. If selected to move forward, you’ll hear from our HR team at Nashville Soccer Club.

POSITION OVERVIEW
The Athletic Development Coach will lead the Long-Term Athletic Development (LTAD) program for the Nashville SC Academy in alignment with the High Performance philosophy. This role works closely with High Performance staff across NSC and HCFC to design and implement team and individual programs, both in the gym and on the field, to optimize youth athlete development.
The ideal candidate has coaching or strength & conditioning experience, formal education in exercise physiology or a related field, and expertise in load management for youth soccer.
This position reports to the Director of High Performance and the Head of Athletic Development for the First Team, and collaborates with the Academy Director, Athletic Trainers, and performance staff to support a collaborative, high-performance environment.
This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to the development of elite youth soccer players!
 
RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Lead and oversee on-field warm-ups, cool-downs, strength training, and prehabilitation sessions, as well as individualized training for targeted or rehabilitating players in collaboration with medical staff.
  • Design and implement individual and team off-season training programs.
  • Foster strong relationships with players and staff to effectively deliver performance programs.
  • Develop educational materials to promote best practices in athletic development and sport performance, aligning with the High Performance department’s initiatives.
  • Organize and maintain field and gym equipment.
  • Travel with the team to games and events as needed.
  • Stay current with the latest research and best practices for future program implementation.
  • Contribute to and enhance LTAD programming, including data collection, testing, analytics, and reporting to optimize youth player performance.
  • Manage player performance data, including distributing devices, processing and inputting data, wellness monitoring, testing administration, RPE collection, analysis, and reporting.
  • Utilize performance monitoring tools and technologies to track player performance and support injury prevention strategies.
MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS
  • Undergraduate (Bachelor’s) Degree from a 4-year accredited University in related field of study such as Kinesiology, Exercise Science, Sport Science, Biomechanics, Strength & Conditioning, and/or similar
  • NSCA-CSCS (Certified Strength & Conditioning Specialist)
  • CPR Certification

PREFERRED

  • Graduate (Master’s) Degree from an accredited University in related field of study
  • 2-3 years experience working with youth soccer within the United States
  • NSCA-CPSS (Certified Performance and Sport Scientist)
  • Functional Movement Screening (FMS) and Selective Functional Movement Assessment (SFMA) Level 1
  • Bilingual in English and Spanish
 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.

job.title: Team Operations - Performance Scientist
job.location: GEODIS Park, 2226 Bransford Ave, Nashville, Tennessee, United States of America
job.html_description:
NO PHONE CALLS OR EMAILS, PLEASE.  Thanks for your interest! Due to the volume of applications, we’re unable to respond to individual status inquiries. If selected to move forward, you’ll hear from our HR team at Nashville Soccer Club.

Position Title: Performance Scientist

Department: Team Operations- High Performance

Reports to: Director of High Performance

 

POSITION OVERVIEW

The Performance Scientist supports player availability and performance by leading sport science data operations, monitoring, reporting, and applied insights that inform training, recovery, and return-to-performance decisions. This role reports directly to the Director of High Performance and works in close collaboration to define the path forward for key initiatives. The Performance Scientist will be provided autonomy to determine the best execution plan, while ensuring alignment with coaching, performance, and medical priorities.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own end-to-end sports science data operations (collection, QA/QC, documentation, and governance) across performance data streams.
  • Lead training and match monitoring systems (e.g., STS) and related technologies (GPS, heart rate, VALD, 1080 and others), ensuring reliable workflows and clean outputs.
  • Build and maintain dashboards, models, metrics, and reports that track workload, readiness, and physical performance across the season.
  • Deliver clear, actionable insights to coaches, performance/medical staff, and players (including real-time training feedback when needed).
  • Plan and execute performance testing and assessment protocols (field and gym-based); maintain benchmarks and individualized targets.
  • Collaborate with Athletic Development and Medical on activation, strength/regeneration, and end-stage return-to-performance support as needed.
  • Partner with analytics and scouting on performance questions tied to player evaluation, transactions, and projections.
  • Lead integration of second team and academy performance data into centralized systems, standards, and reporting.
  • Ensure compliance with all MLS medical manual requirements and club policies and procedures.

KEY DELIVERABLES

  • Readiness/availability updates aligned with training plans and performance/medical direction.
  • Stakeholder dashboards and reports with clear KPI definitions and refresh cadence.
  • Testing battery execution and reporting with benchmarks, targets, and action steps.
  • Multi-squad integration outputs (first team/second team/academy) using shared standards and longitudinal tracking.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • Master’s degree in Exercise Science or related field.
  • Certified Performance and Sport Scientist (CPSS).
  • Certified Strength and Conditioning Specialist (CSCS).
  • Minimum 2 years experience in an elite sport environment.
  • Demonstrated proficiency with GPS systems, heart rate, force plates, and current performance technologies.
  • Experience in a coach-facing role explaining monitoring outputs and real-time GPS results.
  • Proficiency in R, Python, and Power BI for data analysis and reporting.
  • Current CPR/AED certification (or ability to obtain promptly).

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience querying cloud databases and supporting automated/real-time reporting (e.g., SQL, ETL, APIs).
  • Comfortable conversing in Spanish.
  • Experience scaling sport science systems across multiple squads (first team + second team + academy).
  • Strong data QA habits and reproducible workflows (e.g., documentation, version control).

We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.

job.title: Ticketing - Box Office Representative PT
job.location: GEODIS Park, 2226 Bransford Ave, Nashville, Tennessee, United States of America
job.html_description:
POSITION OVERVIEW
The Ticket Office Representative is a part-time, event-day position responsible for providing exceptional customer service and assisting fans with ticket purchases and inquiries at GEODIS Park. This role plays an important part in delivering a seamless matchday experience by supporting ticket sales, processing transactions, and resolving ticket-related questions. Applicants must reside in the Nashville area.

RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Process ticket sales through Ticketmaster and assist guests with ticket purchases and ticketing issues.
  • Provide clear, friendly, and professional customer service throughout all interactions.
  • Address general inquiries related to seating options, pricing, stadium policies, and event information.
  • Accurately complete credit card and cash transactions in accordance with Club procedures.
  • Reconcile and balance cash drawers at the end of each shift.
  • Support Box Office leadership with additional duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS
  • Prior customer service or ticketing experience preferred, but not required.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to remain professional in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to learn and navigate ticketing software quickly (experience with Ticketmaster is a plus).
  • Reliable, punctual, and able to work Nashville SC home matches, special events, nights, weekends, and holidays as needed.
  • Must be detail-oriented and comfortable handling cash and sensitive customer information.
  • Candidates without a degree are encouraged to apply.

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.

job.title: Backup Mascot
job.location: GEODIS Park, 2226 Bransford Ave, Nashville, Tennessee, United States of America
job.html_description:
Nashville SC is looking for highly motivated individuals interested in being a part of the Major League Soccer team in Nashville. The ideal candidates will demonstrate initiative, the ability to multi-task, a willingness to learn and a positive attitude. Please note: This is a part-time, as needed Backup position.

Employment Type: Part-Time

 

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

· Study and learn Tempo the Coyote's mannerisms and characteristics

· Assist Tempo the Coyote at home matches

· Provide support at select appearances, including birthday parties, parades, school visits, hospital visits, charitable events, and other events coordinated by Tempo the Coyote

· Assist in maintaining the condition of costumes and props

· Other duties as assigned by Tempo the Coyote

· Please note this is a part-time, as needed Backup position.

 

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

· Knowledge and interest in sports.

· Knowledge and interest in mascots.

· Computer proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

· Proficient in social media.

· Strong communication skills and telephone etiquette.

· Mascot Experience (College or Professional)

 

REQUIREMENTS:

· Available as needed for Tempo the Coyote appearances.

· Available to assist with home matches.

· The understanding that working in sports is different than being a fan. This position does not guarantee candidates will be able to watch games. Many valuable positions within the organization are behind the scenes, and they provide little ability to watch the games.

· Tempo the Coyote Height Range: 5'7 - 5'10.

 

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.

· Please note this is a part-time, as needed Backup position.
DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS:
· Knowledge and interest in sports.
· Knowledge and interest in mascots.
· Computer proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
· Proficient in social media.
· Strong communication skills and telephone etiquette.
· Mascot Experience (College or Professional)
REQUIREMENTS:
· Available as needed for Tempo the Coyote appearances.
· Available to assist with home matches.
· The understanding that working in sports is different than being a fan. This position does not guarantee candidates will be able to watch games. Many valuable positions within the organization are behind the scenes, and they provide little ability to watch the games.
· Tempo the Coyote Height Range: 5'7 - 5'10.
We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.

job.title: Youth Soccer Coach - Part Time
job.html_description:
Position Summary
Nashville Soccer Club is seeking energetic, reliable, and knowledgeable coaches to support the delivery of its Youth Soccer Programs. This role focuses on camps, clinics, grassroots programming, Academy pathway programs and coach education initiatives across the Nashville community. The role is centered on player development programming within the Youth Soccer Department. Coaches will represent Nashville SC while delivering high-quality soccer experiences that are fun, inclusive, and developmentally appropriate. This position is part-time, with flexible scheduling based on program needs, including evenings, weekends, and seasonal peak periods. Strong performers may be considered for expanded responsibilities or future full-time opportunities within the club. This is not an academy coaching position.

Duties & Responsibilities
  • Deliver engaging and age-appropriate coaching sessions at camps, clinics, and grassroots programs.
  • Implement Nashville SC Youth Soccer curriculum and session plans across all youth programming.
  • Create a positive, safe, and inclusive environment for all participants.
  • Support event operations including setup, check-in, and breakdown of sessions.
  • Serve as a club ambassador, maintaining professionalism with players, parents, and partners.
  • Assist with coaching education sessions and mentorship initiatives when required.
  • Provide feedback on player development and program delivery when requested.
  • Ensure all safety, risk management, and safeguarding standards are followed.
Qualifications
  • Previous coaching experience in youth soccer (recreational, grassroots, or club level required).
  • Passion for working with children and developing players of all ability levels.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work flexible hours including evenings and weekends.
  • Reliable transportation to program locations across the Greater Nashville area.
  • US Soccer Grassroots (or equivalent) License or higher (or willingness to obtain).
  • Experience working in a youth development environment (Rec, Club, Academy or camps).
  • Background in player development models.
  • Ability to be active for extended periods (standing, running, demonstrating drills)
  • Ability to lift and carry equipment up to 30 lbs

job.title: Soccer Squad (Part-Time)
job.html_description:
Position Summary:
Nashville SC Soccer Squad will serve as community ambassadors for the Club at key community-based events and programs throughout Nashville. This group will be integral to executing community outreach through soccer programming. The Soccer Squad will also serve as an extension of the Community Engagement department by assisting with our core youth soccer programs including Grassroots Soccer, IMPACT Soccer, MNPS P.L.A.Y.S., and more.
Essential Duties & Responsibilities:
  • Facilitate soccer-specific activations at community engagement events while providing superb customer service and displaying excitement about the organization.
  • Act as an extension of the club’s community engagement department by providing information on various soccer programs.
  • Assist with program set-up and breakdown. 
  • Collect and report valuable feedback and insights after each event to provide back to the team supervisors.
Shift Information:
  • Must be able to work flexible hours including evenings, weekends, and holidays.
  • Some shifts will require picking up materials to transport to the event site, plus setting up and taking down materials.
Qualifications:
  • A general interest and working knowledge of the sport of soccer. 
  • Should be able to answer basic questions about the game, NSC’s schedule and roster, etc.
  • Experience playing the game and coaching youth is preferred but not required.
  • Strong people and communication skills. 
  • Comfortable promoting and interacting with new people at NSC events with a fun and positive attitude.
  • Collaborative personality who works well with others on their team. 
  • Enjoys engaging with team members and is responsive to messages.
  • Must have transportation, a good driving record, and valid driver’s license.
  • Reliable and punctual, being on-time is important to you.
  • Bilingual (English & Spanish) is helpful but not required.
  • Must be able to move and lift a minimum of 50 pounds.
  • Background check is required.

job.title: Academy- Goalkeeper Coach PT
job.location: GEODIS Park, 2226 Bransford Ave, Nashville, Tennessee, United States of America
job.html_description:
NO PHONE CALLS OR EMAILS, PLEASE.  Thanks for your interest! Due to the volume of applications, we’re unable to respond to individual status inquiries. If selected to move forward, you’ll hear from our HR team at Nashville Soccer Club.

POSITION OVERVIEW:
The Academy Part-Time Goalkeeper Coach will be responsible for the U14 and U15 academy goalkeepers. The goalkeeper coach will be tasked with constructing and executing individualized goalkeeper sessions as well as assisting head coaches on the field where necessary. This person will work closely with the Academy Goalkeeper coach, as well as academy staff and must adhere to all club and league requirements. The ideal candidate must have previous experience in the role of goalkeeper both as a player and coach.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Be able to work roughly 20 hours per week, mainly afternoon sessions with our younger age groups- U14 and U15 boys.
• Construct and execute individualized goalkeeper sessions geared towards our style of play and model
• Assist with Head coach needs during a training session
• Actively participate in player individualized meetings and communicate with academy goalkeepers
• Availability to attend home matches on the weekend on a need basis
• Complete Club and League registration requirements including background checks, SafeSport, Heads up.
QUALIFICATIONS:
• Playing and coaching experience in the Goalkeeper position
• Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.
• Strong ability to communicate and work under pressure.
• Passion for youth soccer and knowledge of MLS
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience preferred.
• Ability to speak Spanish is a plus.

job.title: Academy- Assistant Performance Coach PT
job.location: GEODIS Park, 2226 Bransford Ave, Nashville, Tennessee, United States of America
job.html_description:
NO PHONE CALLS OR EMAILS, PLEASE.  Thanks for your interest! Due to the volume of applications, we’re unable to respond to individual status inquiries. If selected to move forward, you’ll hear from our HR team at Nashville Soccer Club.

POSITION OVERVIEW
The part-time Assistant Performance Coach for the Nashville SC Academy will be responsible for supporting and assisting the club by providing an integrated High-Performance LTAD program for it’s Academy players, in line with the Club and Performance department philosophy. This position will work closely with the Academy Director, Academy Performance Coach, and Academy Medical Department to create team and player-specific programs and administer those programs on the field and in the gym for developing youth athletes within the Academy. The person in this role should have prior playing and/or coaching experience and be expected to comfortably facilitate soccer-centric programs.  In addition, they should also have a formal educational background in exercise physiology (or similar degree) and load management across a variety of metrics as it relates to the development of youth soccer athletes.  This role will report directly to the Head of Performance for the First Team and will work closely with the Academy Director, Academy Performance Coach and Academy Athletic Trainer, as well as various other key coaches/staff.

RESPONSIBILITIES
  • This position will direct and/or assist in the following areas:
  • Assisting, managing and directing on-field warm up and cool down sessions, strength training, prehabilitation, as well as individual sessions for targeted or rehabilitating players in conjunction with medical staff
  • Distribution of player devices and processing data into club systems on a daily basis, along with wellness monitoring, testing administration, RPE collection, compiling, analysis, and reporting
  • Utilizing various monitoring software, tools and technologies to report on player performance and injury prevention
  • Direct and/or assist with the delivery of scientifically based optimal recovery strategies post trining and post-match
  • Help develop and implement individual and/or team off-season programs
  • Help develop strong interpersonal relationships with players and staff to effectively administer programs
  • Help producing educational materials for players to guide towards best practices in the development and optimization of sport performance
  • Organizing and maintaining field and gym equipment
  • Surveying literature and best practices for future implementation
  • Contribute to and advance LTAD programming and curriculum, data collection, testing, analytics, and reporting to develop high-performance in youth players
  • Occasional travel with team to games/events

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS
  • Undergraduate (Bachelor’s) Degree from a 4-year accredited University in related field of study such as Kinesiology, Exercise Science, Sport Science, Biomechanics, Strength & Conditioning, and/or similar
  • NSCA-CSCS (Certified Strength & Conditioning Specialist)
  • CPR Certification
PREFERRED
  • Graduate (Master’s) Degree from an accredited University in related field of study
  • 2-3 years experience working with youth soccer within the United States
  • XPS-EXOS Performance Specialist
  • Functional Movement Screening (FMS) – Certified Level 1/2
  • Bilingual in Spanish and English
HOURS
  • 15-20 hours per week
  • Nights and weekend availability
 

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.
