job.title: Marketing - Street Team PT
job.location: GEODIS Park, 2226 Bransford Ave, Nashville, Tennessee, United States of America
job.html_description:
Position Summary
Nashville SC Street Team members serve as key community ambassadors for the Club throughout the 2025 season. This role supports fan engagement at public appearances, home matches, away watch parties, and community events across the Nashville area. Street Team members play a vital role in strengthening fan loyalty by enhancing the matchday and event experience, while also serving as an extension of the Club’s Marketing and Entertainment teams.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities
  • Facilitate on-site activations and promotional events while delivering exceptional customer service and representing the Club with energy and professionalism.
  • Serve as an extension of the Marketing Department by promoting club initiatives, ticket programs, and brand messaging.
  • Assist guests as part of the GEODIS Park guest experience team when needed.
  • Actively engage with fans to encourage participation in activations, distribute giveaways, and provide event-specific information.
  • Assist with the setup, operation, and breakdown of interactive displays, promotional booths, and event materials.
  • Distribute marketing collateral in an organized and professional manner.
  • Collect and report feedback, observations, and insights following events to supervisors.
  • Support pre-match activities, including Opening Act activations (e.g., Kick Wall, premium tailgate).
  • Serve as a matchday runner for the Nashville SC Entertainment team as needed.
  • Assist with matchday entertainment management, hospitality, and game presentation needs.
  • Support production logistics, including entertainment personnel arrival, load-in, and load-out.

Shift Information
  • Shifts include all home matches, the majority of away matches, and additional off-site community events throughout the season.
  • Hours vary by event schedule, with an expected commitment of approximately 5–15 hours per week during the season.
  • Some shifts require transporting materials to and from event locations and assisting with setup and teardown.

Qualifications
  • Ability to commit to all Nashville SC matchdays (home and away) with minimal scheduling conflicts.
  • General interest in and working knowledge of soccer, including basic understanding of Nashville SC’s schedule and roster.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills with a positive, outgoing attitude.
  • Comfortable engaging with fans and promoting club initiatives in public settings.
  • Team-oriented, collaborative mindset.
  • Willingness to learn club promotions, ticket programs, and soccer-related information (training provided).
  • Reliable transportation, valid driver’s license, and a good driving record.
  • Availability to work evenings, weekends, and select holidays.
  • Dependable, punctual, and professional.
  • Ability to lift and move materials exceeding 50 lbs.
  • Ability to maintain professionalism when interacting with VIP-level personnel.
  • Bilingual (English/Spanish) preferred but not required.
  • Prior experience in promotions, events, or brand ambassador roles preferred.

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.

job.title: Performance Nutritionist
job.html_description:
Position Summary

Under the direction of the Director of High Performance, the Performance Nutritionist is primarily responsible for the development and execution of nutrition services for the first team, providing individualized and team-based nutrition support that optimizes player health, adaptation, recovery, and performance. This role requires a high level of organization and communication to facilitate collaboration with team operations, high performance staff, and the culinary team.

 

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Develop, implement, and evaluate a comprehensive nutrition program designed for optimal performance: the evaluation, interpretation, and monitoring of the nutritional status and nutritional needs of the team, using established standards of care and practice guidelines.
  • Conduct nutrition assessments, care planning, education, and counseling of athletes and staff, including personalized nutrition services and medical nutrition therapy for athletes with clinical nutrition needs and food allergies, integrated with the individual athlete’s nutrition goals as indicated.
  • Design, implement, and oversee an evidence-based supplementation program, prioritizing NSF Certified for Sport (or equivalent third-party banned-substance-tested) products, with ongoing education and monitoring to ensure compliance with MLS rules, regulations, and nutrition-related bylaws and to minimize inadvertent doping risk.
  • Order, interpret, and act on blood biomarker panels (e.g., iron/ferritin, vitamin D, complete metabolic and lipid panels, CBC, inflammatory markers) in collaboration with team physicians, translating findings into individualized lifestyle, fueling, and supplement recommendations that optimize athlete performance and health.
  • Leads and conducts individual and team nutrition counseling and education sessions; development of effective individual nutrition prescriptions and educational materials for athletes.
  • This position will require strong communication skills, both verbal and written and the ability to collaborate with Coaches, Sports Medicine staff, Strength and Conditioning staff, physicians, and other support staff to ensure a collaborative and comprehensive approach to training, nutrition and recovery, as well as aiding in the treatment of diet and nutritional related medical issues.
  • Coordinate and implement nutritional recovery process through pre- and post-competition menus with training ground chefs; oversee and implement catering and meals during team travel with hotels. Coordinate/manage quantity food production, inventory and distribution, of other food products, supplements and beverages. oversee ordering, vendor relationships, procurement of goods and payment of purchases.
  • Body Composition testing (DEXA and other) including assessment, education, and programming regarding the nutritional needs. Conduct body composition assessments by utilizing and maintaining appropriate technology (i.e. DEXA, BodPod or InBody) and other manual anthropometric testing (i.e. ISAK).
  • Implementation of hydration testing and strategies.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

 

 

Requirements

  • Registered Dietitian, by the Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics, must be Registered and Licensed by the Accreditation Council for Education in Nutrition and Dietetics (ACEND) of the Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics and licensed in the state of Tennessee of a minimum of 2 years. 
  • Master’s degree from an accredited college or university in Dietetics, Kinesiology, Exercise Science, Biology, or other Health Sciences related field.
  • Excellent multi-tasking and prioritization skills.
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including: evenings and weekends, with possible travel.  Must be available for in-person work/team interaction at an average of 15-25 hours per week.
  • Candidate should possess strong computer knowledge including proficiency utilizing Microsoft Office and other relevant software.
  • Professional, collegiate or club level sport nutrition experience.
  • Demonstrated proficiency interpreting blood biomarker panels and translating results into actionable lifestyle, fueling, and supplement recommendations, with working knowledge of third-party supplement testing/certification standards (e.g., NSF Certified for Sport) and anti-doping regulations relevant to professional sport.

 

Preferred but not required:

  • Bilingual in English and Spanish
  • Eligible to be Board Certified as a Specialist in Sports Dietetics (CSSD).
  • Soccer experience
  • Certified Strength and Conditioning Specialist, through NSCA (National Strength & Conditioning Association)
  • ISAK certified 
  • Certified in Sports Nutrition (CISSN, ISSN) or comparable applied supplementation credential
  • Experience partnering with physicians on blood panel-driven nutrition and supplementation protocols
  • Experience in research, data collection, analysis of monitored stats, and evaluation of technology used by Sports Science/Performance department.

job.title: Account Executive, Ticket Sales
job.html_description:
The Account Executive, Ticket Sales is responsible for generating new revenue through the sale of season tickets, premium seating, and group ticket packages for Nashville SC. This role will have a primary focus on full season memberships and premium inventory, while also contributing to group sales and select non-soccer events at GEODIS Park (concerts, international matches, and more). The Account Executive will report directly to the Manager of Ticket Sales.  

Key Responsibilities

  • Drive new business by selling season tickets, premium seating, and group ticket packages.
  • Consistently meet and exceed weekly, monthly, and annual sales goals.
  • Execute outbound sales strategies including cold calls, prospecting, networking, and referral generation.
  • Conduct a pre-determined number of weekly face-to-face meetings and outbound calls to develop new opportunities.
  • Deliver a best-in-class customer experience for all clients, from first touch to post-sale service.
  • Develop and implement creative sales strategies to maximize revenue.
  • Actively contribute to a collaborative, high-energy sales team culture.
  • Participate in regular sales meetings, training sessions, and ongoing professional development.

Qualifications: 

  • Minimum of 6 months of sales experience, preferably in sports, entertainment, or a related industry, 1 year of sales experience preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Sports Management, or a related field preferred.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to build lasting relationships.
  • High energy, self-motivated, and team-oriented with a passion for driving results.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint); experience with Salesforce and Archtics preferred. 
  • Flexible work schedule, including evenings, weekends, and holidays as required.
  • Soccer knowledge a plus, but not required.

job.title: Graphic Designer, Partnerships & Revenue
job.html_description:
The Graphic Designer, Partnerships & Revenue will gain hands on experience in partnership visual storytelling, presentation design, brand integration, sports marketing, and cross-functional creative collaboration. This is an opportunity to build a creative career in professional sports while contributing work that reaches partners, fans, and the matchday experience

 

Reporting to the Creative Director and serves as a liaison between the Partnerships and Marketing creative teams, the graphic designer will help bring partnership opportunities, ticketing initiatives, and operational needs to life while maintaining Nashville SC brand standards. The role will also provide photography support at matches, events, and activations as needed.

 

Responsibilities

Corporate Partnerships and Ticketing Support

  • Create compelling sales presentations, pitch decks, renewal materials, PowerPoint templates, and visual mockups that support partnership and ticketing revenue efforts.
  • Translate outlined partner, prospect, and internal stakeholder concepts into clear, polished visual storytelling.
  • Develop branded partnership assets, including proposed activations, sponsored spaces, signage, social and email graphics, digital content, and in-game visuals.
  • Design sales collateral for existing and future products, spaces, tickets, and other revenue-generating opportunities.
  • Maintain thoughtful visual hierarchy when integrating partner brands with Nashville SC branding.
  • Support partnership fulfillment through sponsorship assets, mock advertisements, presentations, signage, and activation materials. 

Operations and Event Support

  • Assist the Partnership Marketing, Ticketing, and Operations teams with design-related assignments.
  • Support Operations with design needs for matchdays, events, special activations, wayfinding, large-format graphics, and other event-facing materials.
  • Prepare print-ready and digital files that meet production specifications and quality standards.
  • Design assets for LED ribbons, virtual signage, stadium displays, and other in-venue systems as assigned.
  • Provide photography coverage for matches, events, activations, and internal needs when required.
  • Organize, store, and archive design files and photography assets for efficient team use.

Marketing and Brand Support

  • Assist the Marketing team with campaigns, promotions, theme nights, match graphics, social media, web, email, advertising, giveaways, and physical signage when capacity allows.
  • Contribute original ideas during creative brainstorming and help keep work current, relevant, and aligned with fan and industry trends.
  • Support the Creative Director and Marketing Designers in maintaining and evolving Nashville SC brand standards.
  • Respond to creative requests from internal departments and manage several assignments within a deadline-driven environment

Qualifications

  • 1-2 years of professional design experience.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating presentation design, branding, digital graphics, layout, and visual storytelling.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint; experience with Canva and Adobe Express is a plus.
  • Familiarity with motion graphics is a plus.
  • Experience in sports, live events, partnership marketing, or ticketing is preferred.
  • Photography experience, particularly sports or events, is preferred.
  • Strong understanding of typography, composition, brand standards, and design for both digital and print environments.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects, prioritize competing deadlines, and maintain close attention to detail.
  • Comfortable receiving creative direction, incorporating feedback, and working collaboratively across departments.
  • Clear communicator who can build productive relationships with Marketing, Partnerships, Ticketing, and Operations colleagues.
  • Thrives in a fast-paced environment and works well as part of a collaborative team.
  • Self-motivated and able to create polished partner mockups from outlined concepts.
  • Available to work select evenings, weekends, and matchdays as needed.

job.title: Senior Manager, Business Strategy & Analytics
job.html_description:
As the Senior Manager, Business Strategy & Analytics, you will play a key leadership role in driving data-informed decision making across the organization. This role will provide strategic ownership of the Club’s CRM and business intelligence initiatives, leveraging customer, ticketing, attendance, marketing, and operational data to identify opportunities for revenue growth, improved fan engagement, and organizational efficiency. The Senior Manager will help lead the development and execution of the Club’s data strategy, establish scalable analytical processes and reporting capabilities, and partner with leaders across other departments to translate complex data into actionable business recommendations.

A successful candidate will be excited to tackle data initiatives daily, develop user interfaces and visualizations that are streamlined and insightful, and balance independent work with a healthy dose of collaboration across several departments. We’re looking for someone who is eager to learn, welcomes challenges with a positive attitude, and exhibits intelligence and flexibility when strategizing on how best to solve a problem or answer a question. The ideal candidate will be comfortable setting priorities, leading cross-functional initiatives, developing and mentoring team members, challenging existing processes, and independently identifying opportunities to improve how the organization uses data to make decisions.

Responsibilities:

  • Own and lead the Club’s CRM strategy, including system design, automation, training, processes, updates to existing data, and coordination with IT and external technology partners.
  • Oversee day-to-day CRM administration including data entry, data cleansing, user support and training for new and existing users.
  • Lead the analysis and interpretation of CRM, ticket sales, attendance, marketing, and other customer data to identify trends, opportunities, and actionable recommendations for leadership.
  • Develop and oversee strategies for building high-quality lead lists, audience segmentation, lead scoring, and targeted campaigns within CRM.
  • Lead the ongoing development and optimization of processes for scoring, evaluating, nurturing, and converting current and prospective customers.
  • Establish and maintain executive-level reporting and business intelligence capabilities to track sales, renewals, invoicing, sales pipelines, customer engagement, and other key performance indicators.
  • Evaluate emerging AI tools and technologies, establish best practices for responsible adoption, and serve as a subject-matter resource for AI applications within the organization.
  • Partner with Marketing, Ticket Sales, Partnerships, Finance, and other business units to improve lead generation, customer acquisition, retention, and lifecycle marketing strategies.
  • Integrate with internal and external data systems to create in-depth customer records and send targeted communications
  • Identify and drive opportunities to maximize revenues, profitability and organizational efficiency through disciplined adherence to research, analytics, automated reporting, and data-informed recommendations.
  • Organize, analyze, and present data from ticket sales and operations, marketing campaigns, merchandise sales, social media interaction, survey responses, capital expenditures, corporate partnerships, and other business areas.
  • Oversee data imports, audits, validation, and quality-control processes supporting the Club’s Data Warehouse and broader analytics environment.
  • Use programming languages, such as Python or SQL, to help develop efficiencies and automate processes.
  • Continuously evaluate emerging technologies, industry trends, and practices across professional sports and other industries to identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Partner with IT and other stakeholders to ensure AI solutions are implemented with appropriate data governance, security, privacy, accuracy, and user adoption standards.
  • Ability to work a flexible schedule and sometimes work evenings or weekends to cover events.
  • Complete other strategic initiatives and special projects as assigned.

 

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Analytics, Business, Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Operations Research, or a closely related field.
  • 5+ years of progressive experience in business strategy, analytics, business intelligence, or a related field.
  • Advanced knowledge of SQL required; experience with Python or other programming languages preferred.
  • Experience working with business intelligence and data visualization tools (Tableau preferred).
  • Demonstrated experience developing and implementing CRM strategies and initiatives; Salesforce experience preferred.
  • Experience working with email marketing tools (Salesforce Marketing Cloud preferred).
  • Demonstrated experience identifying and implementing AI-enabled business solutions, automation, or analytical applications.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional projects and influence stakeholders across multiple departments.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex data into actionable business recommendations and effectively communicate findings to executive leadership.
  • Experience managing, mentoring, and developing junior team members.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to connect analytics, technology, and customer data to revenue and organizational objectives.
  • Strong written, verbal, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.

job.title: Safety & Security - Venue Security Officer PT
job.location: GEODIS Park, 2226 Bransford Ave, Nashville, Tennessee, United States of America
job.html_description:
NO PHONE CALLS OR EMAILS, PLEASE.  Thanks for your interest! Due to the volume of applications, we’re unable to respond to individual status inquiries. If selected to move forward, you’ll hear from our HR team at Nashville Soccer Club.

POSITION OVERVIEW:
The Venue Security Officer will provide prevention activities and contribute to the building safety and security by monitoring and reporting physical security and safety conditions.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
  • Assist with controlling access to the Stadium including registering and directing visitors.  Visually inspect the ID card of each person entering the building and verify that the individual and the cardholder are the same.
  • Help with writing reports on all accidents or potential problems that shall occur, as well as notifying the Security management team.
  • Issue temporary access badges to authorized personnel as required by procedures.
  • Escort visitors and other personnel as required by procedures.
  • Inspect packages and other designated items as required (including assignment as a searcher).
  • Conduct foot patrol and Stadium security checks.
  • Visually inspect and monitor designated post area(s).
  • Assist with monitoring performance of security/safety equipment.
  • Investigate and report any unusual or unauthorized activity within the area.
  • Verify credentials to control access in restricted areas.
  • Assist with inspecting bags and purses at all entry points for prohibited items, as well as operate a walk-through metal detector (WTMD) or Evolv machine. 
  • Be observant for fires and suspicious packages.
  • Be observant for spills and alert to odors and unusual sounds.
  • Check and report condition of area, exit, and emergency lighting.
  • Check external access to vital areas of the facility.
  • Monitor access through designated doors as required.
  • In the event of alarm conditions, assist in the safe and orderly evacuation of facility personnel if warranted.
  • Respond to local audible alarms on HVAC and electrical equipment.  Report and silence alarms as instructed by procedures and Facility Operations personnel during after-hours operations.
  • Identify and turn-off electrical appliances such as space heaters, fans, coffee pots, etc., that might be left on after normal work hours and could pose a source of heat and ignition for fire.
  • Be observant for trespassers and unauthorized persons.
  • Inspect designated areas for unauthorized activity.
  • Operate and monitor CCTV and access control systems where required.
  • Operate computer-based security/safety-related software and applications as required.
  • Assist with controlling access to the Stadium utilizing access control system.
  • Complete required testing of security and fire systems-related equipment as required by security procedures.
  • Operate and monitor alarm systems where required.
  • Initiate appropriate response as required for various alarms.
  • Initiate and maintain 24/7 communication with the Security management team. 
  • Dispatch other Security Force personnel and/or check alarms as required.
  • Additional duties as assigned. 
 
QUALIFICATIONS:
  • Minimum of a high school education or have passed a General Educational Development (GED) equivalency test.
  • Ability to be trained to operate a golf cart, magnetometer wand, and walk-through metal detector and Evolv machine.
  • Able to obtain a State of Tennessee Security Guard License.  
  • Previous security, law enforcement and/or military experience strongly preferred.
  • Effective verbal and written communications skills.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgment and remain calm during times of stress.
  • Ability to lift, pull, push and/or carry 25-60 lbs. as necessary.
  • Ability to work in outdoor weather conditions to include extreme heat, cold and rain.
  • Ability to work a flexible schedule, including but not limited to days, nights, weekends and holidays.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.

job.title: Event Operations - Event Operations Associate PT
job.location: GEODIS Park, 2226 Bransford Ave, Nashville, Tennessee, United States of America
job.html_description:
NO PHONE CALLS OR EMAILS, PLEASE.  Thanks for your interest! Due to the volume of applications, we’re unable to respond to individual status inquiries. If selected to move forward, you’ll hear from our HR team at Nashville Soccer Club.

Department:  Event Operations
Reports to:  Director, Event Operations

ABOUT NASHVILLE SC:
Nashville is America’s “It City” and one of the fastest-growing soccer hubs in the country. From hosting the CONCACAF Gold Cup to FIFA World Cup Qualifiers and the FIFA Club World Cup, Music City has quickly become a destination for some of the sport’s most prominent events. Nashville SC has the largest soccer-specific stadium in Major League Soccer and in 2025 made Tennessee state history by becoming its first professional sports team champion! 
Position Summary:
Nashville Soccer Club is currently seeking an Event Operations part-time associate. This position will support the GEODIS Park Event Operations team in the planning and execution of Major League Soccer matches, as well as other major events, while also providing day-to-day support to the club's operations.  
Duties & Responsibilities:
  • Assist the Event Operations department on the planning and execution of Major League Soccer games, third-party ancillary events, and other major events.
  • Ensure Club and Stadium standard operating procedures are compliant with Major League Soccer’s operational regulations.
  • During Major League Soccer events:
  1. Ensure locker room set-ups meet MLS standardization requirements.
  2. Assist in servicing the needs of visiting teams and league officials on game day.
  3. Provide support for the referee crew before, during and after the game.
  4. Assist with match credential production and distribution.
  5. Lead, brief, and oversee ball retrievers during the event.
  6. Assist various departments with match day responsibilities.
  • During third-party/major events:
  1. Assist in ensuring that client needs, and expectations are met.
  2. Work with the Event Management Team in planning operational details of the event.
  3. Help with the movement and storage of the department’s equipment.
  4. Setting event day spaces to meet needs of various departments.
  • Other duties as assigned.
DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS:
  • Knowledge and interest in sports and entertainment.
  • Computer proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Strong communication skills and professional etiquette.
  • Strong worth ethic with a positive, team-oriented approach.
REQUIREMENTS
  • Available 20-25 hours per week, including nights and weekends and often under extreme weather conditions. A typical game day can require early hours and late nights amounting to a 12 hour event day commitment.
  • Ability to lift and carry at least 50 pounds.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.

job.title: Academy Scouting Coordinator
job.html_description:
The Academy Scouting Coordinator supports the Head of Academy Scouting through our player tracking system, scouting administration, talent identification support, recruitment coordination, recruiting logistics, trial management, and local scouting coordination. This position creates operational efficiencies that let scouting staff maximize time spent evaluating players, building relationships, and identifying elite academy talent.

 

The Academy Scouting Coordinator is responsible for maintaining and updating the operational systems that support Nashville Soccer Club Academy player scouting and recruitment activities.  This role serves as the primary administrator of scouting infrastructure, player databases, reporting systems, video resources, and talent identification workflows, supporting the club's efforts to identify, evaluate, recruit, and monitor elite youth talent.

 

Responsibilities

Player Database Administration

  • Maintain scouting and recruitment databases
  • Ensure data accuracy and integrity
  • Generate dashboards and reports

Recruitment Pipeline Management

  • Manage recruitment pipeline and player tracking
  • Maintain prospect records and watchlists
  • Monitor recruitment timelines and follow-up actions

Scouting Operations Support

  • Coordinate scouting schedules for homegrown reporters’ program
  • Track scouting reports
  • Prepare recruitment briefing materials

Trial Coordination

  • Coordinate academy trials
  • Manage registrations and documentation
  • Collect evaluations and communicate outcomes
  • Support strategic planning

Family and Player Communication

  • Serve as recruitment point of contact
  • Manage trial invitations

job.title: Housekeeping - Housekeeping PT
job.location: GEODIS Park, 2226 Bransford Ave, Nashville, Tennessee, United States of America
job.html_description:
About Nashville SC & GEODIS Park:
 Nashville is America’s “It City” and one of the fastest-growing soccer hubs in the country. From hosting the CONCACAF Gold Cup to FIFA World Cup Qualifiers and the FIFA Club World Cup, Music City has quickly become a destination for some of the sport’s most prominent events. Locally, Nashville SC is in its sixth season and continues to thrive both on and off the field, highlighted by the opening of GEODIS Park in May 2022—the largest soccer-specific stadium in Major League Soccer. 
 
What we are looking for:
  • Individuals available for 6-8 hours, 15-20 times per year, and available to attend all necessary in-person and virtual training as a prerequisite for employment
  • Someone who enjoys speaking and interacting with others in a warm, and respectful manner
  • Must enjoy helping others and working within a team environment
  • Ability to lift, pull, push and/or carry 25-60 lbs. as necessary
  • Must be able to stand for long periods of time and be exposed to different types of weather 

Primary roles & responsibilities:
  • Maintain stadium cleanliness, emptying trash cans, replacing trash cans with a new liner, wiping down countertop areas, tops of trash cans; sweeping/mopping the concourse as necessary; squeegeeing standing water to provide a safe environment for our guests; picking up and throwing away trash left in the stadium and outside perimeter that cannot be swept.
  • Responsible for providing a clean and safe facility before, during, and after all events
  • Responsible for picking up trash and emptying trash and recycle receptacles
  • Maintain all aspects of restroom cleanliness and preparedness by stocking and wiping down dispensers; cleaning and disinfecting all fixtures (toilets, urinals, sinks, baby changing tables); keeping the floor clean, dry and free of debris; and emptying trash cans
  • Respond to and resolve guests’ questions, concerns, complaints or suggestions in a professional and polite manner. Recognize and respond effectively in emergency situations
  • Supervisory positions available

job.title: Facility Operations - Facility Operations Associate PT
job.location: GEODIS Park, 2226 Bransford Ave, Nashville, Tennessee, United States of America
job.html_description:
Nashville Soccer Club is looking for individuals with an interest in event and facility management to join our operations team. This position is responsible for assisting with daily operations of all Geodis Park events. This is a part-time position, working on an as-needed basis only and expected to work an average of 15-20 hours of work per week.  

RESPONSIBILITIES:
  • Assist with venue setup and breakdown for Major League Soccer Events.
  • Ensure locker room and field set-ups meet MLS standardization requirements.
  • Assist with setup and breakdown of parking equipment pre and post match.
  • Accurately execute setup and teardown of event spaces throughout the stadium and surrounding campus.
  • Create and deploy event and stadium signage.
  • Operate heavy machinery and maintain inventory for logistical operations.
  • Collaborate with other departments during the preparation and execution of events. 
  • Help with the movement and storage of stadium equipment.
  • Complete other duties as assigned.
 
 SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS:
  • Available for all (most) of Nashville SC home matches
  • Must be able to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends and holidays, as necessary.
  • Must possess strong communication (verbal and written) and organizational skills.
  • Dependable and team-oriented with a service attitude
  • Ability to lift a minimum of 50 pounds.
  • Ability to stand or walk for long periods of time.
  • Willingness to work in extreme conditions of different weather elements.
  • Outgoing personality, highly energetic, and enthusiastic
  • Experience in athletics, event planning execution or leading a small team preferred. 
  • Ability to work comfortably both independently and in a team environment.
  • Must be able to interact with all levels of the organization and represent the Stadium Operations Team in a professional manner.
 
 WORK ENVIRONMENT:
  • The noise level in the work environment is sometimes loud.
  • Ability to work in all types of weather, including extreme heat and cold.
  • Fast-paced work environment with many moving parts
 
CERTIFICATIONS AND LICENSES:
  • Driver’s license required.
  • Forklift certification preferred but not required.

job.title: Manager, Information Technology
job.html_description:
Position Summary: The Manager, Information Technology leads Nashville SC's day-to-day information technology function across GEODIS Park, office locations, training facilities, and other Club operations. This hands-on management role is responsible for maintaining a reliable and secure technology environment, overseeing IT vendors, providing technical leadership, and managing the IT Administrator. The Manager, Information Technology serves as the primary escalation point for significant technical issues and provides strong hands-on administration of the Club's network environment. The position oversees core systems, infrastructure, vendor coordination, and technical projects while partnering with the Chief of Staff on organizational priorities, budgets, and broader project coordination.

 

Key Responsibilities:

• Lead the day-to-day IT function and maintain a reliable, secure, and well-supported

technology environment across Club facilities.

• Directly manage the IT Administrator, including setting priorities, reviewing work, supporting

professional development, and ensuring help-desk requests are

organized and resolved appropriately.

• Serve as the primary escalation point for complex technical issues, major outages, security

incidents, and significant network problems.

• Provide strong hands-on administration of wired and wireless networks, including switches,

VLANs, wireless access points, firewall rules, DHCP, DNS, VPN

connectivity, monitoring, and advanced troubleshooting.

• Maintain oversight of Microsoft 365, Exchange Online, Active Directory, Entra ID, Okta,

endpoint management, identity and access management, backups, and 

other core business systems.

• Own operational cybersecurity activities, including MFA, endpoint security, access reviews,

security tooling, incident coordination, and employee security practices, 

engaging specialized partners when appropriate.

• Manage external IT and technology vendors, including relationship ownership, project

coordination, proposal review, and recommendations regarding contracts or 

services, subject to organizational approval.

• Serve as the technical owner for IT projects, including defining technical requirements,

evaluating architecture and solutions, coordinating technical 

implementation, testing, and working with vendors and internal stakeholders.

• Own the underlying IT and network infrastructure supporting venue technologies such as Wi-

Fi, point-of-sale connectivity, printers, access-control connectivity, and other connected

systems, while the appropriate departments and vendors remain responsible for their business

platforms.

• Coordinate IT disaster recovery and continuity planning with partners and other applicable

vendors, including understanding critical systems, dependencies, backup processes, restoration

procedures, and escalation paths.

• Identify technology needs, develop technical requirements, evaluate options, and recommend

hardware, software, licensing, and service purchases. 

• Share responsibility with the IT Administrator for maintaining accurate network diagrams,

asset records, system documentation, operating procedures, vendor information, access

procedures, and onboarding/offboarding documentation.

• Provide regular IT coverage for matchdays, stadium events, and other Club activities.

• Perform other duties as assigned.

 

Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in information technology, computer science, or a related field, or

equivalent relevant work experience.

• Three to five years of relevant experience in information technology, systems administration,

network administration, or a related area.

• Prior supervisory or team-lead experience preferred; candidates should demonstrate the

ability to direct work, develop an employee, and lead a small IT function.

• Strong hands-on experience administering and troubleshooting enterprise networks, including

switches, VLANs, wireless networks, firewalls, DHCP, DNS, and VPN 

connectivity.

• Working knowledge of Microsoft 365, Exchange Online, Active Directory, Entra ID, identity and

access management, endpoint administration, and cybersecurity operations.

• Strong troubleshooting, documentation, organization, communication, and customer-service

skills.

• Ability to manage competing priorities in a small, hands-on IT environment supporting

corporate offices, training facilities, and a major event venue.

• Ability to work on-site and travel between Club facilities as needed.

• Availability to support periodic nights, weekends, matchdays, and stadium events.

job.title: Account Executive, Premium Sales
job.html_description:
The Premium Sales, Account Executive is responsible for generating new revenue through the sale of premium seating products, including luxury suites, club seats, and VIP hospitality packages for Nashville SC matches and GEODIS Park events and concerts. This position is ideal for high-performing sales professionals with a proven track record of selling to high-net-worth individuals and corporate decision-makers.

This role will have a primary focus on outbound prospecting, networking, appointment setting, and executing sales presentations face-to-face or virtually to close multi-year membership agreements.

 

Key Responsibilities:  

  • Develop and implement a proactive sales strategy to generate new revenue from premium seating products, including suites, club seats and VIP experiences.
  • Identify and cultivate new business opportunities through cold calling, prospecting, networking, referrals and in-person meetings.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with C-level executives, corporate partners and high-net-worth individuals to drive premium sales.
  • Conduct face-to-face and virtual sales presentations, tailoring premium seating options to meet the specific needs of each prospect.
  • Manage the entire sales process from lead generation to contract execution, ensuring seamless and professional customer experience.
  • Consistently meet or exceed individual and team sales goals, including new business revenue.
  • Maintain an updated pipeline of potential buyers in the CRM system, accurately tracking interactions, follow-ups and deal progress.
  • Collaborate with the premium service team to ensure a high level of customer satisfaction and long-term client retention.
  • Attend networking events, client meetings and industry functions to build brand awareness and generate leads.
  • Work game days and special events to engage with premium clients, host prospects and provide top-tier service.
  • Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned to support the overall sales strategy.
Qualifications:  
  • Minimum, 2 years of B2B sales experience, preferably in sports, entertainment, or a related industry preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree in business, sports management, or a related field preferred.  
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to build lasting relationships.  
  • High energy, self-motivated, and team-oriented with a passion for driving results.  
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint); experience with Salesforce and Archtics preferred.  
  • Flexible work schedule, including evenings, weekends, and holidays as required.  
  • Soccer knowledge is a plus but not required.  
  • Bilingual in English and Spanish strongly preferred.

job.title: Full Stack Engineer
job.location: Newcastle upon Tyne Discipline: Football Operations Job type: Permanent Job ref: 011002 Published: 3 months ago Expiry date: 04 Dec 2026 23:59
job.html_description:
Full Stack Engineer

Permanent  

Newcastle Upon Tyne

Competitive Salary

Be part of something bigger. Data & Insights: Building cutting-edge technology that powers football decision-making across the club.

We are the heartbeat of the city. A club with bold ambitions on a global stage and deep roots in our community. If you’re driven to raise the bar and make an impact, you’ll find the platform, the people and the pride to do your best work here.

This is a great opportunity to develop, learn and make a real contribution in a fast-paced and exciting environment.

About the role

We are seeking a Full Stack Engineer to design, build and maintain the internal analytics tools used by scouts, analysts, coaches and football operations staff. Working across both backend and frontend technologies, you will transform complex football data into intuitive, reliable products that support recruitment and performance decision-making across Newcastle United.

What you’ll do

  • Design, build and maintain internal web applications across the full technology stack.

  • Develop backend services and REST APIs using modern technologies and best practices.

  • Build clear, data-rich interfaces, dashboards and visualisations that support decision-making.

  • Take ownership of cloud infrastructure, deployment pipelines and application performance.

  • Collaborate with data engineers, analysts, designers and stakeholders to deliver production-ready solutions.

  • Contribute to documentation, knowledge sharing and the continuous improvement of the platform.

The team

You’ll be part of a friendly, supportive and dedicated team who will help you settle in and succeed. We value curiosity, teamwork and a positive approach.

Working within a small, focused Data & Insights team, you will have significant autonomy and the opportunity to shape products and technology that are used daily across football operations.

United As One.

We’re committed to equality, diversity and inclusion and believe in equal opportunities for all. We recognise that the diversity of our people is one of our greatest strengths. We work together to reflect the communities we serve and to maintain an inclusive environment in which everyone can be their authentic self and is enabled to achieve their full potential.

Safeguarding

We’re committed to being a place where everyone is safe, heard, valued and able to thrive so we place high value on the safeguarding and welfare of everyone we engage with.

How to apply

To access the full job description for this role please click here.

For further information on this role and about the club please visit our careers page.

Please apply as soon as possible as this vacancy may close early should we receive a high volume of suitable candidates.

This position is UK based and requires proof of the right to live and work in the UK. All job offers are conditional upon background checks, including reference history, DBS checks, and verification of your eligibility to work. Please note, we do not sponsor applicants without the right to work in the UK.

Recruitment Agencies – please note that we do not accept unsolicited candidate details. Any candidates submitted without request will be considered direct applicants.

job.title: Senior Partnership Sales Executive
job.html_description:
Senior Partnership Sales Executive

Permanent, Full Time

Newcastle upon Tyne

Competitive Salary

Closing Date: 27 November 2026

Be part of something bigger. Turn ambition into partnerships that power the Club’s commercial growth.

We are the heartbeat of the city, a club with bold ambitions on a global stage and deep roots in our community. If you’re driven to raise the bar, make an impact and contribute to a high-performance culture, you’ll find the platform, the people and the pride to do your best work here.

We work as One Club, with excellence, integrity, accountability and relentless ambition shaping how we work together.

This is a great opportunity to develop, learn and make a real contribution in a fast-paced and exciting environment. You’ll be encouraged to bring curiosity, take ownership, share ideas and keep improving, helping us move Newcastle United forward, together.

About the role

You will support Newcastle United’s commercial growth by identifying, developing and securing new partnership opportunities with brands across local, national and international markets.

This is a sales and business development role where you’ll generate new business revenue through proactive prospecting, strong relationship building and compelling, tailored commercial proposals. From identifying new prospects and opening conversations to presenting opportunities and supporting negotiations, you’ll play an important part in growing the Club’s commercial partnerships.

You’ll bring a degree in a related discipline or equivalent commercial sales experience, alongside demonstrable experience within a sales environment. You’ll have experience of closing commercial partnerships and achieving business-to-business sales targets, with strong commercial awareness.

You’ll also be confident building credible relationships and presenting proposals to stakeholders at all levels. Experience in a similar sales role within professional sport would be great, but it isn’t essential.

What you’ll do

  • Support the Senior Partnership Sales Lead and wider Partnership Development team in delivering the Club’s commercial growth targets.
  • Identify and research prospective commercial partners across priority sectors and markets, proactively engaging key decision-makers to open conversations about partnership opportunities.
  • Create high-quality outreach materials and bespoke commercial proposals tailored to the needs and objectives of individual prospects and brands.
  • Arrange and attend meetings with prospective partners, presenting the Club’s partnership opportunities clearly, confidently and credibly.
  • Support commercial negotiations and contracting processes through to deal completion.
  • Manage an active sales pipeline through the CRM system, ensuring opportunities are progressed, recorded and followed up effectively.
  • Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders to understand available partnership rights, assets and inventory.
  • Collaborate with Commercial Innovation, Partnership Marketing, Legal and Finance teams throughout the sales process.
  • Represent the Club at industry conferences, networking events, matchdays and other Club events.
  • Travel nationally and internationally where required, with availability for matchdays and relevant large stadium events to develop prospective partner relationships and provide support as needed.

Permanent

Newcastle Upon Tyne 

Competitive Salary

Develop the next generation. Lead our U15 players towards the scholarship phase with a clear Academy philosophy, individual focus and high-performance standards. 

We are the heartbeat of the city, a club with bold ambitions on a global stage and deep roots in our community. If you’re driven to raise the bar, make an impact and contribute to a high-performance culture, you’ll find the platform, the people and the pride to do your best work here.

About the role 

As Player Development Coach (Lead Youth Phase - U15), you’ll lead the day-to-day coaching and development of our U15 squad, working with multidisciplinary performance staff to prepare players for progression into the scholarship phase. You’ll bring the Academy playing and coaching philosophies to life, creating a consistent, individual-focused programme with clear evidence of player development.

What you’ll do 

*        Plan, deliver and review the U15 coaching programme and curriculum; lead games preparation and support selection and succession planning.

*        Bring professional-game player development experience, strong communication and listening skills, and knowledge of EPPP, audits, safeguarding, welfare and equality.

The Knox (First Team Training Ground)

Alongside managing reception, calls and visitor access, you’ll provide trusted administrative support in a fast-paced environment where discretion, organisation and excellent service matter every day.

job.title: NUW Lead Opposition Performance Analyst New
job.html_description:
NEWCASTLE UNITED WOMEN 

Lead Opposition Performance Analyst 

Newcastle upon Tyne 

Competitive Salary 

Closing Date:8 December 2026 

*Turn opposition insight into match-winning detail and help Newcastle United Women prepare to perform at the highest level.*

We are the heartbeat of the city, a club with bold ambitions on a global stage and deep roots in our community. If you’re driven to raise the bar, make an impact and contribute to a high-performance culture, you’ll find the platform, the people and the pride to do your best work here.

We work as One Club, with excellence, integrity, accountability and relentless ambition shaping how we work together.

About the role 

As Lead Opposition Performance Analyst, you’ll lead and develop a comprehensive opposition analysis strategy for Newcastle United Women’s First Team. Taking ownership of the end-to-end process, you’ll translate detailed tactical observation, video analysis and performance data into clear, actionable insight that informs match preparation, tactical planning and in-game decision-making.

Working closely with the Head of Analysis, Head Coach and First Team coaching staff, you’ll ensure the team approaches every fixture with a detailed understanding of the opposition and a clear, evidence-based tactical plan.

What you’ll do 

*         Lead the delivery of pre-match, live and post-match opposition analysis to an elite standard, tailored to the requirements of the Head Coach.

*         Build a clear understanding of each opponent’s tactical identity, strengths, vulnerabilities, key players and potential match-winning opportunities.

*         Present concise opposition reports and practical recommendations to the Head Coach, management team, coaches and players.

*         Translate tactical findings into evidence-based actions that support match planning and training preparation.

*         Develop and maintain a consistent, high-quality framework for opposition analysis, including video, data, set-piece and individual-player insight.

*         Lead background research, telestrated visuals, squad analysis and the opposition scouting schedule, attending matches where required.

*         Monitor tactical developments across the season and maintain accurate video and analysis databases in line with NUW’s philosophy.

*         Use the tactical buggy during First Team training to provide real-time feedback, and live code matches where required.

*         Provide leadership and guidance to colleagues contributing to opposition analysis while working collaboratively across the wider performance team.

What you’ll bring 

*         Demonstrable experience of delivering high-quality opposition analysis within an elite professional football environment, including presenting to senior coaches or management.

*         Strong football and tactical knowledge, with the ability to identify playing styles, player traits, strengths and vulnerabilities.

*         Proven ability to independently lead opposition research and convert complex tactical information into clear, actionable recommendations.

*         Advanced video-editing and visual-presentation skills, with experience of Hudl, Sports code, Studio and Wyscout, alongside Microsoft Office and/or Keynote.

*         Excellent written, verbal and interpersonal skills, with confidence to communicate clearly and challenge constructively.

*         Exceptional attention to detail, sound judgement and the ability to manage multiple priorities and strict deadlines in a fast-moving environment.

*         A collaborative, adaptable and self-motivated approach, with a commitment to confidentiality and continuous improvement.

*         It would be advantageous if you also have:

*         Strong knowledge of women’s football, including current tactical trends and players.

*         The ability to interpret numerical data and use data-visualisation tools such as Power BI or Tableau.

Qualifications

*         An undergraduate or master’s degree in Sports Science, Sports Coaching, Performance Analysis or a related discipline.

*         A UEFA B Coaching Qualification and/or five or more years’ experience supporting professional football through analysis, coaching, scouting or playing.

The team 

You’ll be an integral member of the Newcastle United Women Performance Analysis department, working in close partnership with the Head of Analysis, Head Coach and First Team coaching staff. You’ll join a committed, collaborative football environment where high standards, curiosity, accountability and continuous improvement are central to how we work.

United As One

We work as One Club, reflecting the communities we serve, acting with integrity, and creating an environment where everyone can be their authentic self and achieve their full potential.

Safeguarding 

We’re committed to creating an environment where everyone is safe, heard, valued and able to thrive. Safeguarding and welfare are central to the way we work, and we expect everyone to play their part in doing the right thing and upholding the highest standards of care.

This role requires an enhanced criminal record check with a check of the relevant barred list, deemed suitable by the Club.

How to apply 

To access the full job description for this role please click here.

Please apply as soon as possible as this vacancy may close early should we receive a high volume of suitable candidates.

job.plain_text_description:
NEWCASTLE UNITED WOMEN
Lead Opposition Performance Analyst
Newcastle upon Tyne
Competitive Salary
Closing Date:8 December 2026
*Turn opposition insight into match-winning detail and help Newcastle United Women prepare to perform at the highest level.*
We are the heartbeat of the city, a club with bold ambitions on a global stage and deep roots in our community. If you’re driven to raise the bar, make an impact and contribute to a high-performance culture, you’ll find the platform, the people and the pride to do your best work here.
We work as One Club, with excellence, integrity, accountability and relentless ambition shaping how we work together.
About the role
As Lead Opposition Performance Analyst, you’ll lead and develop a comprehensive opposition analysis strategy for Newcastle United Women’s First Team. Taking ownership of the end-to-end process, you’ll translate detailed tactical observation, video analysis and performance data into clear, actionable insight that informs match preparation, tactical planning and in-game decision-making.
Working closely with the Head of Analysis, Head Coach and First Team coaching staff, you’ll ensure the team approaches every fixture with a detailed understanding of the opposition and a clear, evidence-based tactical plan.
What you’ll do
* Lead the delivery of pre-match, live and post-match opposition analysis to an elite standard, tailored to the requirements of the Head Coach.
* Build a clear understanding of each opponent’s tactical identity, strengths, vulnerabilities, key players and potential match-winning opportunities.
* Present concise opposition reports and practical recommendations to the Head Coach, management team, coaches and players.
* Translate tactical findings into evidence-based actions that support match planning and training preparation.
* Develop and maintain a consistent, high-quality framework for opposition analysis, including video, data, set-piece and individual-player insight.
* Lead background research, telestrated visuals, squad analysis and the opposition scouting schedule, attending matches where required.
* Monitor tactical developments across the season and maintain accurate video and analysis databases in line with NUW’s philosophy.
* Use the tactical buggy during First Team training to provide real-time feedback, and live code matches where required.
* Provide leadership and guidance to colleagues contributing to opposition analysis while working collaboratively across the wider performance team.
What you’ll bring
* Demonstrable experience of delivering high-quality opposition analysis within an elite professional football environment, including presenting to senior coaches or management.
* Strong football and tactical knowledge, with the ability to identify playing styles, player traits, strengths and vulnerabilities.
* Proven ability to independently lead opposition research and convert complex tactical information into clear, actionable recommendations.
* Advanced video-editing and visual-presentation skills, with experience of Hudl, Sports code, Studio and Wyscout, alongside Microsoft Office and/or Keynote.
* Excellent written, verbal and interpersonal skills, with confidence to communicate clearly and challenge constructively.
* Exceptional attention to detail, sound judgement and the ability to manage multiple priorities and strict deadlines in a fast-moving environment.
* A collaborative, adaptable and self-motivated approach, with a commitment to confidentiality and continuous improvement.
* It would be advantageous if you also have:
* Strong knowledge of women’s football, including current tactical trends and players.
* The ability to interpret numerical data and use data-visualisation tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
Qualifications
* An undergraduate or master’s degree in Sports Science, Sports Coaching, Performance Analysis or a related discipline.
* A UEFA B Coaching Qualification and/or five or more years’ experience supporting professional football through analysis, coaching, scouting or playing.
The team
You’ll be an integral member of the Newcastle United Women Performance Analysis department, working in close partnership with the Head of Analysis, Head Coach and First Team coaching staff. You’ll join a committed, collaborative football environment where high standards, curiosity, accountability and continuous improvement are central to how we work.

job.title: Host Family Provider
job.location: The Nigel Doughty Academy, Nottingham, NG2 7SR, GB
job.html_description:
Contract: Temporary engagement

Location: Within three miles (15 minutes), easy access to The Nigel Doughty Academy, Nottingham, NG2 7SR

Working Arrangements: Remote

Closing Date For Applications: INSERT

About the Role:

We are recruiting for host families who can provide accommodation for our Academy players to support them living away from home. This is a unique and rewarding opportunity to make a real difference to their experience and provide vital support to the players as they develop as young people alongside their football.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • Provide a homely and friendly environment for our young people

  • Support with the development of our young people in your care with their independent living and self-care skills

  • Include our young people in family life as much as they feel comfortable with

  • Provide access to a private bedroom, bathroom, laundry facilities, and communal areas of the house

  • Provide a nutritious evening meal 

  • Report any welfare concerns to the Safeguarding and Welfare team should they occur.

  • Allow access from the Club for regular inspection and visits throughout the season.

  • Adhere to any further and ongoing requirements of Host Families, as outlined in the application process, guidance will be provided by the Club on this. 

What are we looking for:

  • Provide a warm, welcoming and safe environment for our young person

  • Provide the young person with their own private bedroom and relevant amenities 

  • Excellent communication and listening skills

  • Ability to cope with the young person's flexible schedule throughout the football season

  • Previous experience of working with young people

  • Ability to promote and demonstrate anti-discriminatory practice 

As part of the recruitment process the Club would need to conduct a number of home visits to determine suitability and ensure the home meets the requirements for hosting young people within the Academy.

Forest For Everyone

At Nottingham Forest Football Club we are committed to creating an environment where differences are respected, individuality is celebrated, everyone feels valued, supported, and included. Our goal is to ensure every member of our team can be themselves, contribute fully, and reach their potential without barriers.

Our Commitment to Equality, Diversity, Inclusion and Mental Wellbeing

As an equal opportunities employer, we welcome applications from talented people of all backgrounds regardless of age, disability, gender identity or reassignment, marital or civil partnership status, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by law.

We continue to develop policies and practices that promote equality, diversity, inclusion and mental wellbeing across our workforce. To help us measure progress and hold ourselves accountable, we ask all applicants to provide accurate diversity information during the recruitment process.

Disability Confident Committed Employer

As part of the Club’s commitment to safeguarding, the successful applicant may be required to undergo a Disclosure Barring Service (“DBS”) check. The level of check required will depend on the requirements of the role. Individuals will be asked to declare any convictions, cautions, reprimands, warnings or bind-overs that they are required to disclose for the level of check applicable to the role, in accordance with the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act 1974 (as amended) and the DBS filtering rules. The results of any check will be considered on an individual basis, and the Club will act proportionately in deciding whether to proceed with the appointment. The Club reserves the right to carry out risk assessments where content has been disclosed if it feels that it is relevant to the job requirements of the role. Failure to satisfy the Club, FA’s and the PL's safeguarding requirements may lead to the job offer being withdrawn or, if they have already started employment, summary termination of the employment, in accordance with the Club's disciplinary procedures

Our Commitment to Safeguarding

As part of the Club’s commitment to safeguarding, the successful applicant may be required to undergo a Disclosure Barring Service (“DBS”) check or an enhanced DBS check. The results of a DBS check will be considered on an individual basis, and the Club will act in a proportionate manner when deciding whether or not to proceed with the appointment.

An FA Enhanced DBS disclosure is required for all relevant new appointments to the Club. Individuals will be asked to declare any convictions, cautions or reprimands, warnings or bind-overs that may have been incurred. The Club reserves the right to carry out risk assessments where content has been disclosed on a DBS disclosure if it feels that it is relevant to the job requirements. Failure to satisfy the Club and the PL's safeguarding requirements may lead to the job offer being withdrawn or, if they have already started employment, summary termination of the employment.

Health and Safety

At Nottingham Forest Football Club, we are committed to ensuring a safe and healthy working environment for all employees. In accordance with the Health and Safety at Work etc. Act 1974, you are required to take reasonable care for your own health and safety and that of others who may be affected by your actions or omissions at work. You must also cooperate with the Club's health and safety policies and procedures. Should you identify any health and safety concerns, please report them promptly to your manager or a member of the Health and Safety/Facilities team.

job.title: Academy Safeguarding Manager
job.location: The City Ground, Nottingham, NG2 5FJ, GB
job.html_description:
Salary: Please state your expectations within your application

Contract: Full Time, 42 hours a week

Location: The Nigel Doughty Academy, Nottingham, NG2 7SR

Department: Safeguarding

Reporting to: Head of Safeguarding

Closing Date For Applications: 27th November 2026

About the Role:

The designated person will have primary responsibility for leading and implementing the Academy's safeguarding strategy and policies and for putting excellent monitoring and reporting procedures into daily practice to safeguard children and adults at risk across the Academy.

The Perks of the Job:

  • Opportunity to access tickets for events at The City Ground.

  • Employee Assistance Programme.

  • Access to high street and gym discounts.

  • Discount within our Club shop.

  • Free on-site parking.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • Line Management of Academy Designated Safeguarding Officer.

  • Ensuring appropriate safeguarding cover at the training ground during all Academy activity.

  • Providing strategic influence and guidance on good safeguarding practise as part of the Academy Leadership Team.

  • Working with all stakeholders to create a positive, child-centred academy environment.

  • Lead on implementing and evolving the Academy’s approach to safeguarding children, young people and adults at risk.

  • Be the lead point of contact within the Academy for reporting and managing of Safeguarding concerns about children and young people and guide and delegate colleagues to manage concerns where appropriate.

  • Ensure all stakeholders are fully aware of reporting procedures through regular training and the dissemination of appropriate resources.

  • Manage cases relating to safeguarding concerns about children and young people reported to and by the Academy staff and stakeholders, undertake further investigations as/when required, and ensure all information is accurate, confidential, up to date, in line with GDP regulations and appropriately captured and monitored using our online system MyConcern.

  • Support the Head of Safeguarding to manage concerns relating to Academy staff when appropriate.

  • Liaise with parents/carers, schools, and local authorities when appropriate in relation to safeguarding concerns.

  • Maintain oversight of children and young people with additional vulnerabilities and ensure their needs are assessed and reasonable support is in place for them at the Academy.

  • Monitor and report on themes or trends in safeguarding matters at the Academy to the Academy Leadership Team, Head of Safeguarding and where appropriate the Senior Safeguarding Board.

  • Help to ensure that the Premier League standards are met within in the Academy by promoting and championing all safeguarding policy and procedures and assisting in compiling evidence for audits.

  • Develop policies, procedures and guidance documents to enhance safeguarding practises at the Academy. Facilitate and support the development and review of policies and procedures as appropriate.

  • Design and deliver educational interventions for staff including training, presentations, and resource materials to raise awareness of safeguarding policies, procedures, and guidance.

  • Design and regularly review the Academy safeguarding induction and ensure new starters receive relevant information and resources.

  • Support the Operations and Coaching departments with planning, preparing, and delivering trips and tours, including risk assessments and safeguarding provisions. Attend trips and tours on occasion to maintain oversight of risks, to assess safeguarding procedures, and to provide safeguarding support.

  • Assist the Academy in keeping staff’s safeguarding training up to date, including the FA Safeguarding Children certificates.

  • Support the Club’s safer recruitment process by ensuring new and existing staff undertake the relevant DBS checks in a timely manner.

  • Attend training and fixtures for all age groups in the Academy to observe and feedback where applicable on best practice. Including and not limited to training and fixture venues both home and away.

  • Provide advice and support to all staff, volunteers and associates of the organisation in relation to safeguarding concerns and queries.

  • Responsible for identifying staff training and development needs by evaluating strengths and weaknesses, Once identified, responsible for planning, organising and overseeing appropriate training on an annual basis.

  • Attend and contribute to Academy SWEP Group meetings as deemed appropriate.

  • Represent the Academy at Club safeguarding meetings and feedback where appropriate.

  • Maintain player information confidentiality and professional distance from all playing staff acting within professional codes of conduct and scope of practice at all times.

  • To act, at all times, in a manner appropriate to a representative of Nottingham Forest FC.

What are we looking for:

Essential:

  • FA Safeguarding Children or equivalent.

  • A recognised qualification in Player Care / Safeguarding.

  • Understanding of Safeguarding policies and procedures.

  • Experience of safeguarding and working with children, ideally in an elite sport environment.

  • Knowledge, understanding and experience of working with and supporting young people with mental health or wellbeing concerns.

  • Excellent presentation, planning and communication skills.

  • Excellent problem solving and decision-making skills with the ability to multi-task and balance conflicting demands.

  • Experience in contributing to the design, delivery and evaluation of education and development interventions for individuals and groups.

  • Experience of working and contributing to a team environment by collaborating with others.

  • Ability to build strong relationships with players, parents, coaches and other stakeholders.

  • Ability to engage and communicate with people of all ages, especially young elite athletes.

  • Flexible, caring and a non-judgmental approach and attitude.

  • Always hold a professional manner and remain compliant with confidentiality.

  • Knowledge of roles and responsibilities of local statutory agencies (social services, police, and local safeguarding children board).

Desirable:

  • Previous experience in a safeguarding role in Academy football.

  • Mental Health First Aid training qualification.

  • FA Welfare Officer training.

Forest For Everyone

We aim to create a culture which embraces and celebrates our differences, enables individuals to feel comfortable, maximise their potential and eliminate discrimination.

Nottingham Forest Football Club is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from all suitably qualified persons, regardless of age, disability, gender, gender reassignment, marital / civil partnership status, pregnancy / maternity leave, race, religion/belief, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Nottingham Forest Football Club is a signatory of the FA’s Football Leadership Diversity Code. We are committed to developing policies to promote equal opportunities and diversity within our workforce. To monitor our progress against these commitments, we Invite all applicants to provide diversity data during the application process.

Disability Confident Committed Employer

We are a Disability Confident Committed employer.  We encourage applications from people with disabilities and long-term health conditions.  If you need disability-related adjustments to the recruitment process, please indicate this in your application.

If you are likely to meet the definition of being a "disabled person" according to the Equality Act 2010, you may be eligible to apply for an interview via the Disability Confident Scheme - please indicate this in your application form below.  The information you share with us about your health or disability will not be used in recruitment selections.

Our Commitment to Safeguarding

As part of the Club’s commitment to safeguarding, the successful applicant may be required to undergo a Disclosure Barring Service (“DBS”) check. The level of check required will depend on the requirements of the role. Individuals will be asked to declare any convictions, cautions, reprimands, warnings or bind-overs that they are required to disclose for the level of check applicable to the role, in accordance with the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act 1974 (as amended) and the DBS filtering rules. The results of any check will be considered on an individual basis, and the Club will act proportionately in deciding whether to proceed with the appointment. The Club reserves the right to carry out risk assessments where content has been disclosed if it feels that it is relevant to the job requirements of the role. Failure to satisfy the Club, FA’s and the PL's safeguarding requirements may lead to the job offer being withdrawn or, if they have already started employment, summary termination of the employment, in accordance with the Club's disciplinary procedures

Health and Safety

Nottingham Forest is committed to maintaining a safe and healthy working environment for all employees, contractors, visitors, and guests. All employees are expected to comply with company health and safety policies, procedures and risk assessments, use equipment and PPE correctly and report any hazards, accidents and near misses. Appropriate training will be provided to ensure everyone understands their health and safety responsibilities.
